episodeTitle.en: Meta’s Muse: How we launched the most successful consumer product this year | Mona Sarantakos
episodeTitle.zh: Meta 的 Muse：我们如何推出今年最成功的消费产品｜Mona Sarantakos

bio.zh: Mona Sarantakos 是 Meta Superintelligence Labs 的产品副总裁，从 Muse 项目第一天起就负责产品。受访时她在 Meta 已有十年、做产品超过二十年。她特别关注普通消费者第一次使用 AI 时会卡在哪里。
bio.en: Mona is VP of Product at Meta Superintelligence Labs and led Muse from day one. At the time of the interview she had spent ten years at Meta and more than twenty in product. Her focus is where AI succeeds or fails for everyday consumers.

episodeTitle.en: Why PMs are suddenly valuable again | Tulsee Doshi (Head of Product, Gemini)
episodeTitle.zh: 为什么产品经理突然又变得有价值了？｜Gemini 产品负责人 Tulsee Doshi

bio.zh: Tulsee Doshi 在 Google 负责前沿 AI 模型的产品工作，范围包括 Gemini 及图像、视频和音乐模型。她常在研究团队和应用团队之间工作，把模型的能力边界变成可以讨论的产品决定。
bio.en: Tulsee leads product work on Google’s frontier AI models, including Gemini and models for images, video, and music. Her role connects model research with decisions about what people can actually use.

episodeTitle.en: A UGC masterclass from the 22-year-old who built Wispr Flow’s growth machine | Hector Serrano
episodeTitle.zh: 搭建 Wispr Flow 增长体系的 22 岁操盘手，讲透用户创作内容｜Hector Serrano

bio.zh: Hector Serrano 在 Wispr Flow 负责内容，从自己持续制作广告，做到组织一群创作者为语音输入产品制作内容。他熟悉从第一次邀约、合作说明，到最终审核一支视频的全过程。
bio.en: Hector heads content at Wispr Flow. He went from personally producing ads for its voice-to-text product to running a creator program, working across outreach, onboarding, and final review.

episodeTitle.en: An 86-minute guide to finding PMF | Rob Snyder (Author, The Power of Pull)
episodeTitle.zh: 寻找产品与市场匹配的 86 分钟指南｜《The Power of Pull》作者 Rob Snyder

bio.zh: Rob Snyder 是《The Power of Pull》作者，写作 The Physics of Startups 通讯。他做过创始人，也辅导过五十多家早期公司。他的出发点来自一次切身体会：可以努力卖上两年，仍没摸到市场真正想要的东西。
bio.en: Rob wrote The Power of Pull and publishes The Physics of Startups. A founder who later advised over fifty early-stage companies, he draws on his own experience trying for two years to sell a product the market did not want.

episodeTitle.en: Inside the black box of AI: How AI models actually think | Emmanuel Ameisen (Anthropic)
episodeTitle.zh: 打开 AI 的黑箱：模型究竟怎样思考？｜Anthropic 的 Emmanuel Ameisen

bio.zh: Emmanuel Ameisen 在 Anthropic 研究模型可解释性，尝试观察 Claude 等语言模型内部的计算。此前他在 Stripe 和 Insight 从事应用机器学习。他关注的是，怎样用可检验的证据解释一次输出。
bio.en: Emmanuel researches model interpretability at Anthropic after working in applied machine learning at Stripe and Insight. He studies what evidence can support an explanation of how a model produced an answer.

episodeTitle.en: Why every company now needs to think and operate like a lab team | Josh Woodward (VP Google Labs)
episodeTitle.zh: 为什么每家公司现在都需要像实验室团队那样思考和运作？｜Google Labs 副总裁 Josh Woodward

bio.zh: Josh Woodward 负责 Google Labs、Gemini 应用和 AI Studio，在 Google 工作了十多年。他带的团队既孵化新想法，也负责把其中一些做成大规模产品，日常难题是何时给实验更多时间。
bio.en: Josh leads Google Labs, the Gemini app, and AI Studio. A longtime Google product leader, he oversees both early experiments and products that have to reach a large audience.

episodeTitle.en: OpenAI’s Head of ChatGPT: We’re entering a new era of AI (again) | Tibo Sottiaux
episodeTitle.zh: OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 负责人：我们又一次迈入了 AI 的新时代｜Tibo Sottiaux

bio.zh: Tibo Sottiaux 在 OpenAI 负责 ChatGPT 和 Codex，经历了 Codex、ChatGPT Work 和 Dots 的推出。他直接与用户交流，关注同一款产品如何兼顾快速问答和耗时更长的工作。
bio.en: Tibo leads ChatGPT and Codex at OpenAI. His teams have shipped Codex, ChatGPT Work, and Dots. He stays close to the user community as those products expand from quick answers to longer-running work.

episodeTitle.en: Molly Graham: The grief, burnout, and opportunity hiding inside the AI transition
episodeTitle.zh: Molly Graham：AI 转型中的失落、倦怠与潜藏的机会

bio.zh: Molly Graham 曾在 Google、Facebook、Quip 和陈扎克伯格基金会担任管理职务。录制时她经营管理者社区 Glue Club，并主持 TED 的 WorkLife。她长期陪伴快速成长团队里的个人处理职责变化和身份转换。
bio.en: Molly has held leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She runs Glue Club and hosts TED’s WorkLife, drawing on years of helping people navigate changes in organizational roles and identity.

episodeTitle.en: 90 minutes of unfiltered product advice from Snap and Discord’s product chief | Peter Sellis
episodeTitle.zh: Snap 与 Discord 产品负责人的 90 分钟坦诚建议｜Peter Sellis

bio.zh: Peter Sellis 是 Snapchat 第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，后来出任 Discord 产品负责人。受访时他已离开 Discord，正在两份工作之间，得以回头谈订阅、创作工具和产品经理的判断力。
bio.en: Snapchat’s first PM, Peter Sellis spent seven years there before leading product at Discord. Between roles at the time of the interview, he looks back on subscriptions, creation tools, and how product managers make decisions.

episodeTitle.en: How we built Grok Bot in a month | Roman Ugarte (SpaceXAI)
episodeTitle.zh: 我们如何在一个月内做出 Grok Bot｜SpaceXAI 的 Roman Ugarte

bio.zh: Roman Ugarte 是 Cursor 的早期员工，做过增长，后来参与孵化 Grok Bot 并负责其产品。他从少数内部用户开始观察，尤其关心大家愿意交给智能体哪些任务，以及在哪些环节仍想亲自掌握进度。
bio.en: An early Cursor employee with a growth background, Roman helped incubate Grok Bot and leads product for it. He pays particular attention to what users delegate and how much of an agent’s progress they actually want to see.

episodeTitle.en: Why companies are becoming a series of loops | Anish Acharya (a16z)
episodeTitle.zh: 为什么公司正在变成一连串的反馈循环？｜a16z 的 Anish Acharya

bio.zh: Anish Acharya 是 a16z 关注消费领域的普通合伙人。他创办过 SocialDeck 和 Snowball，两家公司分别被 Google 和 Credit Karma 收购。这段从创业、运营到投资的经历，也体现在他对分发和竞争优势的分析里。
bio.en: Anish is a general partner at a16z focused on consumer investing. Before investing, he founded SocialDeck and Snowball, acquired by Google and Credit Karma respectively. He approaches distribution as both an operator and an investor.

episodeTitle.en: AI’s third era: the rise of persistent AI coworkers | Tara Seshan (OpenAI’s product lead)
episodeTitle.zh: AI 的第三个时代：能持续与你共事的 AI 同事正在兴起｜OpenAI 产品负责人 Tara Seshan

bio.zh: Tara Seshan 在 OpenAI 负责 ChatGPT Work 等产品，与工程负责人 Andrew Ambrosino 共事。此前她是 Stripe 最早的五位产品经理之一。她经常把工具放进自己的工作日，借此发现演示和长期使用之间的差距。
bio.en: Tara leads product work on ChatGPT Work at OpenAI alongside engineering leader Andrew Ambrosino. An early Stripe PM, she puts the tools into her own working day to see what holds up beyond a demo.

episodeTitle.en: 84 minutes of enterprise sales alpha | Jen Abel
episodeTitle.zh: 84 分钟的企业销售实战心得｜Jen Abel

bio.zh: Jen Abel 是 JJellyfish 联合创始人，录制时担任 State Affairs 企业销售总经理。这是她第三次受访。她长期亲自参与企业交易，尤其关注内部支持者、试用证据和谈判节奏怎样推动签约。
bio.en: Jen co-founded JJellyfish and runs enterprise sales at State Affairs. In her third appearance, she draws on hands-on experience with internal champions, pilots, and negotiations.

episodeTitle.en: Chatbots are not the final interface: OpenAI’s Head of Design on what’s next | Ian Silber
episodeTitle.zh: 聊天机器人不会是最终的界面：OpenAI 设计负责人谈下一步｜Ian Silber

bio.zh: Ian Silber 在 OpenAI 负责产品设计，带队做过 ChatGPT 和 Codex 的使用体验。加入前，他曾在 Instagram 工作八年，也参与过新闻应用 Artifact。他关心怎样把新能力交给普通用户，而不让界面的复杂度跟着上涨。
bio.en: Ian leads product design at OpenAI across experiences including ChatGPT and Codex. He previously worked on Artifact and spent eight years at Instagram. A recurring concern is exposing new capabilities without making everyday use harder.

episodeTitle.en: The playbook for building high talent density teams | Adam Ward, Head of Talent at Cursor
episodeTitle.zh: 如何打造高人才密度的团队｜Cursor 人才负责人 Adam Ward

bio.zh: Adam Ward 创办过独立招聘与人才战略公司 Growth by Design。Cursor 收购该公司后，他出任人才负责人。他关心创始人愿意为招聘投入多少时间，也关心候选人从第一次见面起经历了什么。
bio.en: Adam founded Growth by Design, a recruiting and talent strategy firm acquired by Cursor. As Cursor’s head of talent, he focuses on founders’ investment in recruiting and on the experience candidates have throughout the process.

episodeTitle.en: This CPO regrets that product management exists | Tom Verrilli (CPO of Whatnot)
episodeTitle.zh: 这位首席产品官希望「产品管理」这个岗位从未出现过｜Whatnot 首席产品官 Tom Verrilli

bio.zh: Tom Verrilli 在 Whatnot 负责产品，此前担任 Twitch 首席产品官，也负责过 Twitter 的产品增长。他熟悉直播和交易平台，习惯顺着卖家与买家的完整行为检验一个功能的效果。
bio.en: Whatnot CPO Tom Verrilli previously led product at Twitch and product growth at Twitter. His experience with marketplaces and live video shapes how he examines a change from both the buyer’s and seller’s sides.

episodeTitle.en: Why AI is going vertical (again) | Dianne Penn (Anthropic)
episodeTitle.zh: 为什么 AI 又开始向垂直领域深入？｜Anthropic 的 Dianne Penn

bio.zh: Dianne Penn 于 2023 年成为 Anthropic 首位技术产品经理，录制时负责 AI 研究与 Labs 的产品工作。她参与了多代 Claude 模型和 Claude Code 等产品的交付，工作常在模型研究、真实任务与产品评测之间往返。
bio.en: Anthropic’s first technical PM, Dianne Penn joined in 2023 and leads product for AI Research and Labs. She has worked on successive Claude models and on products including Claude Code, connecting research with concrete user tasks.

episodeTitle.en: Why Netflix is betting on systems thinkers—not specialists—in the AI era | Elizabeth Stone (CPTO)
episodeTitle.zh: AI 时代，Netflix 为什么看重系统思考者，胜过专才？｜首席产品与技术官 Elizabeth Stone

bio.zh: Elizabeth Stone 在本期录制时是 Netflix 首席产品与技术官，负责工程、产品与设计。上次受访时她还是 CTO。横跨数据科学、技术和产品的经历，让她尤其关注一项局部优化会怎样影响整个观看体验。
bio.en: Elizabeth Stone oversees engineering, product, and design at Netflix. Previously its CTO, she brings experience across data science and product to questions about how a local change affects the viewing experience.

episodeTitle.en: Why the AI’s honeymoon is ending (and tech workers are feeling it) | Noam Segal
episodeTitle.zh: AI 的蜜月期为何正在结束（科技从业者已经感受到了）｜Noam Segal

bio.zh: Noam Segal 与 Lenny 共同主持科技从业者年度调查。两人曾在 Airbnb 搭档做用户研究；此后 Noam 在 Intercom、Twitter、Meta、Figma 等公司带过研究团队。他关心的是，人们怎样描述自己的工作，以及调查问题怎样影响我们听到的答案。
bio.en: Noam co-leads the annual Tech Worker Sentiment Survey with Lenny, his former research partner at Airbnb. He has led research teams at Intercom, Twitter, Meta, and Figma. He is particularly interested in how the wording of a question changes what researchers learn about work.

episodeTitle.en: The rise of taste, human authenticity and judgment in an AI world | Adam Mosseri (Head of IG)
episodeTitle.zh: 在AI世界中品味、人类真实性与判断力的崛起 | 亚当·莫塞里（Instagram负责人）

bio.en: Adam Mosseri is the Head of Instagram, leading a platform used by over three billion people monthly, and previously designed and led the early Facebook News Feed and its ranking algorithm.
bio.zh: Adam Mosseri 是 Instagram 负责人，领导着月活超过 30 亿人的平台，此前曾设计并主导 Facebook 早期动态消息（News Feed）及其排序算法。

episodeTitle.en: Why OpenAI is merging Codex and ChatGPT and the future of knowledge work | Andrew Ambrosino
episodeTitle.zh: 为什么 OpenAI 正在合并 Codex 和 ChatGPT？未来知识工作的走向 | 安德鲁·安布罗西诺

bio.en: Andrew Ambrosino is the product and engineering lead for the Codex app at OpenAI, which is quickly becoming a go-to tool for building products with AI.
bio.zh: Andrew Ambrosino 是 OpenAI Codex 应用的产品与工程负责人，该应用正迅速成为用 AI 构建产品的首选工具。

episodeTitle.en: What happens after coding is solved? | Fiona Fung (Claude Code & Cowork)
episodeTitle.zh: 编码问题解决后会发生什么？ | 冯丽芬（Claude Code & Cowork）

bio.en: Fiona Fung leads the teams behind Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, and is a 25-year engineering veteran who previously built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and founded Facebook Marketplace, which now drives over $100 billion in GMV a year.
bio.zh: Fiona Fung 在 Anthropic 领导 Claude Code 和 Cowork 背后的团队，是一位拥有 25 年经验的工程老将，此前在微软打造了 TypeScript 和 Visual Studio，并在 Facebook 创立了如今年 GMV 超 1000 亿美元的 Facebook Marketplace。

episodeTitle.en: The hidden pattern behind successful products | Mark Pincus (FarmVille, Words with Friends, & more)
episodeTitle.zh: 成功产品的隐藏模式 | 马克·平卡斯（《开心农场》《好友消消乐》等）

bio.en: Mark Pincus is the founder of Zynga, the social-gaming pioneer behind FarmVille, and a serial consumer-internet entrepreneur and investor.
bio.zh: 马克·平卡斯（Mark Pincus）是 Zynga 的创始人，即《FarmVille》背后的社交游戏先驱，也是一位连续消费互联网创业者与投资人。

episodeTitle.en: Tony Fadell: How to build real taste (and why AI makes it matter more)
episodeTitle.zh: 托尼·法德尔（Tony Fadell）：如何打造真正的品味（以及AI为何让它变得更重要）

bio.en: Tony Fadell is a legendary product creator who co-created the iPod, iPhone, and Nest Thermostat, was part of the legendary team at General Magic, holds 300+ patents, and authored Build.
bio.zh: Tony Fadell 是一位传奇产品创造者，他共同打造了 iPod、iPhone 与 Nest 恒温器，曾是 General Magic 传奇团队的一员，拥有 300 多项专利，并著有《Build》一书。

episodeTitle.en: The most rational take on AI you’ll hear this year
episodeTitle.zh: 今年你将听到的关于AI最理性的观点

bio.en: Benedict Evans is a long-time analyst (formerly in-house at a16z) and independent thinker who has tracked the most important shifts in tech and now writes about where the industry is heading.
bio.zh: Benedict Evans 是资深分析师（曾为 a16z 驻场分析师）和独立思想家，长期追踪科技行业最重要的变化，如今撰写关于行业走向的文章。

episodeTitle.en: AI predictions: Job markets, Codex beats Claude, and the death of org charts | Dan Shipper
episodeTitle.zh: AI预测：就业市场、Codex击败Claude，以及组织结构图的终结 | Dan Shipper

bio.en: Dan Shipper is co-founder and CEO of Every, a company at the bleeding edge of AI adoption, and returns to predict where AI and work are heading after his earlier correct call on Claude Code.
bio.zh: Dan Shipper 是 Every 的联合创始人兼 CEO，一家处于 AI 应用最前沿的公司，继此前准确预言 Claude Code 后，他再度做客预测 AI 与工作将走向何方。

episodeTitle.en: Why the next AI boom is physical AI | Caitlin Kalinowski (ex-OpenAI, Meta, Apple)
episodeTitle.zh: 下一场AI热潮将是物理AI | 凯特琳·卡利诺夫斯基（曾任OpenAI、Meta、苹果公司）

bio.en: Caitlin Kalinowski is a sought-after builder who has worked with legendary makers like Steve Jobs, Mark Zuckerberg, and Sam Altman, and is focused on robotics, manufacturing, and physical-world AI.
bio.zh: Caitlin Kalinowski 是一位备受追捧的构建者，曾与 Steve Jobs、Mark Zuckerberg、Sam Altman 等传奇人物共事，目前专注于机器人、制造和物理世界的 AI。

episodeTitle.en: How Anthropic, Costco, and Patagonia all build incorruptible companies  | Eric Ries
episodeTitle.zh: 人类中心主义、好市多和巴塔哥尼亚如何打造廉洁公司 | 埃里克·里斯

bio.en: Eric Ries is the author of The Lean Startup—the most influential startup book of the past 15 years—and now of Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad and How Great Companies Stay Great, on protecting what founders build.
bio.zh: Eric Ries 是《精益创业》（过去 15 年最具影响力的创业著作）的作者，如今又推出《Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad and How Great Companies Stay Great》，讲述如何守护创始人所建立的事业。

episodeTitle.en: AI era skills: Why cultivating agency matters more than job titles | Max Schoening (Notion)
episodeTitle.zh: AI时代技能：为何培养自主性比职位头衔更重要 | 马克斯·肖宁（Max Schoening，Notion）

bio.en: Max Schoenig is Head of Product at Notion, and has been a PM at Google, ran design at Heroku, and was an engineering and design leader at GitHub.
bio.zh: 马克斯·舍宁（Max Schoenig）是 Notion 的产品负责人，曾在 Google 任 PM、在 Heroku 领导设计，并在 GitHub 担任工程与设计领导。

episodeTitle.en: How to win when software is not a moat | Evan Spiegel (Snapchat CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: 当软件不再是护城河时如何取胜 | 埃文·斯皮格尔（Snapchat CEO）

bio.en: Evan Spiegel is the co-founder and CEO of Snap, the company behind Snapchat—one of the very few durable consumer social apps ever built, with over one billion monthly active users and more than $6 billion in annual revenue.
bio.zh: Evan Spiegel 是 Snap 的联合创始人兼 CEO；Snap 是 Snapchat 的母公司——Snapchat 是有史以来极少数真正长期存活的消费者社交应用之一，月活用户超 10 亿，年收入超 60 亿美元。

episodeTitle.en: How Anthropic’s product team moves faster than anyone else | Cat Wu (Head of Product, Claude Code)
episodeTitle.zh: Anthropic产品团队如何比任何人都更快行动 | 吴佳佳（Cat Wu，产品负责人）

bio.en: Cat Wu is Head of Product for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, at the center of how AI is changing the way products are built.
bio.zh: Cat Wu 是 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 与 Cowork 产品负责人，正处于 AI 改变产品构建方式的核心。

episodeTitle.en: Why half of product managers are in trouble | Nikhyl Singhal (Meta, Google)
episodeTitle.zh: 为何半数产品经理深陷困境 | 尼克尔·辛格尔（Meta、Google）

bio.en: Nikhyl Singhal is a veteran product executive who spent years at Meta and Google, served as CPO of Credit Karma, founded four companies, and now leads the leading communities for heads of product (Skip).
bio.zh: Nikhyl Singhal 是一位资深产品高管，曾长期任职于 Meta 和 Google，担任过 Credit Karma 的 CPO，是四家公司的创始人，如今运营着面向产品负责人与 CPO 的顶尖社区 Skip。

episodeTitle.en: Hard truths about building in the AI era | Keith Rabois (Khosla Ventures)
episodeTitle.zh: 关于AI时代构建的硬道理 | 基思·拉博伊斯（Khosla Ventures）

bio.en: Keith Rabois is a veteran operator and investor, part of the PayPal Mafia, and an early backer of Stripe, Palantir, Airbnb, YouTube, DoorDash, Ramp, and many others.
bio.zh: 基思·拉博伊斯（Keith Rabois）是一位资深运营者与投资人，属于"PayPal 黑帮"成员，并早期投资了 Stripe、Palantir、Airbnb、YouTube、DoorDash、Ramp 等数十家公司。

episodeTitle.en: Head of Growth (Anthropic): Anthropic is automating its own growth
episodeTitle.zh: 增长负责人（Anthropic）：Anthropic正在自动化自身的增长

bio.en: Amol Avasare is Head of Growth at Anthropic, which grew from $1 billion to over $19 billion in annual recurring revenue in roughly 14 months—one of the fastest growth runs in history.
bio.zh: Amol Avasare 是 Anthropic 的增长负责人，该公司在约 14 个月内将年度经常性收入从 10 亿美元增长到超过 190 亿美元，是史上增长最快的纪录之一。

episodeTitle.en: An AI state of the union: We’ve passed the inflection point & dark factories are coming
episodeTitle.zh: 《AI现状报告：我们已越过临界点，暗工厂即将来临》

bio.en: Simon Willison is a renowned engineer and one of the most useful voices on how AI is changing software and knowledge work; he co-created Django, coined 'prompt injection,' popularized 'AI slop' and 'agentic engineering,' and maintains 100+ open-source projects.
bio.zh: Simon Willison 是一位知名的工程师，也是关于“AI 如何改变软件与知识工作”最具实用价值的声音之一；他共同创造了 Django 框架、提出了“提示注入（prompt injection）”一词、普及了“AI slop”与“智能体工程（agentic engineering）”，并维护着 100 多个开源项目。

episodeTitle.en: From skeptic to true believer: How OpenClaw changed my life | Claire Vo
episodeTitle.zh: 从怀疑者到忠实信徒：OpenClaw如何改变我的生活 | 克莱尔·沃

bio.en: Claire Vo is a three-time chief product officer (Color, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly) and creator of ChatPRD, likely the most-used PM-specific AI product, which she builds nights and weekends.
bio.zh: Claire Vo 是三度首席产品官（Color、Optimizely、LaunchDarkly），也是 ChatPRD 的创造者——这大概是使用最广的 PM 专用 AI 产品，由她在业余时间打造。

episodeTitle.en: The art of influence: The single most important skill left that AI can’t replace | Jessica Fain
episodeTitle.zh: 影响力的艺术：AI无法替代的关键技能 | 杰西卡·费恩（Jessica Fain）

bio.en: Jessica Fain is a product leader who has held roles at Box, Slack, Brightwheel, and now Webflow, and who has become uniquely skilled at the art and science of influencing executives—arguably the highest-leverage skill for product leaders.
bio.zh: Jessica Fain 是一位产品负责人，曾在 Box、Slack、Brightwheel 任职，如今在 Webflow，她在“影响高管”这门艺术与科学上练就了独到的功力——这可以说是产品领导者杠杆率最高的技能。

episodeTitle.en: He's negotiated $1B+ in executive compensation. Here's his playbook. | Jacob Warwick
episodeTitle.zh: 他谈判了超过10亿美元的高管薪酬。这是他的谈判秘籍。| 雅各布·沃里克

bio.en: Jacob Warwick is a professional negotiator who works behind the scenes with senior tech execs, pro athletes, and celebrities to navigate complex comp, M&A, and enterprise-sales negotiations, having helped clients secure over $1 billion in additional compensation.
bio.zh: Jacob Warwick 是一位职业谈判专家，在幕后为科技高管、职业运动员和名人处理复杂的薪酬、并购与企业销售谈判，已帮助客户额外争取到超 10 亿美元的补偿。

episodeTitle.en: A behind-the-scenes interview with Lenny Rachitsky on building his newsletter and podcast
episodeTitle.zh: Lenny Rachitsky关于如何打造新闻通讯和播客的幕后访谈

bio.en: Michelle Rial is a writer, illustrator, and data journalist whose newsletter grew past a million subscribers, and author of books like Am I Overthinking This?
bio.zh: 米歇尔·里尔（Michelle Rial）是一位作家、插画师与数据新闻工作者，她的新闻通讯订阅者超过百万，并著有《我是不是想太多了？》（Am I Overthinking This?）等书。

episodeTitle.en: The real AI revolution isn’t software. It’s farms, mines, and trucks. | Qasar Younis
episodeTitle.zh: 真正的AI革命并非软件，而是农场、矿山和卡车。| Qasar Younis

bio.en: Qasar Younis is co-founder and CEO of Applied Intuition, a ~$15 billion company that adds AI to vehicles, mining rigs, construction equipment, and more, and is one of the most important under-the-radar AI companies in the world.
bio.zh: Qasar Younis 是 Applied Intuition 的联合创始人兼 CEO，这家估值约 150 亿美元的公司将 AI 应用于汽车、采矿设备、工程机械等领域，是全球最重要却低调隐秘的 AI 公司之一。

episodeTitle.en: The design process is dead. Here’s what’s replacing it. | Jenny Wen (head of design at Claude)
episodeTitle.zh: 设计流程已死。以下是取代它的东西。 | 温佳妮（Claude设计负责人）

bio.en: Jenny Wen leads design for Claude Cowork at Anthropic, and was previously director of design at Figma (leading the FigJam and Slides teams) and a designer at Dropbox, Square, and Shopify; she offers a glimpse of where the design profession is heading.
bio.zh: Jenny Wen 在 Anthropic 领导 Claude Cowork 的设计，此前是 Figma 的设计总监（领导 FigJam 和 Slides 团队），并在 Dropbox、Square 和 Shopify 担任设计师；她向我们展示了设计职业正走向何方。

episodeTitle.en: AI is critical for humanity’s survival: Cisco President on the AI revolution | Jeetu Patel
episodeTitle.zh: AI对人类生存至关重要：思科总裁谈AI革命 | 吉图·帕特尔

bio.en: Jeetu Patel is Chief Product Officer and President at Cisco, where he has led a remarkable internal transformation to make a traditionally slow enterprise giant operate in an AI-first way.
bio.zh: Jeetu Patel 是 Cisco 的首席产品官兼总裁，他在内部推动了一场显著的转型，让这家传统上偏慢的企业巨头以“AI 优先”的方式运作。

episodeTitle.en: Head of Claude Code: What happens after coding is solved | Boris Cherny
episodeTitle.zh: Claude Code负责人：编码问题解决后的挑战 | 鲍里斯·切尔尼

bio.en: Boris Cherny is Head of Claude Code at Anthropic, whose tool has transformed how software engineers work and become a major driver of Anthropic's growth.
bio.zh: Boris Cherny 是 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 负责人，该工具彻底改变了软件工程师的工作方式，也成为 Anthropic 增长的重要驱动力。

episodeTitle.en: OpenAI’s head of platform engineering on the next 12-24 months of AI | Sherwin Wu
episodeTitle.zh: OpenAI平台工程主管谈未来12-24个月AI发展 | 吴胜文

bio.en: Sherwin Wu is Head of Engineering for OpenAI's API and Developer Platform, giving him a uniquely broad view into the AI startup ecosystem since nearly every AI company integrates with OpenAI's APIs.
bio.zh: Sherwin Wu 是 OpenAI API 与开发者平台工程负责人，由于几乎每一家 AI 公司都接入 OpenAI 的 API，这让他对 AI 创业生态拥有极其独特而广博的视野。

episodeTitle.en: The rise of the professional vibe coder (a new AI-era job)
episodeTitle.zh: 专业编程代码员的崛起（AI时代的新兴职业）

bio.en: Lazar Jovanovic is the first official "vibe coding" engineer at Lovable, having built his role in public by shipping projects and teaching others to code with AI.
bio.zh: 拉扎尔·约万诺维奇（Lazar Jovanovic）是 Lovable 公司首位正式的"氛围编程"（vibe coding）工程师，他通过在公开场合持续构建项目、教他人用 AI 编程，把自己做成了这份工作。

episodeTitle.en: A child psychologist’s guide to working with difficult adults | Dr. Becky Kennedy
episodeTitle.zh: 儿童心理学家指导如何与难相处的成年人共事 | 贝基·肯尼迪博士（Dr. Becky Kennedy）

bio.en: Dr. Becky Kennedy is a clinical psychologist, author, and CEO of Good Inside, one of the most popular parenting platforms, applying attachment and resilience science to both kids and adults at work.
bio.zh: Dr. Becky Kennedy 是一位临床心理学家、作家，也是热门育儿平台 Good Inside 的 CEO，将依恋与韧性科学应用于孩子以及职场中的成年人。

episodeTitle.en: Marc Andreessen: The real AI boom hasn’t even started yet
episodeTitle.zh: 马克·安德森：真正的AI热潮尚未真正开启

bio.en: Marc Andreessen is the co-founder of Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and co-author of the Mosaic browser, and one of the most influential venture capitalists and thinkers on technology and AI.
bio.zh: 马克·安德森（Marc Andreessen）是安德森·霍洛维茨（a16z）风投公司的联合创始人、Mosaic 浏览器的联合开发者，也是最具影响力的科技与 AI 风险投资人和思想者之一。

episodeTitle.en: The surprising advice from a founder who built 2 unicorns | Jason Cohen (WP Engine)
episodeTitle.zh: 一位打造了两家独角兽企业的创始人给出的惊人建议 | 杰森·科恩（Jason Cohen，WP Engine）

bio.en: Jason Cohen is a four-time founder including two unicorns (one being WP Engine), a prolific writer on product and startups for over 20 years, and the author of the upcoming book Hidden Multipliers.
bio.zh: Jason Cohen 是一位四次创业、打造过两家独角兽（其中之一为 WP Engine）的创始人，二十多年来持续撰写关于产品与创业的文章，并即将出版新作《Hidden Multipliers》。

episodeTitle.en: How a Meta PM ships products without ever writing code | Zevi Arnovitz
episodeTitle.zh: Meta产品经理如何无需写代码就能交付产品 | 泽维·阿诺维茨

bio.en: Zevi Arnovitz is a PM at Meta (previously at Wix) who, despite having no technical background, learned to use Cursor and Claude Code to build real products entirely on his own.
bio.zh: Zevi Arnovitz 是 Meta 的产品经理（此前在 Wix），尽管没有技术背景，他却学会了用 Cursor 和 Claude Code 完全靠自己构建出真正的产品。

episodeTitle.en: How to show up in any room with a low heart rate: Silicon Valley’s missing etiquette playbook
episodeTitle.zh: 如何在任何场合保持冷静：硅谷缺失的社交礼仪指南

bio.en: Sam Lessin is a partner at Slow Ventures, former VP of Product at Facebook, and a two-time founder, who joined Lenny to talk about the surprisingly high-leverage skill of proper etiquette.
bio.zh: Sam Lessin 是 Slow Ventures 的合伙人、Facebook 前产品副总裁、两次创业者，他做客本期，聊的是一个出人意料却极具杠杆效应的技能：得体的社交礼仪。

episodeTitle.en: Why most AI products fail: Lessons from 50+ AI deployments at OpenAI, Google & Amazon
episodeTitle.zh: 《为何多数AI产品失败：OpenAI、谷歌和亚马逊50余次AI部署的经验教训》

bio.en: Aishwarya Naresh Reganti and Kiriti Badam are AI product leaders who co-authored a widely-read guest post arguing that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software.
bio.zh: Aishwarya Naresh Reganti 与 Kiriti Badam 是 AI 产品负责人，他们合写了一篇广受关注的客座文章，论述构建 AI 产品与传统软件开发有本质区别。

episodeTitle.en: “I like being scared”: Molly Graham’s frameworks for rapid career growth | Molly Graham
episodeTitle.zh: “我喜欢被吓到”：莫莉·格雷厄姆的快速职业成长框架 | 莫莉·格雷厄姆

bio.en: Molly Graham is an operating executive who has worked with founder-CEOs like Mark Zuckerberg, Sheryl Sandberg, Larry Page, and Sergey Brin, and coined the "give away your Legos" framework.
bio.zh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆（Molly Graham）是一位运营高管，曾与马克·扎克伯格、谢丽尔·桑德伯格、拉里·佩奇、谢尔盖·布林等创始人型 CEO 共事，并首创了"交出你的乐高"（give away your Legos）框架。

episodeTitle.en: “I deliberately understaff every project” | Leadership lessons from Rippling’s $16B journey
episodeTitle.zh: “我故意让每个项目的人手不足” | 来自Rippling 160亿美元征程的领导力启示

bio.en: Matt MacInnis is the Chief Product Officer at Rippling, where he previously served as COO, and is known for his philosophy that extraordinary results require extraordinary effort.
bio.zh: 马特·麦金尼斯（Matt MacInnis）是 Rippling 的首席产品官，此前担任该公司 COO，以"非凡成果需要非凡投入"的理念而闻名。

episodeTitle.en: Why securing AI is harder than anyone expected and guardrails are failing | HackAPrompt CEO
episodeTitle.zh: 为何保障AI安全比任何人预期的都困难，防护措施为何失效 | HackAPrompt首席执行官

bio.en: Sander Schulhoff is a leading researcher in adversarial robustness and AI red-teaming - the art of getting AI systems to do things they shouldn't - who runs the field's first and largest AI red-teaming competition and partners with frontier labs.
bio.zh: Sander Schulhoff 是对抗鲁棒性与 AI 红队（让 AI 系统做出不该做之事的艺术）领域的顶尖研究者，他运营着该领域首个也是规模最大的 AI 红队竞赛，并与前沿 AI 实验室合作。

episodeTitle.en: Inside OpenAI: 2026 is the year of agents, AI’s biggest bottleneck, and why compute isn’t the issue
episodeTitle.zh: OpenAI内部视角：2026年是智能体之年，AI的最大瓶颈，以及为何计算资源不是问题

bio.en: Alexander Embiricos leads work on Codex, OpenAI's coding agent, and views it as the beginning of an AI software-engineering teammate.
bio.zh: Alexander Embiricos 负责 OpenAI 编程智能体 Codex 的相关工作，并将其视为 AI 软件工程“队友”的开端。

episodeTitle.en: The $1B Al company training ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini on the path to responsible AGI | Edwin Chen
episodeTitle.zh: 价值100亿美元的AI公司训练ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini，踏上负责任的通用人工智能之路 | 陈宇轩

bio.en: Edwin Chen is the founder and CEO of Surge AI, the leading AI data company that powers training at every frontier AI lab and became the fastest company ever to reach $1 billion in revenue—bootstrapped, with under 100 people, and profitable from day one.
bio.zh: Edwin Chen 是 Surge AI 的创始人兼 CEO；Surge AI 是领先的 AI 数据公司，为每一家前沿 AI 实验室的训练提供支撑，并以最快速度在四年内依靠不到 100 人、零融资、自第一天起盈利的模式跻身十亿美元营收俱乐部。

episodeTitle.en: Why AI is disrupting traditional product management | Tomer Cohen (LinkedIn CPO)
episodeTitle.zh: 《为什么人工智能正在颠覆传统产品管理 | 托默·科恩（领英首席产品官）》

bio.en: Tomer Cohen is LinkedIn's longtime Chief Product Officer, piloting the 'Full Stack Builder' program that lets anyone take products from idea to launch regardless of function.
bio.zh: Tomer Cohen 是 LinkedIn 任职已久的首席产品官（CPO），他正在推行“全栈构建者（Full Stack Builder）”计划，让任何人无论职能都能将产品从想法推进到上线。

episodeTitle.en: What world-class GTM looks like in 2026 | Jeanne DeWitt Grosser (Vercel, Stripe, Google)
episodeTitle.zh: 《2026年世界级GTM的模样》 | 珍妮·德威特·格罗瑟（Jeanne DeWitt Grosser，Vercel、Stripe、Google）

bio.en: Jeanne Grosser is the COO of Vercel, where she oversees marketing, sales, customer success, revenue operations, and field engineering, and she previously built Stripe's earliest sales team from the ground up as its Chief Product Officer.
bio.zh: Jeanne Grosser 是 Vercel 的首席运营官（COO），负责市场营销、销售、客户成功、营收运营和现场工程；此前她曾在 Stripe 担任首席产品官，从零搭建起 Stripe 最早的销售团队。

episodeTitle.en: A guide to difficult conversations, building high-trust teams, and designing a life you love
episodeTitle.zh: 《艰难对话指南：如何建立高度信任的团队，设计理想生活》

bio.en: Rachel Lockett is an executive coach and former longtime HR leader at Pinterest and at Stripe who helps CEOs, founders, and tech leaders with emotional intelligence, resilience, and building trusted, accountable teams.
bio.zh: Rachel Lockett 是一位高管教练，也曾长期担任 Pinterest 与 Stripe 的人力资源负责人，她帮助 CEO、创始人和科技领导者提升情商、韧性，并打造值得信赖、各负其责的团队。

episodeTitle.en: Mental models for building products people love ft. Stewart Butterfield
episodeTitle.zh: 打造人们喜爱的产品的心智模型，嘉宾斯图尔特·巴特菲尔德（Stewart Butterfield）

bio.en: Stewart Butterfield is a legendary founder who created Flickr and Slack (sold to Salesforce in one of tech's biggest deals), known for deep product, craft, and taste.
bio.zh: Stewart Butterfield 是一位传奇创始人，他创造了 Flickr 和 Slack（被 Salesforce 以科技圈最大交易之一收购），以深厚的产品功力、工艺与品味著称。

episodeTitle.en: The Godmother of AI on jobs, robots & why world models are next | Dr. Fei-Fei Li
episodeTitle.zh: 人工智能教母谈就业、机器人及为何世界模型是下一个风口 | 李飞飞博士（Dr. Fei-Fei Li）

bio.en: Dr. Fei-Fei Li, known as the “godmother of AI,” sparked the deep-learning revolution with ImageNet and now works on world models, including launching the large world model “Marble.”
bio.zh: 被誉为“AI 教母”的李飞飞（Dr. Fei-Fei Li）以 ImageNet 点燃了深度学习革命，如今致力于世界模型，并发布了大型世界模型 “Marble”。

episodeTitle.en: “Dumbest idea I’ve heard” to $100M ARR: Inside the rise of Gamma | Grant Lee (co-founder)
episodeTitle.zh: “我听过最愚蠢的主意”到1亿美元年营收：Gamma崛起记 | 格兰特·李（联合创始人）

bio.en: Grant Lee is the co-founder and CEO of Gamma, the profitable AI-powered presentation and website design tool that reached $100M ARR in just over two years with a ~30-person team and is valued at over $2 billion.
bio.zh: Grant Lee 是 Gamma 的联合创始人兼 CEO；Gamma 是一款盈利的 AI 演示与网站设计工具，仅用 30 人左右的团队在两年多内达到 1 亿美元 ARR，估值超 20 亿美元。

episodeTitle.en: $1M to $10M: The enterprise sales playbook with Jen Abel
episodeTitle.zh: 从100万到1000万美元：与珍·阿贝尔探讨企业销售攻略

bio.en: Jen Abel is co-founder of JJELLYFISH, where she helps early-stage founders learn to sell, and now GM of Enterprise at a high-growth company; this episode is the tactical follow-up to her first, on going from ~$1M to ~$10M ARR in enterprise sales.
bio.zh: Jen Abel 是 JJELLYFISH 的联合创始人，帮助早期创始人学会销售，如今在某高成长公司担任企业业务 GM；这期节目是她首期节目（如何从 0 到 100 万美元 ARR 的创始人式销售）的战术续集，聚焦如何从约 100 万做到约 1000 万美元 ARR 的企业销售。

episodeTitle.en: She turned 100+ rejections into a $42B company | Melanie Perkins
episodeTitle.zh: 《她将100多次拒绝转化为价值420亿美元的公司 | 梅兰妮·珀金斯》

bio.en: Melanie Perkins is the co-founder and CEO of Canva, the design platform valued at over $42 billion, on track to be one of the most successful founders in tech history.
bio.zh: 梅兰妮·珀金斯（Melanie Perkins）是 Canva 的联合创始人兼 CEO，这家设计平台估值超过 420 亿美元，有望成为科技史上最成功的创始人之一。

episodeTitle.en: How Block is becoming the most AI-native enterprise in the world | Dhanji R. Prasanna
episodeTitle.zh: Block如何正成为全球最具AI原生性的企业 | 丹吉·R·普拉萨纳（Dhanji R. Prasanna）

bio.en: Dhanji R. Prasanna leads applied AI efforts and open-source agents at a major AI lab, where internal tools like their “Goose” agent are saving employees 8–10 hours a week.
bio.zh: Dhanji R. Prasanna 在一家顶级 AI 实验室领导应用 AI 与开源智能体工作，其内部工具（如开源智能体 “Goose”）每周为员工节省 8–10 小时。

episodeTitle.en: Al Engineering 101 with Chip Huyen (Nvidia, Stanford, Netflix)
episodeTitle.zh: Al工程入门：与奇普·许（Chip Huyen，Nvidia、斯坦福大学、Netflix）对话

bio.en: Chip Huyen is an AI expert, author of Designing Machine Learning Systems, and founder focused on helping companies build great AI products, with deep experience in ML fundamentals and production.
bio.zh: Chip Huyen 是一位 AI 专家、《设计机器学习系统》（Designing Machine Learning Systems）作者，也是致力于帮助企业打造优秀 AI 产品的创始人，在机器学习基础与生产化方面有深厚经验。

episodeTitle.en: How to measure AI developer productivity in 2025 | Nicole Forsgren
episodeTitle.zh: 2025年如何衡量AI开发者生产力 | 妮可·福斯格伦

bio.en: Nicole Forsgren is the leading expert on developer productivity and author of Accelerate, who now researches how AI is changing how engineering teams work.
bio.zh: 妮可·福斯格伦（Nicole Forsgren）是开发者生产力领域的顶尖专家、《Accelerate》一书的作者，如今研究 AI 如何改变工程团队的工作方式。

episodeTitle.en: Figma’s CEO: Why AI makes design, craft, and quality the new moat for startups | Dylan Field
episodeTitle.zh: Figma首席执行官：为何人工智能让设计、工艺和质量成为初创公司的新护城河 | Dylan Field

bio.en: Dylan Field is the co-founder and CEO of Figma, the collaborative design tool used by virtually every product team in the world, and is now leading the company's push into AI-native product building with Figma Make.
bio.zh: Dylan Field 是 Figma 的联合创始人兼 CEO；Figma 是全球几乎每个产品团队都在使用的协作设计工具，他目前正带领公司借助 Figma Make 进军 AI 原生产品构建领域。

episodeTitle.en: Inside Google's AI turnaround: AI Mode, AI Overviews, and vision for AI-powered search | Robby Stein
episodeTitle.zh: 谷歌AI转型内幕：AI模式、AI概览及AI驱动搜索愿景 | 罗比·斯坦

bio.en: Robby Stein is VP of Product for Google Search, responsible for the entire search experience including AI Overviews, AI Mode, Google Lens, and the ranking algorithm, and previously led the launch of Instagram Stories, Reels, and Close Friends as Head of Product at Instagram.
bio.zh: Robby Stein 是 Google 搜索的产品副总裁，负责包括 AI Overviews、AI Mode、Google Lens 与排序算法在内的整个搜索体验，此前作为 Instagram 产品负责人主导推出了 Stories、Reels 与 Close Friends。

episodeTitle.en: Scale AI CEO on Meta’s $14B deal, scaling Uber Eats to $80B, & what frontier labs are building next
episodeTitle.zh: Scale AI CEO谈元宇宙140亿美元交易、Uber Eats如何扩张至800亿美元，以及前沿实验室的未来方向

bio.en: Jason Droege is the CEO of Scale AI—his first interview since succeeding founder Alexandr Wang after the Meta deal—and previously co-founded Uber Eats, which grew into a multi-billion-dollar business that helped save Uber during the pandemic.
bio.zh: Jason Droege 是 Scale AI 的 CEO——这是他接替创始人 Alexandr Wang（赴 Meta 后）后的首次采访，他此前联合创办了 Uber Eats，将其发展为价值数十亿美元的业务，并在疫情期间拯救了 Uber。

episodeTitle.en: Finding hidden growth opportunities in your product | Albert Cheng (Duolingo, Grammarly, Chess.com)
episodeTitle.zh: 在产品中发现隐藏的增长机遇 | 阿尔伯特·程（Albert Cheng，Duolingo、Grammarly、Chess.com）

bio.en: Albert Cheng is one of the world's leading consumer growth leaders, having led growth and monetization at Duolingo, Grammarly, and Chess.com, where he applies an experiment-driven, user-value-focused approach to scaling beloved products.
bio.zh: Albert Cheng 是全球顶尖的消费增长领导者之一，曾在 Duolingo、Grammarly 和 Chess.com 主导增长与变现，用实验驱动、聚焦用户价值的方式规模化打造受人喜爱的产品。

episodeTitle.en: Why AI evals are the hottest new skill for product builders | Hamel Husain & Shreya Shankar
episodeTitle.zh: 为何AI评估是产品构建者最热门的新技能 | 哈梅尔·胡赛因 & 施瑞娅·尚卡尔

bio.en: Hamel Husain and Shreya Shankar are the leading voices on AI evals—Hamel a veteran ML engineer (formerly at GitHub and Airbnb) and Shreya a PhD researcher at Stanford—who teach the definitive online course that has trained over 2,000 PMs and engineers across 500 companies, including the teams at OpenAI and Anthropic.
bio.zh: Hamel Husain 与 Shreya Shankar 是 AI 评估（evals）领域最具代表性的声音——Hamel 是一位资深机器学习工程师（曾任职于 GitHub 和 Airbnb），Shreya 是斯坦福的博士研究员——他们开设的权威在线课程已培训超过 2000 名 PM 与工程师、覆盖 500 家公司，其中包括 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的团队。

episodeTitle.en: From managing people to managing AI: The leadership skills everyone needs now | Julie Zhuo
episodeTitle.zh: 从管理人到管理AI：当下每个人都需要的领导力技能 | 朱莉·卓

bio.en: Julie Zhuo is the co-founder and President of Sundial, a leadership and AI tooling company, and previously spent 13 years at Facebook rising from designer to VP of Product Design.
bio.zh: 朱莉·卓（Julie Zhuo）是 Sundial 公司的联合创始人兼总裁，该公司专注于领导力与 AI 工具；她此前在 Facebook 工作了 13 年，从设计师一路晋升为产品设计副总裁。

episodeTitle.en: Why experts writing AI evals is creating the fastest-growing companies in history | Brendan Foody
episodeTitle.zh: 为何AI评估专家正在创造史上增长最快的公司 | 布伦丹·福迪

bio.en: Brendan Foody is CEO and co-founder of Mercor, the fastest-growing company in history to reach $500M in revenue (in 17 months) and the youngest unicorn founder, building a marketplace for AI training labor.
bio.zh: Brendan Foody 是 Mercor 的 CEO 兼联合创始人，该公司是史上最快达到 5 亿美元收入（仅 17 个月）的公司，他也是最年轻的独角兽创始人，正在打造一个 AI 训练劳动力的市场。

episodeTitle.en: $46B of hard truths: Why founders fail and why you need to run toward fear | Ben Horowitz (a16z)
episodeTitle.zh: 《460亿美元的残酷真相：为何创始人会失败，以及为何你需要直面恐惧》 | 本·霍洛维茨（Ben Horowitz，a16z）

bio.en: Ben Horowitz is the co-founder of Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), one of the world's largest venture capital firms, and author of the New York Times bestsellers The Hard Thing About Hard Things and The CEO Within.
bio.zh: Ben Horowitz 是安德森·霍洛维茨（a16z）的联合创始人，该公司是全球最大的风险投资机构之一，也是《创业维艰》（The Hard Thing About Hard Things）和《掌舵》（The CEO Within）等纽约时报畅销书作者。

episodeTitle.en: How we restructured Airtable's entire org for AI | Howie Liu (co-founder and CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: 我们如何为AI重组Airtable的整个组织 | 豪伊·刘（联合创始人兼CEO）

bio.en: Howie Liu is the co-founder and CEO of Airtable, the flexible low-code application platform, and is part of a wave of founders reinventing decade-old software businesses for the AI era.
bio.zh: Howie Liu 是 Airtable 的联合创始人兼 CEO；Airtable 是一款灵活的低代码应用平台，他也是将成立十余年的软件公司重新改造以迎接 AI 时代的创始人之一。

episodeTitle.en: How 80,000 companies build with AI: Products as organisms and the death of org charts | Asha Sharma
episodeTitle.zh: 8万家公司如何借助AI进行建设：产品如有机体，组织结构图已死 | 阿莎·夏尔马

bio.en: Asha Sharma is Corporate Vice President of AI Platform at Microsoft, leading the company's AI product strategy and platform, previously COO of Instacart and VP of Product & Engineering at Meta (Messenger, Instagram Direct).
bio.zh: Asha Sharma 是微软 AI 平台企业副总裁，领导公司的 AI 产品战略与平台，此前曾任 Instacart 首席运营官，以及 Meta（Messenger、Instagram Direct）产品与工程副总裁。

episodeTitle.en: Inside the expert network training every frontier AI model | Garrett Lord
episodeTitle.zh: 专家网络如何训练每一款前沿AI模型 | 加勒特·洛德

bio.en: Garrett Lord is the co-founder and CEO of Handshake, the 'LinkedIn for college students' used by every Fortune 500 company to hire graduates, who turned the platform's proprietary student network into a new AI training-data business that hit $50M ARR in four months.
bio.zh: Garrett Lord 是 Handshake 的联合创始人兼 CEO；Handshake 被称为“大学生的 LinkedIn”，每一家财富 500 强公司都用它来招聘毕业生。他把平台独有的学生网络变成了全新的 AI 训练数据业务，仅用四个月就达到了 5000 万美元 ARR。

episodeTitle.en: How Intercom rose from the ashes by betting everything on AI | Eoghan McCabe (founder and CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: Intercom如何从灰烬中崛起，押注一切于AI | Eoghan McCabe（创始人兼首席执行官）

bio.en: Eoghan McCabe is the co-founder and CEO of Intercom, the customer-service platform that he steered from a plateauing SaaS business into an AI-first company via its Fin AI agent, now on track to surpass $100 million in ARR.
bio.zh: Eoghan McCabe 是 Intercom 的联合创始人兼 CEO；他将这家客服平台从增长停滞的 SaaS 业务，通过 Fin AI 智能体转型为 AI 优先的公司，目前 Fin 的 ARR 正迈向 1 亿美元。

episodeTitle.en: Why ChatGPT will be the next big growth channel (and how to capitalize on it) | Brian Balfour
episodeTitle.zh: 《为什么ChatGPT将成为下一个重大增长渠道（以及如何从中获利）》|布莱恩·巴尔弗

bio.en: Brian Halligan is co-founder and longtime CEO of HubSpot and now the in-house CEO coach at Sequoia, where he brings top CEOs together and coaches them one-on-one.
bio.zh: Brian Halligan 是 HubSpot 的联合创始人兼长期 CEO，现任红杉资本的驻场 CEO 教练，将顶尖 CEO 们聚集一堂并一对一带教。

episodeTitle.en: The one question that saves product careers | Matt LeMay
episodeTitle.zh: 《那个挽救产品职业生涯的问题 | 马特·勒梅》

bio.en: Matt LeMay is a longtime product leader and author of Product Management in Practice, a practical guide used by hundreds of product teams.
bio.zh: 马特·勒梅（Matt LeMay）是一位资深产品负责人，也是实用指南《Product Management in Practice》的作者，该书被数百个产品团队使用。

episodeTitle.en: Inside ChatGPT: The fastest growing product in history  | Nick Turley (OpenAI)
episodeTitle.zh: 《深入ChatGPT：史上增长最快的产品》 | 尼克·特利（OpenAI）

bio.en: Nick Turley is the product lead for ChatGPT at OpenAI, having joined from Dropbox and Instacart, and helped turn a research project into the most consequential product in history.
bio.zh: 尼克·特利（Nick Turley）是 OpenAI 旗下 ChatGPT 的产品负责人，此前来自 Dropbox 和 Instacart，他帮助把一个研究项目变成了史上最具影响力的产品。

episodeTitle.en: Brian Chesky's secret mentor who scaled Airbnb (after dying 9 times & building a hotel empire)
episodeTitle.zh: 布莱恩·切斯基背后的“秘密导师”：如何将Airbnb扩展至全球（历经九次失败后建立酒店帝国）

bio.en: Chip Conley is a hospitality entrepreneur (founder of Joie de Vivre Hotels), former strategic advisor to Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky, founder of the Modern Elder Academy, and author on thriving at work as you age.
bio.zh: Chip Conley 是一位酒店业创业者（Joie de Vivre Hotels 创始人）、Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky 的前战略顾问、现代长者学院（Modern Elder Academy）创始人，也是关于“年长者在职场中茁壮成长”的作者。

episodeTitle.en: He saved OpenAI, invented the “Like” button, and built Google Maps: Bret Taylor (Sierra)
episodeTitle.zh: 他拯救了OpenAI，发明了“点赞”按钮，并打造了谷歌地图：Bret Taylor（Sierra）

bio.en: Bret Taylor is a legendary builder—co-creator of Google Maps, inventor of the Like button and real-time News Feed (sold to Facebook), former CTO of Facebook, co-CEO of Salesforce, and current co-founder/CEO of Sierra, an AI agent company, plus chairman of OpenAI's board.
bio.zh: Bret Taylor 是一位传奇构建者——Google Maps 联合创造者、Like 按钮与实时动态消息（卖给 Facebook）的发明者、Facebook 前 CTO、Salesforce 联席 CEO，现任 AI 智能体公司 Sierra 的联合创始人兼 CEO，并任 OpenAI 董事会主席。

episodeTitle.en: Pricing your AI product: Lessons from 400+ companies and 50 unicorns | Madhavan Ramanujam
episodeTitle.zh: 《为AI产品定价：400+家公司与50家独角兽的经验之谈 | 马德哈万·拉马努贾姆》

bio.en: Madhavan Ramanujam is one of the world's leading pricing and monetization strategists, a former managing partner at Simon-Kucher who has advised over 250 companies including 30 unicorns, author of Monetizing Innovation and its sequel Scaling Innovation, and now invests full-time in early-stage AI companies through his own fund.
bio.zh: Madhavan Ramanujam 是全球顶尖的定价与变现战略专家，曾任 Simon-Kucher 的管理合伙人，为包括 30 家独角兽在内的 250 多家公司提供顾问服务；他是《Monetizing Innovation》及其续作《Scaling Innovation》的作者，目前通过自己的基金全职投资早期 AI 公司。

episodeTitle.en: Anthropic co-founder: AGI predictions, leaving OpenAI, what keeps him up at night | Ben Mann
episodeTitle.zh: Anthropic联合创始人：AGI预测、离开OpenAI、让他夜不能寐的难题 | 本·曼（Ben Mann）

bio.en: Benjamin Mann is a co-founder of Anthropic, where he serves as tech lead for product engineering and focuses on aligning AI to be helpful, harmless, and honest.
bio.zh: Benjamin Mann 是 Anthropic 的联合创始人，担任产品工程技术负责人，专注于让 AI 做到有用、无害、诚实。

episodeTitle.en: The AI-native startup: 5 products, 7-figure revenue, 100% AI-written code. | Dan Shipper (Every)
episodeTitle.zh: 《AI原生初创公司：5款产品、7位数收入、100%AI编写代码》| Dan Shipper（Every）

bio.en: Dan Shipper is co-founder and CEO of Every, a 15-person company building four products at the bleeding edge of what's possible with AI, with a head of AI operations automating the team's workflows.
bio.zh: Dan Shipper 是 Every 的联合创始人兼 CEO，这家仅 15 人的公司在 AI 可能性的最前沿打造了四款产品，并设有 AI 运营负责人来自动化团队工作流。

episodeTitle.en: Rapidly test and validate any startup idea with the 2-day Foundation Sprint
episodeTitle.zh: 通过为期两天的基础冲刺，快速测试并验证任何初创想法

bio.en: Jake Knapp and John Zeratsky are the co-creators of the Design Sprint and authors of Sprint and Make Time; in this conversation they share the 'Foundation Sprint,' a framework (from their book Click) for founders to clarify and test a startup idea before building.
bio.zh: Jake Knapp 与 John Zeratsky 是“设计冲刺”（Design Sprint）的共同创造者，也是《Sprint》和《Make Time》的作者；在本期对话中，他们分享了“基础冲刺”（Foundation Sprint）——出自其著作《Click》的一个框架，帮助创始人在动手之前厘清并验证创业点子。

episodeTitle.en: I’ve run 75+ businesses. Here’s why you’re probably chasing the wrong idea. | Andrew Wilkinson
episodeTitle.zh: 我经营过 75 家以上的企业。以下是为什么你可能在追逐错误理念的原因。 | 安德鲁·威尔金森

bio.en: Andrew Wilkinson is co-founder and CEO of Tiny, a holding company often called the Berkshire Hathaway of the internet that owns over 40 businesses, and has started and run more companies than almost anyone.
bio.zh: Andrew Wilkinson 是 Tiny 的联合创始人兼 CEO，这家控股公司常被称为“互联网界的伯克希尔·哈撒韦”，旗下拥有 40 多家企业，他创办并运营过的公司数量几乎无人能及。

episodeTitle.en: Naming expert shares process for creating billion-dollar brands: Vercel, Azure, Windsurf, Sonos
episodeTitle.zh: 命名专家分享打造十亿美元品牌的流程：Vercel、Azure、Windsurf、Sonos

bio.en: David Placek is the founder of Lexicon Branding, the firm that pioneered the discipline of brand naming and created iconic names including BlackBerry, Pentium, Swiffer, and the Impossible Burger.
bio.zh: David Placek 是 Lexicon Branding 的创始人，该公司开创了品牌命名这门行当，并创造了包括 BlackBerry、Pentium、Swiffer 和 Impossible Burger 在内的标志性名称。

episodeTitle.en: From ChatGPT to Instagram to Uber: The quiet architect behind the world’s most popular products
episodeTitle.zh: 从ChatGPT到Instagram再到Uber：全球最受欢迎产品的幕后默默耕耘者

bio.en: Peter Deng is one of the most under-the-radar impactful product leaders in tech, having been VP of Product at OpenAI - where he oversaw ChatGPT Enterprise, voice, memory, and custom GPTs - and the first Head of Product at Instagram, plus leadership roles at Meta, Uber, and AOL.
bio.zh: Peter Deng 是科技圈最低调却最具影响力的产品领袖之一：曾任 OpenAI 产品副总裁（统管 ChatGPT Enterprise、语音、记忆与自定义 GPT），也是 Instagram 首任产品负责人，并曾在 Meta、Uber 和 AOL 担任领导职务。

episodeTitle.en: AI prompt engineering in 2025: What works and what doesn’t | Sander Schulhoff
episodeTitle.zh: 2025年AI提示工程：哪些有效，哪些无效 | 桑德·舒尔霍夫

bio.en: Sander Schulhoff is the OG prompt engineer - creator of the first prompt-engineering guide on the internet - who partnered with OpenAI on the first and largest AI red-teaming competition, HackAPrompt, and now works with frontier labs on model security.
bio.zh: Sander Schulhoff 是“元老级提示工程师（OG prompt engineer）”——互联网上第一份提示工程指南的创作者——他曾与 OpenAI 合作发起首个也是规模最大的 AI 红队竞赛 HackAPrompt，如今与前缘实验室合作研究模型安全。

episodeTitle.en: How to build a team that can “take a punch” | Hilary Gridley (Head of Core Product, Whoop)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何打造一支能“承受打击”的团队 | 希拉里·格里德利（Whoop公司核心产品负责人）

bio.en: Hilary Gridley is head of core product at Whoop and the author of the sixth most popular post ever in Lenny's newsletter, 'How to Become a Super Manager with AI'; she previously held product leadership roles at Big Health and Dropbox.
bio.zh: Hilary Gridley 是 Whoop 的核心产品负责人，也是 Lenny newsletter 史上第六受欢迎的文章《如何用 AI 成为超级管理者》（How to Become a Super Manager with AI）的作者；她此前曾在 Big Health 和 Dropbox 担任产品领导职务。

episodeTitle.en: 35 years of product design wisdom from Apple, Disney, Pinterest and beyond | Bob Baxley
episodeTitle.zh: 来自苹果、迪士尼、Pinterest等公司的35年产品设计智慧 | 鲍勃·巴克斯利

bio.en: Bob Baxley is a designer and executive who built and led design teams at Apple, Pinterest, Yahoo, and ThoughtSpot over a three-decade career, shaping products used by hundreds of millions.
bio.zh: Bob Baxley 是一位设计师和高管，在三十年的职业生涯中于 Apple、Pinterest、Yahoo 和 ThoughtSpot 构建并领导设计团队，塑造了数亿人使用的产品。

episodeTitle.en: Anthropic's CPO on what comes next | Mike Krieger (co-founder of Instagram)
episodeTitle.zh: Anthropic公司的首席产品官谈未来发展 | 迈克·克里格（Instagram联合创始人）

bio.en: Mike Krieger is the Chief Product Officer at Anthropic, maker of Claude, and the co-founder of Instagram, one of the most influential product thinkers in tech.
bio.zh: 迈克·克里格（Mike Krieger）是 Anthropic（Claude 的开发者）的首席产品官，也是 Instagram 的联合创始人，是科技界最具影响力的产品思考者之一。

episodeTitle.en: Growth tactics from OpenAI and Stripe’s first marketer | Krithika Shankarraman
episodeTitle.zh: OpenAI和Stripe首位营销人员的增长策略 | Krithika Shankarraman

bio.en: Krithika Shankarraman was the first marketing hire and VP of Marketing at OpenAI, the first marketing hire at Stripe, and an early marketing leader at Retool, Dropbox, and Android at Google; she is now an Executive in Residence at Thrive Capital advising founders on marketing.
bio.zh: Krithika Shankarraman 是 OpenAI 的首位市场负责人兼市场副总裁、Stripe 的首位市场负责人，也是 Retool、Dropbox 以及 Google Android 的早期市场领袖；她目前是 Thrive Capital 的驻场高管（Executive in Residence），为创始人提供市场方面的顾问支持。

episodeTitle.en: Unconventional product lessons from Binance, N26, Google, more | Mayur Kamat (CPO at N26)
episodeTitle.zh: 来自币安、N26、谷歌等公司的非传统产品经验 | 梅尤尔·卡马特（N26首席产品官）

bio.en: Mayur Kamat is the Chief Product Officer at N26, one of the world's top fintech startups, and was previously Global Head of Growth at Google and the first PM on Hangouts.
bio.zh: 马尤尔·卡马特（Mayur Kamat）是 N26 的首席产品官，N26 是全球顶尖的金融科技初创公司之一，他此前是 Google 的全球增长负责人、也是 Hangouts 的第一位 PM。

episodeTitle.en: Microsoft CPO: If you aren’t prototyping with AI you’re doing it wrong | Aparna Chennapragada
episodeTitle.zh: 微软首席产品官：如果你没有用AI做原型，那你就做错了 | 阿帕纳·陈纳普拉加达

bio.en: Aparna Chennapragada is Chief Product Officer at Microsoft overseeing AI product strategy for productivity tools and agents, previously CPO at Robinhood and a long-time VP at Google (Lens, Search, Shopping, AR).
bio.zh: Aparna Chennapragada 是微软首席产品官，负责生产力工具与智能体的 AI 产品战略，此前曾任 Robinhood 首席产品官，以及 Google 长期副总裁（负责 Lens、搜索、购物、AR 等）。

episodeTitle.en: How Revolut trains world-class PMs: The “Local CEO” model, raw intellect & building wow products
episodeTitle.zh: Revolut如何培养世界级的产品经理："本地CEO"模式、原始智力与打造惊艳产品

bio.en: Dmitry Zlokazov is Global Head of Product at Revolut, the $60B+ finance super app, known for hiring and incubating some of the best product managers in the industry.
bio.zh: Dmitry Zlokazov 是 Revolut 的全球产品负责人，Revolut 是一家估值超 600 亿美元的金融超级应用，以招聘和培养业内最优秀的产品经理而闻名。

episodeTitle.en: How Palantir built the ultimate founder factory | Nabeel S. Qureshi (founder, writer, ex-Palantir)
episodeTitle.zh: Palantir如何打造终极创始人工厂 | 纳比尔·S·库雷希（创始人、作家、前Palantir员工）

bio.en: Nabeel S. Qureshi is a writer, researcher, and engineer who studied AI policy at the Mercatus Center and documented Palantir's distinctive product-management model.
bio.zh: 纳比尔·S·库雷希（Nabeel S. Qureshi）是一位作家、研究员与工程师，曾在 Mercatus Center 研究 AI 政策，并系统记录过 Palantir 独特的产品管理模式。

episodeTitle.en: How have I been complicit in creating the conditions I say I don’t want? | Jerry Colonna
episodeTitle.zh: 我为何会默许自己创造了厌恶的环境？ | 杰瑞·科隆纳（Jerry Colonna）

bio.en: Jerry Colonna is one of the world's most respected executive coaches, co-founder and CEO of Reboot, and a former venture capitalist (Flatiron Partners) and author of Reboot and Reunion; he helps leaders do the inner work of becoming better humans.
bio.zh: Jerry Colonna 是全球最受尊敬的髙管教练之一，也是 Reboot 的联合创始人兼 CEO、前风险投资家（Flatiron Partners）以及《Reboot》《Reunion》的作者；他帮助领导者通过内在修炼成为更好的人。

episodeTitle.en: Inside Devin: The AI engineer that's set to write 50% of its company’s code this year | Scott Wu
episodeTitle.zh: 深入德文：这位AI工程师今年将为公司编写50%的代码 | 吴斯科特

bio.en: Scott Wu is co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the world's first autonomous AI software engineer that works like a remote engineer you collaborate with through Slack and a dedicated site.
bio.zh: Scott Wu 是 Cognition 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司打造了 Devin——全球首个自主式 AI 软件工程师，它像一个远程工程师，可通过 Slack 和专用网站与人协作。

episodeTitle.en: The rise of Cursor: The $300M ARR AI tool that engineers can’t stop using | Michael Truell
episodeTitle.zh: Cursor的崛起：这款年营收3亿美元的AR/AI工具让工程师爱不释手 | 迈克尔·特鲁尔

bio.en: Michael Truell is the co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, the company behind Cursor, the AI code editor that reached $100M ARR in about a year and a half.
bio.zh: 迈克尔·特鲁埃尔（Michael Truell）是 Anysphere 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司打造了 AI 代码编辑器 Cursor，约在一年半内达到 1 亿美元 ARR。

episodeTitle.en: Inside monday.com’s transformation: Radical transparency, impact over output, & the path to $1B ARR
episodeTitle.zh: monday.com内部转型启示：彻底透明、以影响力而非产出为导向，以及如何实现10亿美元年营收目标的路径

bio.en: Daniel Lereya is Chief Product and Technology Officer at Monday.com, having joined when the company was around 40 people and helped scale it to a public company with hundreds of thousands of customers.
bio.zh: Daniel Lereya 是 Monday.com 首席产品与技术官，在公司约 40 人时加入，助其扩展为拥有数十万客户的上市公司。

episodeTitle.en: Building a magical AI code editor used by over 1m developers in 4 months: Inside Windsurf
episodeTitle.zh: 如何在4个月内打造吸引超过100万开发者的神奇AI代码编辑器：Windsurf内部故事

bio.en: Varun Mohan is co-founder and CEO of Windsurf, a leading AI coding tool and main competitor to Cursor, which reached 1 million users within four months.
bio.zh: Varun Mohan 是 Windsurf 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Windsurf 是一款领先的 AI 编程工具、也是 Cursor 的主要竞争者，它在四个月内就达到了 100 万用户。

episodeTitle.en: Everyone’s an engineer now: Inside v0’s mission to create 100 million builders | Guillermo Rauch
episodeTitle.zh: 如今人人都是工程师：v0如何致力于培养1亿名创客 | 吉列尔莫·劳奇

bio.en: Guillermo Rauch is the founder and CEO of Vercel, whose AI website builder v0 is one of the most popular in the world, and a legendary open-source engineer behind frameworks like Next.js and Socket.IO.
bio.zh: Guillermo Rauch 是 Vercel 的创始人兼 CEO；其 AI 建站工具 v0 是全球最流行的同类产品之一，他也是 Next.js、Socket.IO 等开源框架背后的传奇工程师。

episodeTitle.en: OpenAI’s CPO on how AI changes must-have skills, moats, coding, startup playbooks, more | Kevin Weil
episodeTitle.zh: OpenAI首席产品官Kevin Weil解析AI如何重塑必备技能、护城河、编程、创业路径等 | Kevin Weil

bio.en: Kevin Weil is the Chief Product Officer of OpenAI, maker of ChatGPT, and has previously led product at Twitter, Meta's Novi, and Planet Labs.
bio.zh: 凯文·韦尔（Kevin Weil）是 OpenAI（ChatGPT 的开发者）的首席产品官，此前曾领导 Twitter、Meta 的 Novi 以及 Planet Labs 的产品。

episodeTitle.en: Become a better communicator: Specific frameworks to improve your clarity, influence, and impact
episodeTitle.zh: 成为更出色的沟通者：提升清晰度、影响力和成果的具体框架

bio.en: Wes Kao co-created the Alt-MBA with Seth Godin, co-founded Maven (live cohort-based courses), and now runs her own course on Executive Communication and Influence.
bio.zh: Wes Kao 与 Seth Godin 共同创造了 Alt-MBA，联合创立了 Maven（实时 cohort 制课程平台），如今运营着自己关于“高管沟通与影响力”的课程。

episodeTitle.en: A better way to plan, build, and ship products | Ryan Singer (creator of “Shape Up")
episodeTitle.zh: 规划、构建和交付产品的更佳之道 | 瑞安·辛格（Ryan Singer，“Shape Up”创始人）

bio.en: Ryan Singer is one of the first hires at 37signals and, through 17 years building Basecamp, authored Shape Up, a distinctive alternative approach to building software centered on appetites rather than deadlines.
bio.zh: Ryan Singer 是 37signals 最早的一批员工之一，在 17 年打造 Basecamp 的过程中写就了《Shape Up》——一种以“胃口（appetite）”而非截止日期为中心的、别具一格的软件开发方法。

episodeTitle.en: How to win in the AI era: Ship weekly, embrace technical debt, ruthlessly cut scope, and more
episodeTitle.zh: 如何在AI时代胜出：每周发布产品、接受技术债务、无情地缩减范围等

bio.en: Gaurav Misra is the co-founder and CEO of Captions, a leading consumer AI app for generating and editing talking videos with over 10 million users, and was previously an early employee at Snap who led its design engineering team.
bio.zh: Gaurav Misra 是 Captions 的联合创始人兼 CEO；Captions 是一款领先的消费级 AI 应用，可用 AI 生成和编辑口播视频，用户超 1000 万，他此前是 Snap 的早期员工并领导其设计工程团队。

episodeTitle.en: Superhuman's secret to success | Rahul Vohra (CEO and founder)
episodeTitle.zh: 《超人成功秘诀》| 拉胡尔·沃赫拉（CEO兼创始人）

bio.en: Rahul Vohra is the founder and CEO of Superhuman, the AI-powered email client, and a famously thoughtful and articulate builder who previously founded Rapportive, the first Gmail extension to scale to millions of users.
bio.zh: Rahul Vohra 是 AI 驱动电子邮件客户端 Superhuman 的创始人兼 CEO，也是一位以深思熟虑、表达清晰著称的构建者，此前曾创立首个规模化至数百万用户的 Gmail 插件 Rapportive。

episodeTitle.en: Inside Bolt: From near-death to one of the fastest-growing products in history | Eric Simons
episodeTitle.zh: Bolt内部视角：从濒临倒闭到史上增长最快的产品之一 | 埃里克·西蒙斯

bio.en: Eric Simons is the co-founder and CEO of StackBlitz, whose AI coding app Bolt became one of the fastest-growing products in history—hitting roughly $20M ARR within two months of launch and approaching $40M—after seven years of building the underlying WebContainer technology.
bio.zh: Eric Simons 是 StackBlitz 的联合创始人兼 CEO；其 AI 编程应用 Bolt 成为史上增长最快的产品之一——上线两个月即达到约 2000 万美元 ARR、并逼近 4000 万美元——而这建立在历时七年打磨的 WebContainer 底层技术之上。

episodeTitle.en: Building Lovable: $10M ARR in 60 days with 15 people | Anton Osika (CEO and co-founder)
episodeTitle.zh: 打造可爱的产品：15人团队60天内创收1000万美元年营收 | 安东·奥西卡（CEO兼联合创始人）

bio.en: Anton Osika is co-founder and CEO of Lovable, an AI engineer that turns an English prompt into a working product in minutes, and the fastest-growing startup in Europe's history.
bio.zh: Anton Osika 是 Lovable 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Lovable 是一个把英文提示词在几分钟内变成可用产品的 AI“软件工程师”，也是欧洲史上增长最快的创业公司。

episodeTitle.en: Notion's lost years, near collapse during COVID, staying small to move fast, building horizontal
episodeTitle.zh: Notion的迷失岁月、在新冠疫情期间濒临倒闭、保持小规模以快速发展、构建横向

bio.en: Ivan Zhao is the co-founder and CEO of Notion, the beloved all-in-one productivity and workspace tool used by millions, and a famously philosophical founder who rarely does interviews.
bio.zh: Ivan Zhao 是 Notion 的联合创始人兼 CEO；Notion 是一款被数百万人喜爱的“一体化”生产力与协作空间工具，他本人是一位以富有哲学思考著称、极少接受采访的创始人。

episodeTitle.en: Matt Mullenweg on the future of open source and why he’s taking a stand
episodeTitle.zh: 马特·马伦威格谈论开源的未来及他的立场

bio.en: Matt Mullenweg is the co-creator of WordPress, which powers about 40% of the internet, and the CEO of Automattic, the company behind WordPress.com, Tumblr, and WooCommerce.
bio.zh: 马特·穆伦韦格（Matt Mullenweg）是 WordPress 的联合创始人，该产品支撑了约 40% 的互联网，他也是 Automattic 的 CEO，该公司旗下有 WordPress.com、Tumblr 和 WooCommerce。

episodeTitle.en: An inside look at X’s Community Notes | Keith Coleman & Jay Baxter
episodeTitle.zh: X社区笔记内幕解析 | 基思·科尔曼与杰伊·巴克斯特

bio.en: Keith Coleman and Jay Baxter lead Community Notes at X (formerly Twitter), the crowdsourced system that adds context and flags misleading posts across the platform.
bio.zh: 基思·科尔曼（Keith Coleman）和杰伊·巴克斯特（Jay Baxter）负责 X（原 Twitter）的 Community Notes 功能，这是一个通过众包方式为帖子补充背景、标记误导信息的系统。

episodeTitle.en: How to find work you love | Bob Moesta (Jobs-to-be-Done co-creator, author of "Job Moves”)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何找到热爱的工作 | Bob Moesta（Jobs-to-be-Done框架联合创始人、《Job Moves》作者）

bio.en: Bob Moesta is co-creator of the Jobs-to-be-Done framework (with Clay Christensen) and author of Job Moves, focused on helping people find careers and jobs that truly fit them.
bio.zh: Bob Moesta 是与 Clay Christensen 共同创立“待办任务”（Jobs-to-be-Done）框架的人，也是《Job Moves》一书的作者，专注于帮助人们找到真正适合自己的职业与工作。

episodeTitle.en: A founder’s guide to crisis management | Uri Levine (Waze co-founder, serial entrepreneur)
episodeTitle.zh: 创始人危机管理指南 | 乌里·莱文（Waze联合创始人、连续创业者）

bio.en: Uri Levine is co-founder of Waze (and nine other companies), has sold two companies for over $1 billion, sits on 20 startup boards, and authored Fall in Love with the Problem, Not the Solution.
bio.zh: Uri Levine 是 Waze 的联合创始人（以及另外九家公司的创始人），曾将两家公司以超 10 亿美元售出，任职于 20 家初创公司董事会，并著有《爱上问题，而非方案》（Fall in Love with the Problem, Not the Solution）。

episodeTitle.en: OpenAI researcher on why soft skills are the future of work | Karina Nguyen
episodeTitle.zh: OpenAI研究员谈软技能为何是未来工作的核心 | 卡琳娜·阮

bio.en: Karina Nguyen is a research engineer at Anthropic, where she works on the cutting edge of building and improving Claude, and previously did front-end engineering.
bio.zh: 卡琳娜·阮（Karina Nguyen）是 Anthropic 的研究工程师，在构建与改进 Claude 模型的最前沿工作，此前从事前端工程。

episodeTitle.en: Tobi Lütke's leadership playbook: First principles, infinite games, and maximizing human potential
episodeTitle.zh: 托比·卢特克（Tobi Lütke）的领导力秘籍：第一性原理、无限游戏与最大化人类潜能

bio.en: Tobi Lutke is the co-founder and CEO of Shopify, one of the most respected operator-founders in tech, known for first-principles, infinite-game thinking.
bio.zh: Tobi Lutke 是 Shopify 的联合创始人兼 CEO，是科技圈最受尊敬、以“运营者—创始人”著称的人物之一，以其第一性原理、无限游戏式的思维闻名。

episodeTitle.en: Linear’s secret to building beloved B2B products | Nan Yu (Head of Product)
episodeTitle.zh: Linear打造备受喜爱的B2B产品的秘诀 | 余南（Nan Yu，产品负责人）

bio.en: Nan Yu is a product leader at Linear known for the team's belief that there is no trade-off between speed and quality when people are truly competent.
bio.zh: 南宇（Nan Yu）是 Linear 的产品负责人，以团队"在真正有能力的状态下，速度与质量之间并无折中"的信念而闻名。

episodeTitle.en: An operator’s guide to product strategy | Chandra Janakiraman (CPO at VRChat, ex-Meta, Headspace)
episodeTitle.zh: 《产品战略操作指南》 | 钱德拉·贾纳基拉曼（Chandra Janakiraman，VRChat首席产品官，前Meta、Headspace高管）

bio.en: Chandra Janakiraman is Chief Product Officer and EVP at VRChat, formerly a product leader at Meta, CPO at Headspace, GM at Zynga, and senior PM at Amazon.
bio.zh: Chandra Janakiraman 是 VRChat 首席产品官兼执行副总裁，曾任 Meta 产品负责人、Headspace 首席产品官、Zynga 总经理，以及亚马逊高级产品经理。

episodeTitle.en: 10 growth tactics that never work | Elena Verna (Amplitude, Miro, Dropbox, SurveyMonkey)
episodeTitle.zh: 十种永远行不通的增长策略 | 埃琳娜·维尔纳（曾任Amplitude、Miro、Dropbox、SurveyMonkey等公司增长负责人）

bio.en: Elena Verna is the Head of Growth at Lovable, the AI vibe-coding platform that surpassed $200 million in ARR within roughly a year of launch with a team of about 100 people.
bio.zh: Elena Verna 是 Lovable 的增长负责人，Lovable 是一个 AI vibe coding 平台，在发布约一年内、以约 100 人的团队实现了超过 2 亿美元的年度经常性收入（ARR）。

episodeTitle.en: How to break out of autopilot and create the life you want | Graham Weaver (Stanford GSB professor)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何摆脱自动驾驶模式，创造理想生活 | 格雷厄姆·威弗（斯坦福商学院教授）

bio.en: Graham Weaver teaches a top-rated course at Stanford's Graduate School of Business and is the founder and CEO of Alpine Investors, one of the world's top-performing private equity firms; he helps people get off 'autopilot' and figure out what to do with their lives.
bio.zh: Graham Weaver 在斯坦福商学院开设一门高评分课程，同时是 Alpine Investors（全球表现最顶尖的私募股权基金之一）的创始人兼 CEO；他帮助人们摆脱“自动驾驶模式”，想清楚自己这辈子该做什么。

episodeTitle.en: Behind the founder: Drew Houston (Dropbox)
episodeTitle.zh: 创始人背后的故事：德鲁·休斯顿（Drew Houston，Dropbox）

bio.en: Drew Houston is co-founder and CEO of Dropbox, which he's built over 18 years through three eras—hypergrowth, attacks from Big Tech incumbents, and a painful reinvention toward productivity.
bio.zh: Drew Houston 是 Dropbox 联合创始人兼 CEO，18 年来他将公司经历了三个时代——超高速增长、来自科技巨头的围剿，以及痛苦地向生产力方向重塑。

episodeTitle.en: Scripts for navigating difficult conversations | Alisa Cohn (executive coach)
episodeTitle.zh: 应对艰难对话的剧本 | 阿莉莎·科恩（Alisa Cohn，执行教练）

bio.en: Alisa Cohn is an executive coach who has worked with C-suite leaders at startups like Etsy, Venmo, and DraftKings as well as Fortune 500s like Microsoft and Google, and has been named one of the world's top startup coaches.
bio.zh: Alisa Cohn 是一位高管教练，曾辅导 Etsy、Venmo、DraftKings 等初创公司以及微软、谷歌等世界 500 强企业的高管，被誉为全球顶尖的初创公司教练之一。

episodeTitle.en: Why great AI products are all about the data | Shaun Clowes (CPO at Confluent)
episodeTitle.zh: 优秀的AI产品为何都离不开数据 | 肖恩·克洛斯（Confluent首席产品官）

bio.en: Shaun Clowes is Chief Product Officer at Confluent, previously CPO at MuleSoft (a billion-dollar business within Salesforce), CPO at Metromile, and a six-year Atlassian veteran who built the first-ever B2B growth team and created two popular Reforge courses.
bio.zh: Shaun Clowes 是 Confluent 的首席产品官（CPO），此前曾任 MuleSoft（Salesforce 内部一家十亿美元级企业）的 CPO、Metromile 的 CPO，并在 Atlassian 任职六年，打造了史上首个 B2B 增长团队，还创建了两门广受欢迎的 Reforge 课程。

episodeTitle.en: Behind the founder: Marc Benioff
episodeTitle.zh: 创始人背后的故事：马克·贝尼奥夫

bio.en: Marc Benioff is the founder, chairman, and CEO of Salesforce, the cloud CRM pioneer he started in 1999 that grew into one of the world's largest enterprise software companies.
bio.zh: 马克·贝尼奥夫（Marc Benioff）是 Salesforce 的创始人、董事长兼 CEO，这家云 CRM 先驱公司始于 1999 年，已成长为全球最大的企业软件公司之一。

episodeTitle.en: How Shopify builds a high-intensity culture | Farhan Thawar (VP and Head of Eng)
episodeTitle.zh: Shopify如何打造高强度文化 | 法尔汉·塔瓦尔（VP兼工程总监）

bio.en: Farhan Thawar is Vice President and Head of Engineering at Shopify, where he helps run a 10,000-person fully-remote engineering organization known for its urgency, velocity, and first-principles thinking.
bio.zh: Farhan Thawar 是 Shopify 的工程副总裁兼工程负责人，管理着一支 1 万人、完全远程的工程组织，该组织以紧迫感、高速执行和第一性原理式的思考著称。

episodeTitle.en: Behind the product: Duolingo streaks | Jackson Shuttleworth (Group PM, Retention Team)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品背后的故事：Duolingo的学习连胜 | 杰克逊·沙特尔沃斯（Group PM，留存团队）

bio.en: Jackson Shuttleworth is a group product manager at Duolingo, where he leads the retention team and owns the streaks feature—arguably the single most impactful driver of Duolingo's growth into a $14B business.
bio.zh: Jackson Shuttleworth 是 Duolingo 的集团产品经理，领导留存团队并负责“连续打卡”（streaks）功能——这可以说是推动 Duolingo 成长为 140 亿美元公司的最具影响力的单一功能。

episodeTitle.en: Seth Godin's best tactics for building remarkable products, strategies, brands and more
episodeTitle.zh: 赛斯·戈丁（Seth Godin）打造卓越产品、战略、品牌等的绝佳策略

bio.en: Seth Godin is a marketer, teacher, entrepreneur, and author of more than 20 books, including Purple Cow, Permission Marketing, and Linchpin.
bio.zh: 赛斯·戈丁（Seth Godin）是营销思想家、教育者和创业者，著有《紫牛》《许可营销》《支点》等 20 余部作品，并通过长期写作持续影响人们对营销、品牌、产品与改变的理解。

episodeTitle.en: How a great founder becomes a great CEO | Jonathan Lowenhar (co-founder of Enjoy The Work)
episodeTitle.zh: 伟大创始人如何成为卓越CEO | 乔纳森·洛文哈尔（Enjoy The Work联合创始人）

bio.en: Jonathan Lowenhar runs Enjoy The Work, a firm whose singular mission is to help founders become great CEOs, through mentoring and advising rooted in the study of how the best startups operate.
bio.zh: Jonathan Lowenhar 经营着 Enjoy The Work，这家公司唯一的使命是帮助创始人成为杰出的 CEO，其辅导与咨询建立在“研究最优秀初创公司如何运作”之上。

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to founder-led sales | Jen Abel (co-founder of JJELLYFISH)
episodeTitle.zh: 创始人主导销售的终极指南 | 珍·阿贝尔（JJELLYFISH联合创始人）

bio.en: Jen Abel is the co-founder of Jellyfish (JJELLYFISH), where she and her team help early-stage founders learn how to sell, do customer discovery, and build a repeatable sales motion; this episode is an ultra-tactical guide to founder-led sales from zero to one.
bio.zh: Jen Abel 是 Jellyfish（JJELLYFISH）的联合创始人，她和团队帮助早期创始人学习如何销售、做客户探索并建立起可复制的销售动作；这期节目是关于从 0 到 1 的“创始人式销售”的极致实战指南。

episodeTitle.en: Behind the product: Replit | Amjad Masad (co-founder and CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品背后的故事：Replit | 阿米贾德·马萨德（联合创始人兼CEO）

bio.en: Amjad Masad is the co-founder of Replit, an AI-powered platform for building and shipping software with over 34 million users, on a mission to make creating software dramatically easier.
bio.zh: Amjad Masad 是 Replit 的联合创始人，这是一个拥有超 3400 万用户的 AI 软件开发与部署平台，使命是让创建软件变得容易得多。

episodeTitle.en: Building Wiz: The fastest-growing startup in history | Raaz Herzberg (CMO & VP Product Strategy)
episodeTitle.zh: Building Wiz：史上发展最快的初创公司 | 拉兹·赫茨伯格（CMO兼产品战略副总裁）

bio.en: You're one of the first 10 employees, you're the first product manager. It was when you joined, the founders didn't really have an idea figured out yet. When they landed on an idea, and then ended up being wrong, ended up not working. Six weeks after you joined, there was a pivot.
bio.zh: 你是前10名员工之一，是首位产品经理。当时你加入时，创始人们还没有想清楚主意。他们确定了一个想法，结果却发现方向错误，最终失败了。你加入六周后，公司进行了转型。

episodeTitle.en: Everything you’ve ever wanted to know about SAFe and the product owner role | Melissa Perri
episodeTitle.zh: 关于SAFe和产品负责人的角色，你想知道的一切 | 梅利莎·佩里

bio.en: Melissa is a product leader and guest on Lenny's podcast discussing product management, company building, and team leadership.
bio.zh: 梅丽莎（Melissa）是一位产品负责人，作为嘉宾做客 Lenny 的播客，探讨产品管理、公司建设与团队领导等话题。

episodeTitle.en: Breaking the rules of growth: Why Shopify bans KPIs, optimizes for churn, and prioritizes intuition
episodeTitle.zh: 打破增长规则：为何Shopify禁用KPI、优化客户流失并优先考虑直觉

bio.en: Archie Abrams is VP of Product and Head of Growth at Shopify, leading a 600+ person org (product, design, engineering, data ops, growth marketing) and formerly a long-time leader at Udemy; he turned Shopify's "build a 100-year company" long-termism, its long-horizon holdout experiments, and its use of absolute numbers over conversion rates into an operational growth practice.
bio.zh: Archie Abrams 是 Shopify 的产品 VP 兼增长负责人，领导一个 600 多人的组织（产品、设计、工程、数据运营、增长营销），曾长期任职于 Udemy；他把 Shopify「为 100 年建公司」的长期主义、用长期 holdout 实验衡量真实影响、以及用绝对数而非转化率做增长指标的方法，变成了可执行的增长实践。

episodeTitle.en: 4 questions Shreyas wishes he’d asked himself sooner | Former PM leader at Stripe, Twitter, Google
episodeTitle.zh: 施雷亚斯希望自己能早点问自己的4个问题 | 曾任Stripe、Twitter、Google产品经理的领导者

bio.en: Shreyas Doshi is a product leader and one of today's most consistently insightful voices on the craft of product management, drawing on senior product roles at Google, Twitter, Yahoo, and Stripe; this is a live-recorded edition of his conversation.
bio.zh: Shreyas Doshi 是一位产品领导者，也是当下对产品管理手艺最具持续洞察力的声音之一，其经验来自在 Google、Twitter、Yahoo 和 Stripe 的高级产品职务；本期为其对话的现场录制版。

episodeTitle.en: Meta’s head of product on working with Mark Zuckerberg, early growth tactics, and more | Naomi Gleit
episodeTitle.zh: Meta产品主管谈与马克·扎克伯格共事、早期增长策略等 | 娜奥米·格莱特

bio.en: Naomi Gleit is Head of Product at Meta and, apart from Mark Zuckerberg, the longest-serving executive, having joined as employee #29 and scaled the company for nearly 20 years.
bio.zh: 娜奥米·格莱特（Naomi Gleit）是 Meta 的产品负责人，除马克·扎克伯格外任职最久的高管，她以第 29 号员工身份加入，伴随公司成长近 20 年。

episodeTitle.en: How to see like a designer: The hidden power of typography and logos | Jessica Hische
episodeTitle.zh: 如何像设计师一样思考：字体与标志的隐藏力量 | 杰西卡·希舍（Jessica Hische）

bio.en: Jessica Hische is a renowned custom typographer and lettering artist (and bestselling children's book author) whose work—logos for Mailchimp, Eventbrite, Philz Coffee, and more—has shaped how a generation thinks about brand and craft.
bio.zh: Jessica Hische 是一位知名的定制字体与字母设计艺术家（也是畅销童书作者），她的作品——为 Mailchimp、Eventbrite、Philz Coffee 等设计的标志——塑造了一代人对于品牌与工艺的认知。

episodeTitle.en: Becoming more strategic, navigating difficult colleagues, founder mode, more | Anneka Gupta
episodeTitle.zh: 变得更具战略眼光、应对难相处的同事、创始人模式等挑战 | 安妮卡·古普塔

bio.en: Anneka Gupta is Chief Product Officer at Rubrik, a lecturer on product management at Stanford's Graduate School of Business, and former President and head of product at LiveRamp, where she spent 11 years.
bio.zh: Anneka Gupta 是 Rubrik 首席产品官、斯坦福商学院产品经理课程讲师，曾任 LiveRamp 总裁兼产品负责人，在那里工作了 11 年。

episodeTitle.en: Why most public speaking advice is wrong—and how to finally overcome anxiety | Tristan de Montebello
episodeTitle.zh: 为何大多数公众演讲建议都是错误的——以及如何最终克服焦虑 | 特里斯坦·德·蒙特贝洛

bio.en: Tristan de Montebello is co-creator of Ultraspeaking, the best public-speaking workshop Lenny has found, and a former world-championship finalist in public speaking.
bio.zh: Tristan de Montebello 是 Ultraspeaking 的联合创造者——这是 Lenny 所见过最好的公开演讲工作坊——他也是世界演讲锦标赛的前决赛选手。

episodeTitle.en: Becoming a conscious leader: Leading without fear, finding your life’s objective function, and getting better at vision and strategy | John Mark Nickels (Uber, Waymo, DoorDash)
episodeTitle.zh: 成为有意识的领导者：无所畏惧地领导、找到人生使命函数、提升愿景与战略能力 | John Mark Nickels（优步、Waymo、DoorDash）

bio.en: J.M. Nickels is a product leader who has built and led teams at Waymo, DoorDash, and Uber—launching the first version of Uber Pool and later leading the infrastructure behind Uber's matching and pricing—and now leads product for Uber's mobility team; he speaks on 'conscious leadership.'
bio.zh: J.M. Nickels 是一位产品负责人，曾在 Waymo、DoorDash 和 Uber 打造并领导团队——推出了 Uber Pool 的第一个版本，后来领导支撑 Uber 匹配与定价的底层基础设施——如今领导 Uber 出行（mobility）团队的产品；他常谈“自觉领导力”（conscious leadership）。

episodeTitle.en: Thinking like a gardener, slime mold, the adjacent possible: Product advice from Alex Komoroske
episodeTitle.zh: 像园丁一样思考、黏菌、邻近可能性：亚历克斯·科莫罗斯基的产品建议

bio.en: Alex Komoroske is a former 13-year Google veteran (Search, Chrome's Open Web Platform, AR at Maps) and ex-head of corporate strategy at Stripe who is founding a startup to reimagine the web for the AI era.
bio.zh: Alex Komoroske 在 Google 工作了 13 年（搜索、Chrome 开放网络平台、地图 AR 等），曾任 Stripe 企业战略负责人，目前正在创办一家旨在为 AI 时代重塑网络的公司。

episodeTitle.en: How marketplaces win: Liquidity, growth levers, quality, more | Benjamin Lauzier (Lyft, Thumbtack)
episodeTitle.zh: 市场平台如何取胜：流动性、增长杠杆、质量等 | 本杰明·劳齐尔（Lyft、Thumbtack）

bio.en: Ben Lauzier was VP of Product and Growth at Thumbtack (3x growth in three years) and an early Lyft employee (#30) who led driver-side product and growth, and now advises marketplace teams and founded healthcare startup Nurra.
bio.zh: Ben Lauzier 曾任 Thumbtack 产品与增长副总裁（三年内增长 3 倍），也是 Lyft 早期员工（第 30 号），负责司机端产品与增长，现为正念市场团队顾问，并创办了医疗创业公司 Nurra。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons in product leadership and AI strategy from Glean, Google, Amazon, and Slack | Tamar Yehoshua
episodeTitle.zh: 来自Glean、谷歌、亚马逊和Slack的产品领导力与AI战略启示 | 塔玛·耶霍舒亚

bio.en: Tamar Yehoshua is president of product and technology at Glean, previously CPO at Slack (where she 10x'd revenue through IPO and Salesforce acquisition) and a long-time Google leader on Search.
bio.zh: Tamar Yehoshua 是 Glean 的产品与技术总裁，此前曾任 Slack 首席产品官（在她任内营收增长 10 倍，直至 IPO 并被 Salesforce 收购），也是 Google 搜索领域的长期领导者。

episodeTitle.en: Rethinking SEO in the age of AI | Eli Schwartz (SEO advisor, author)
episodeTitle.zh: AI时代重新思考SEO | 伊莱·施瓦茨（SEO顾问、作家）

bio.en: Eli Schwartz is a growth advisor and SEO strategist who has guided search strategy for companies like Quora, Coinbase, Tinder, LinkedIn, and Zapier, and is the author of the book Product-Led SEO.
bio.zh: Eli Schwartz 是一位增长顾问兼 SEO 策略师，曾为 Quora、Coinbase、Tinder、LinkedIn、Zapier 等公司指导搜索策略，并著有《Product-Led SEO》一书。

episodeTitle.en: The things engineers are desperate for PMs to understand | Camille Fournier (“The Manager’s Path”)
episodeTitle.zh: 工程师迫切希望产品经理理解的事 | 卡米尔·福尼尔（《管理者之路》）

bio.en: Camille Fournier is a respected technology executive and author of The Manager's Path (a definitive guide to engineering management), formerly CTO of Rent the Runway, VP of Technology at Goldman Sachs, and head of platform engineering at JPMorgan Chase.
bio.zh: Camille Fournier 是一位受人尊敬的技术高管、《经理人之路》（The Manager's Path，工程管理权威指南）的作者，曾任 Rent the Runway 的 CTO、高盛技术副总裁、摩根大通平台工程负责人。

episodeTitle.en: Land your dream job in today’s market: negotiation tactics, job search councils, more | Phyl Terry
episodeTitle.zh: 在当今市场中获得理想工作：谈判技巧、求职建议等 | 菲尔·特里（Phyl Terry）

bio.en: Phyl Terry is the author of Never Search Alone and a veteran operator - he was on the founding team of the first company Amazon acquired and later ran the consulting firm Creative Good - who has reinvented job searching through peer support.
bio.zh: Phyl Terry 是《永远不要独自求职》（Never Search Alone）一书的作者，也是一位资深从业者——他曾是亚马逊收购的第一家公司的创始团队成员，后来运营咨询公司 Creative Good——他通过同伴互助重新发明了求职方式。

episodeTitle.en: How LinkedIn became interesting: The inside story | Tomer Cohen (CPO at LinkedIn)
episodeTitle.zh: 《领英如何变得引人入胜：内部故事 | 托默·科恩（领英首席产品官）》

bio.en: Tomer Cohen is Chief Product Officer at LinkedIn, overseeing all product teams, previously head of mobile and the revamp of the LinkedIn feed, and a driver of LinkedIn's early AI-first shift.
bio.zh: Tomer Cohen 是 LinkedIn 的首席产品官（CPO），统管所有产品团队，此前曾任移动端负责人、主导 LinkedIn 信息流的改版，也是 LinkedIn 早期“AI 优先”转向的推动者之一。

episodeTitle.en: The original growth hacker reveals his secrets | Sean Ellis (author of “Hacking Growth”)
episodeTitle.zh: 首席增长黑客揭秘秘籍 | 肖恩·埃利斯（《增长黑客》作者）

bio.en: Today, my guest is Sean Ellis. Sean is one of the earliest and most influential thinkers and operators in the world of growth. He coined the term growth hacking, invented the ICE prioritization framework, was one of the earliest people to use freemium as a growth strategy, and maybe most famously de
bio.zh: 今天的嘉宾是 Sean Ellis。Sean 是增长领域最早、最具影响力的思想家和实践者之一。他创造了"增长黑客"（growth hacking）一词，发明了 ICE 优先级排序框架，是最早将免费增值（freemium）作为增长策略的人之一，或许最广为人知的是 de

episodeTitle.en: How to consistently go viral: Nikita Bier’s playbook for winning at consumer apps
episodeTitle.zh: 如何持续打造爆款产品：尼基塔·比尔（Nikita Bier）在消费类应用领域的成功秘籍

bio.en: Nikita Bier is a consumer-app builder who has launched more chart-topping apps than almost anyone else, selling tbh to Facebook for over $30 million and Gas to Discord for many millions more with a tiny team.
bio.zh: Nikita Bier 是一位消费级应用高手，他打造并推向排行榜榜首的应用数量几乎无人能及：以超过 3000 万美元将 tbh 出售给 Facebook，又以数千万美元将 Gas 出售给 Discord，且全程只有极小的团队与极少的资金。

episodeTitle.en: Succeeding as an introvert, building zero-to-one, and PM’ing your career like a product | Deb Liu
episodeTitle.zh: 作为内向者的成功之道：从0到1的构建，以及像产品经理般规划职业生涯 | 黛布·刘（Deb Liu）

bio.en: Deb Liu was VP of Product at Facebook (creating and leading Facebook Marketplace, used by 1B+ monthly), led its first mobile ad product, and is CEO of Ancestry, with board roles including Intuit.
bio.zh: Deb Liu 曾任 Facebook 产品副总裁（创建并领导月活超 10 亿的 Facebook Marketplace，并主导首个移动广告产品），现任 Ancestry CEO，并在 Intuit 等公司任董事。

episodeTitle.en: Unorthodox PM tips: Automating user insights, unselling candidates, decision logs, more | Kevin Yien
episodeTitle.zh: 制作和营销

bio.en: Kevin Yien leads merchant product experiences at Stripe, previously built Square's restaurant business, and was Head of Product and Design at Mutiny.
bio.zh: 凯文·叶（Kevin Yien）在 Stripe 负责商户产品体验，此前在 Square 打造了餐饮业务，并曾任 Mutiny 的产品与设计负责人。

episodeTitle.en: Improve strategy, influence, and decision-making by understanding your brain | Evan LaPointe
episodeTitle.zh: 通过了解大脑来提升战略、影响力和决策力 | 埃文·拉普安特

bio.en: Evan LaPointe is the founder of CORE Sciences, which teaches companies and individuals how the brain actually works and how to apply that understanding to collaborate, build products, and make smarter decisions; a four-time founder, he created Satellite (the fourth-largest analytics product on the internet), later acquired by Adobe where he led product strategy and innovation for Adobe's digital business.
bio.zh: Evan LaPointe 是 CORE Sciences 的创始人，该公司向企业和个人讲解大脑真正的工作方式，并据此帮助人们更好地协作、打造产品、做出更明智的决策；作为连续四次创业的人，他创办了 Satellite（互联网上第四大的分析产品），该公司后被 Adobe 收购，他随后在 Adobe 负责数字业务的产品战略与创新。

episodeTitle.en: How embracing your emotions will accelerate your career | Joe Hudson (Art of Accomplishment)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何拥抱你的情绪将加速你的职业生涯 | 乔·哈德森（成就艺术）

bio.en: Joe Hudson is one of the most sought-after executive coaches among tech leaders, having worked with people from OpenAI, SpaceX, and Apple; his approach blends spiritual, psychological, and neurological practices to help people build a life of enjoyment and ease.
bio.zh: Joe Hudson 是科技圈高管中最抢手的教练之一，曾与来自 OpenAI、SpaceX、Apple 的人士合作；他的方法融合了精神、心理与神经科学的练习，帮助人们打造充满乐趣与从容的人生。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons from scaling Uber and Opendoor | Brian Tolkin (Head of Product at Opendoor, ex-Uber)
episodeTitle.zh: Uber和Opendoor扩张的经验教训 | Brian Tolkin（Opendoor产品主管，前Uber员工）

bio.en: Brian Tolkin is Head of Product and Design at Opendoor, previously an early Uber employee (#100) who started in operations, led uberPOOL's launch, and created Uber's product-operations function.
bio.zh: Brian Tolkin 是 Opendoor 产品与设计负责人，此前是 Uber 早期员工（第 100 号），从运营起步，领导了 uberPOOL 的发布，并创立了 Uber 的产品运营职能。

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to paid growth | Timothy Davis (Shopify)
episodeTitle.zh: 《权力掮客：罗伯特·摩西与纽约的衰落》

bio.en: Timothy Davis led performance marketing for all of Shopify for two and a half years and, as a consultant, helped companies like Pinterest, LinkedIn, Redfin, and Eventbrite build and scale their performance marketing teams.
bio.zh: Timothy Davis 在 Shopify 全面负责效果营销长达两年半，并以顾问身份帮助 Pinterest、LinkedIn、Redfin、Eventbrite 等公司搭建并做大了效果营销团队。

episodeTitle.en: 5 essential questions to craft a winning strategy | Roger Martin (author, advisor, speaker)
episodeTitle.zh: 《制定制胜战略的五个关键问题》| 罗杰·马丁（作家、顾问、演讲者）

bio.en: Roger Martin is one of the world's most trusted strategy advisors, professor emeritus at the Rotman School of Management at the University of Toronto, and author of the classic Playing to Win.
bio.zh: Roger Martin 是全球最受信赖的战略顾问之一，多伦多大学罗特曼管理学院荣休教授，也是经典著作《赢得胜利》（Playing to Win）的作者。

episodeTitle.en: Building a world-class data org | Jessica Lachs (VP of Analytics and Data Science at DoorDash)
episodeTitle.zh: 打造世界级数据组织 | 杰西卡·拉克斯（Jessica Lachs，DoorDash分析与数据科学副总裁）

bio.en: Jessica Lachs is Vice President of Analytics and Data Science at DoorDash, where she has built one of the largest and most respected data teams in tech over a 10+-year tenure and was the company's first GM launching new markets; she previously founded the social-gifting startup GiftSimple.
bio.zh: Jessica Lachs 是 DoorDash 的分析与数据科学副总裁，在十余年任期里打造了科技圈规模最大、最受尊敬的数据团队之一，也是公司开拓新市场的第一位 GM；她此前创办了社交送礼初创 GiftSimple。

episodeTitle.en: Building product at Stripe: craft, metrics, and customer obsession | Jeff Weinstein (Product lead)
episodeTitle.zh: 在Stripe构建产品：工艺、指标和以客户为中心 | 杰夫·温斯坦（Jeff Weinstein，产品负责人）

bio.en: Jeff Weinstein spent six-plus years at Stripe, where he led payment-infrastructure product teams, scaled Stripe Payments to hundreds of billions in annual volume, and grew Stripe Atlas—now used to start one in six new Delaware corporations.
bio.zh: Jeff Weinstein 在 Stripe 任职六年多，领导支付基础设施产品团队，将 Stripe Payments 的规模做到每年数千亿交易量，并壮大了 Stripe Atlas——如今全美每六家新成立的特拉华州公司就有一家通过它注册。

episodeTitle.en: Pattern Breakers: How to find a breakthrough startup idea | Mike Maples, Jr. (Partner at Floodgate)
episodeTitle.zh: 《破局者：如何找到突破性创业理念》 | 小迈克·马普尔斯（Mike Maples, Jr.，Floodgate合伙人）

bio.en: Mike Maples Jr is a legendary early-stage investor and co-founder of Floodgate, a seed-investing pioneer that backed Twitter, Lyft, Twitch, and other transformative companies.
