bio.zh: 小迈克·梅普尔斯（Mike Maples Jr）是一位传奇的早期投资人、种子投资先驱 Floodgate 的联合创始人，曾投资 Twitter、Lyft、Twitch 等变革性公司。

episodeTitle.en: Dylan Field live at Figma's Config: Intuition, simplicity, and the future of design
episodeTitle.zh: Dylan Field在Figma Config上的现场演讲：直觉、简洁性与设计的未来

bio.en: Dylan Field is the co-founder and CEO of Figma, the collaborative interface design tool that became one of the most widely used products by design and product teams worldwide.
bio.zh: Dylan Field 是 Figma 的联合创始人兼 CEO；Figma 是一款协作式界面设计工具，已成为全球设计与产品团队使用最广泛的产品之一。

episodeTitle.en: The social radar: Y Combinator’s secret weapon | Jessica Livingston (co-founder of YC, author)
episodeTitle.zh: 社交雷达：Y Combinator的秘密武器 | 杰西卡·利文斯顿（YC联合创始人、作家）

bio.en: Jessica Livingston is the co-founder of Y Combinator—the first and most famous startup accelerator, which has funded 5,000+ companies including Airbnb, Stripe, and Coinbase—and author of Founders at Work; she is famed for her 'social radar' for reading people.
bio.zh: Jessica Livingston 是 Y Combinator 的联合创始人——这是第一家也是最著名的创业加速器，已投资 5000 多家公司，包括 Airbnb、Stripe、Coinbase——也是《Founders at Work》的作者；她以善于“读人”的“社交雷达”而闻名。

episodeTitle.en: Making an impact through authenticity and curiosity | Ami Vora (CPO at Faire, ex-WhatsApp, FB, IG)
episodeTitle.zh: 通过真实与好奇心产生影响 | 阿米·沃拉（Faire首席产品官，前WhatsApp、Facebook、Instagram高管）

bio.en: Ami Vora is Chief Product Officer at Faire, the leading B2B marketplace for independent retailers and brands, and was employee #150 at Facebook, where she launched the first developer platform and led global ads and WhatsApp product/design.
bio.zh: Ami Vora 是 Faire（面向独立零售商与品牌的最大 B2B 市场）首席产品官，也是 Facebook 第 150 号员工，曾发布首个开发者平台，并领导全球广告业务及 WhatsApp 的产品与设计。

episodeTitle.en: Hard-won lessons building 0 to 1 inside Atlassian | Tanguy Crusson (Head of Jira Product Discovery)
episodeTitle.zh: 《在Atlassian内部从0到1的艰辛历程 | 坦古伊·克鲁松（Tanguy Crusson，Jira产品发现负责人）》

bio.en: Tanguy Crusson is a 10+ year Atlassian veteran who has led major internal big bets including HipChat, Statuspage, and Jira Product Discovery, one of the fastest-growing products in Atlassian's history.
bio.zh: Tanguy Crusson 是一位在 Atlassian 任职逾十年的老兵，曾领导多项重大的内部“从零到一”赌注，包括 HipChat、Statuspage，以及 Atlassian 史上增长最快的产品之一 Jira Product Discovery。

episodeTitle.en: The paths to power: How to grow your influence and advance your career | Jeffrey Pfeffer (Stanford)
episodeTitle.zh: 通往权力的道路：如何提升你的影响力并推进你的职业生涯 | 杰弗里·普费弗（Jeffrey Pfeffer，斯坦福大学）

bio.en: Jeffrey Pfeffer is a Professor of Organizational Behavior at Stanford Graduate School of Business and the author of The 7 Rules of Power, who teaches that power is a learnable skill—not a personality trait—that advances your career and well-being.
bio.zh: Jeffrey Pfeffer 是斯坦福商学院组织行为学教授、《权力的 7 条法则》（The 7 Rules of Power）的作者，他主张权力是一项可习得的技能——而非性格特质——能推动你的职业生涯与幸福感。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons from a 2-time unicorn builder, 50-time startup advisor and 20-time board member | Uri Levine
episodeTitle.zh: 从两次独角兽公司创始人、50次创业顾问到20次董事会成员的经验谈 | 乌里·莱文

bio.en: Uri Levine is co-founder of Waze and nine other companies, has sold two companies for over $1 billion, advised 50+ founders, and authored Fall in Love with the Problem, Not the Solution.
bio.zh: Uri Levine 是 Waze 与另外九家公司的联合创始人，曾将两家公司以超 10 亿美元售出，为 50 多位创始人提供过顾问服务，并著有《爱上问题，而非方案》（Fall in Love with the Problem, Not the Solution）。

episodeTitle.en: Inside Canva: Coaches not managers, giving away your Legos, and embracing AI | Cameron Adams
episodeTitle.zh: Canva内部：教练而非管理者，分享乐高积木，拥抱AI | 卡梅伦·亚当斯

bio.en: Cameron “Cam” Adams is co-founder and Chief Product Officer at Canva, the profitable design platform generating billions in ARR and growing 60%+ year over year.
bio.zh: Cameron “Cam” Adams 是 Canva 的联合创始人兼首席产品官，Canva 是一家盈利的设计平台，年经常性收入达数十亿美元，年增速超 60%。

episodeTitle.en: The surprising truth about what closes deals: Insights from 2.5m sales conversations | Matt Dixon
episodeTitle.zh: 《成交背后的惊人真相：250万次销售对话的洞察》|马特·迪克森

bio.en: Matt Dixon is a sales and customer-experience researcher and author of the bestsellers The Challenger Sale and The JOLT Effect, based on studies of millions of sales conversations.
bio.zh: 马特·迪克森（Matt Dixon）是一位销售与客户体验研究专家，也是畅销书《挑战式销售》（The Challenger Sale）与《JOLT 效应》（The JOLT Effect）的作者，其结论基于对数百万次销售对话的研究。

episodeTitle.en: Unorthodox frameworks for growing your product, career, and impact | Bangaly Kaba (YT, IG, FB)
episodeTitle.zh: 《增长你的产品、职业和影响力的非传统框架 | 班加利·卡巴（YouTube、Instagram、Facebook）》

bio.en: Bangaly Kaba was an early growth PM at Facebook, Head of Growth at Instagram (scaling it past 1 billion users), VP of Product at Instacart, and is Director of Product Management at YouTube, known for his framework on driving organizational change.
bio.zh: Bangaly Kaba 曾是 Facebook 早期增长产品经理、Instagram 增长负责人（将其扩展到超 10 亿用户）、Instacart 产品副总裁，现任 YouTube 产品管理总监，以其推动组织变革的框架闻名。

episodeTitle.en: Why not asking for what you want is holding you back | Kenneth Berger (exec coach, first PM @Slack)
episodeTitle.zh: 为何不主动争取想要的东西会阻碍你前进 | 肯尼斯·伯格（执行教练，Slack首位产品经理）

bio.en: Kenneth Berger was Slack's first product manager and is now an executive coach helping startup leaders make ambitious work sustainable without burning out.
bio.zh: 肯尼斯·伯杰（Kenneth Berger）是 Slack 的第一位产品经理，如今是一位高管教练，帮助初创公司领导者在不透支的前提下持续推进高难度目标。

episodeTitle.en: Be fundamentally different, not incrementally better | Jag Duggal (Nubank, Facebook, Google)
episodeTitle.zh: 像杰克·杜加尔（Nubank、Facebook、谷歌）那样：从根本上与众不同，而非渐进式改进

bio.en: Jag Duggal is Chief Product Officer at Nubank, the massively under-the-radar Brazilian fintech with a fanatical user base that is larger than Coinbase, Robinhood, Affirm, SoFi, and Lemonade combined; before Nubank he led product at Facebook, Google, and Quantcast.
bio.zh: Jag Duggal 是 Nubank 的首席产品官；Nubank 是一家极度低调却庞大的巴西金融科技公司，拥有狂热的用户群，规模超过 Coinbase、Robinhood、Affirm、SoFi 和 Lemonade 之和；加入 Nubank 前，他曾在 Facebook、Google 和 Quantcast 领导产品。

episodeTitle.en: A framework for PM skill development | Vikrama Dhiman (Gojek)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品经理技能发展框架 | 维克拉马·迪曼（Go-Jek）

bio.en: Vikrama Dhiman heads all product at Gojek - including product management, design, and research across India, Singapore, and Indonesia - and is one of Asia's best-known product leaders.
bio.zh: Vikrama Dhiman 统管 Gojek 的全部产品事务——包括产品管理、设计与研究，团队横跨印度、新加坡与印尼——也是亚洲最知名的产品领导者之一。

episodeTitle.en: Business strategy with Hamilton Helmer (author of 7 Powers)
episodeTitle.zh: 与汉密尔顿·赫尔默（《7种战略力量》作者）的商业战略对话

bio.en: Hamilton Helmer is a strategy legend and the author of 7 Powers, the widely praised framework for identifying and building sustainable competitive advantage ('moats'), credited by leaders like Peter Thiel and Reed Hastings for helping them build durable companies.
bio.zh: Hamilton Helmer 是战略领域的传奇人物，也是《七种力量》（7 Powers）的作者；这本书提出了识别与构建可持续竞争优势（“护城河”）的广为推崇的框架，被 Peter Thiel、Reed Hastings 等领导者誉为帮助他们打造持久公司的关键。

episodeTitle.en: This will make you a better decision maker | Annie Duke (Thinking In Bets, former pro poker player)
episodeTitle.zh: 这将让你成为更优秀的决策者 | 安妮·杜克（《在博彩中思考》前职业扑克玩家）

bio.en: Annie Duke is the author of the bestsellers Thinking in Bets and Quit: The Power of Knowing When to Walk Away, a former professional poker player who won over $4 million, and a special partner at First Round Capital.
bio.zh: Annie Duke 是畅销书《赌注思维》（Thinking in Bets）和《退出：懂得何时放手的力量》（Quit）的作者，曾经的职业扑克玩家（赢得超 400 万美元），也是 First Round Capital 的特别合伙人。

episodeTitle.en: Twitter’s ex-Head of Product on Elon, consumer products, culture, more | Kayvon Beykpour
episodeTitle.zh: 推特前产品主管谈埃隆、消费产品、文化等 | 凯文·贝克波尔

bio.en: Kayvon Beykpour is a product leader best known for transforming Twitter's product culture from stagnant to ship-driven, and was previously the founder of Periscope.
bio.zh: 凯冯·贝伊科佩（Kayvon Beykpour）是一位产品负责人，以将 Twitter 的产品文化从停滞不前转变为高频发布而闻名，他此前是 Periscope 的创始人。

episodeTitle.en: How to build deeper, more robust relationships | Carole Robin (Stanford professor, “Touchy Feely”)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何建立更深厚、更稳固的关系 | 卡罗尔·罗宾（斯坦福大学教授，“触觉感知”）

bio.en: Carole Robin taught the legendary “Touchy Feely” (Interpersonal Dynamics) course at Stanford's Graduate School of Business for over 20 years and wrote Connect, distilling those lessons for leaders.
bio.zh: Carole Robin 在斯坦福商学院讲授传奇的“Touchy Feely”（人际动力学）课程逾 20 年，并著有《Connect》一书，将那些洞见提炼给领导者。

episodeTitle.en: Vision, conviction, and hype: How to build 0 to 1 inside a company | Mihika Kapoor (Product, Figma)
episodeTitle.zh: 《愿景、信念与炒作：如何在公司内部从0到1打造创新》 | 米希卡·卡普尔（Mihika Kapoor，Figma产品经理）

bio.en: Mihika Kapoor is a product manager at Figma renowned for creating a compelling vision and getting teams to see it, and a repeated "best PM" cited by peers.
bio.zh: 米希卡·卡普尔（Mihika Kapoor）是 Figma 的产品经理，以"能创造令人信服的愿景、并让团队看见它"而闻名，被同行多次评为"最佳 PM"。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons from 1,000+ YC startups: Resilience, tar pit ideas, pivoting, more | Dalton Caldwell (YC)
episodeTitle.zh: 1000+ YC初创企业的经验教训：韧性、停滞不前的想法、转型等 | 达尔顿·考德威尔（YC）

bio.en: Dalton Caldwell is a managing director and group partner at Y Combinator, where he's worked with more startups than nearly anyone alive, and previously co-founded and led imeem and App.net.
bio.zh: Dalton Caldwell 是 Y Combinator 的管理董事兼集团合伙人，他合作过的初创公司数量几乎无人能及，此前曾联合创立并领导 imeem 和 App.net。

episodeTitle.en: A framework for finding product-market fit | Todd Jackson (First Round Capital)
episodeTitle.zh: 《寻找产品-市场匹配的框架》 | 托德·杰克逊（First Round Capital）

bio.en: Todd Jackson is a partner at First Round Capital and a rare VC who came up as a product leader - PM of Gmail, Facebook News Feed/Photos/Groups, Twitter product director, Dropbox VP of product & design, and a founder.
bio.zh: Todd Jackson 是 First Round Capital 的合伙人，也是一位罕见的、从产品领导者成长起来的投资人——他曾任 Gmail 产品经理、Facebook 动态消息/照片/小组产品负责人、Twitter 产品总监、Dropbox 产品与设计副总裁，同时也是一位创始人。

episodeTitle.en: Bending the universe in your favor | Claire Vo (LaunchDarkly, Color, Optimizely, ChatPRD)
episodeTitle.zh: “让宇宙为你所用” | Claire Vo（LaunchDarkly、Color、Optimizely、ChatPRD）

bio.en: Claire Vo is the host of the sister podcast How I AI, a three-time CPO, and longtime engineer and founder, sharing her journey from AI skeptic to power user of the OpenClaw agent platform.
bio.zh: Claire Vo 是姊妹播客《How I AI》的主持人、三度首席产品官、长期工程师兼创始人，她分享了自己从 AI 怀疑者到 OpenClaw 智能体平台重度用户的心路历程。

episodeTitle.en: Zigging vs. zagging: How HubSpot built a $30B company | Dharmesh Shah (co-founder/CTO)
episodeTitle.zh: 《曲线求生：HubSpot如何打造市值300亿美元的公司》，达米什·沙阿（Dharmesh Shah，HubSpot联合创始人兼首席技术官）

bio.en: Dharmesh Shah is the co-founder and CTO of HubSpot, the publicly traded CRM and inbound-marketing platform that grew from a scrappy SMB-focused startup into a multi-billion-dollar company serving hundreds of thousands of businesses.
bio.zh: Dharmesh Shah 是 HubSpot 的联合创始人兼 CTO。HubSpot 是一家上市的 CRM 与集客营销平台，从一家专注中小企业的草根创业公司，成长为服务数十万家企业、市值数十亿美元的公司。

episodeTitle.en: How to speak more confidently and persuasively | Matt Abrahams (professor, speaker, author)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何更自信、更有说服力地表达 | 马特·亚伯拉罕斯（教授、演讲家、作家）

bio.en: Matt Abrahams is a Stanford Graduate School of Business lecturer on communication and the host of the Think Fast, Talk Smart podcast, and author of a popular book on speaking confidently.
bio.zh: 马特·亚伯拉罕斯（Matt Abrahams）是斯坦福商学院的沟通课程讲师、Think Fast, Talk Smart 播客的主持人，也是一本关于自信演讲的畅销书作者。

episodeTitle.en: Kunal Shah on winning in India, second-order thinking, the philosophy of startups, and more
episodeTitle.zh: 库纳尔·沙阿谈在印度取胜、二阶思维、创业哲学等

bio.en: Kunal Shah is the founder and CEO of CRED, the Indian fintech app for credit-card bill payments, and a widely followed thinker on why products succeed in India.
bio.zh: 库纳尔·沙阿（Kunal Shah）是 CRED 的创始人兼 CEO，CRED 是一款印度信用卡还款金融科技应用，他也是关于"产品为何能在印度成功"的广受关注的思考者。

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to PR | Emilie Gerber (founder of Six Eastern)
episodeTitle.zh: 《公关终极指南》| Emilie Gerber（Six Eastern创始人）

bio.en: Emilie Gerber is the founder and CEO of Six Eastern, a PR agency that has worked with over 100 tech companies—from stealth startups to public companies—to earn press, build awareness, and sharpen their communications strategy.
bio.zh: Emilie Gerber 是 Six Eastern 的创始人兼 CEO；这是一家公关机构，已与 100 多家科技公司（从隐身期初创到上市公司）合作，帮助它们获得媒体曝光、建立认知并打磨传播策略。

episodeTitle.en: The happiness and pain of product management | Noam Lovinsky (Grammarly, FB, Thumbtack, YT)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品管理的幸福与痛苦 | 诺姆·洛文斯基（Grammarly、Facebook、Thumbtack、YouTube）

bio.en: When you were at Facebook, you built what is called the New Product Experimentation team trying to create a startup within a startup.
bio.zh: 你在Facebook工作时，组建了所谓的新产品实验团队，试图在公司内部创建一家初创公司。

episodeTitle.en: Product management theater | Marty Cagan (Silicon Valley Product Group)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品管理戏码 | 马蒂·卡根（硅谷产品集团）

bio.en: Marty Cagan is the author of Inspired and Empowered and a partner at SVPG, who has coached more product teams and PMs than almost anyone, and recently released a new book on modern product practice.
bio.zh: 马蒂·卡根（Marty Cagan）是《Inspired》与《Empowered》的作者、SVPG 的合伙人，他辅导过的产品团队与 PM 几乎无人能及，近期又推出了一本关于现代产品实践的新书。

episodeTitle.en: Inside TikTok: Culture, strategy, monetization, and more | Ray Cao
episodeTitle.zh: TikTok内幕：文化、战略、变现等 | 曹睿（Ray Cao）

bio.en: Ray Cao is the global Head of Monetization Product Strategy & Operations at TikTok, where he has been for over four years, after spending six years at Google helping scale Google Shopping globally.
bio.zh: Ray Cao 是 TikTok 全球变现产品战略与运营负责人，已在公司四年有余，此前曾在 Google 工作六年，帮助 Google Shopping 在全球范围规模化。

episodeTitle.en: Making Meta | Andrew ‘Boz’ Bosworth (CTO)
episodeTitle.zh: 打造元宇宙 | Andrew ‘Boz’ Bosworth（首席技术官）

bio.en: Andrew “Boz” Bosworth is CTO of Meta, one of its first engineers (2006), and creator of landmark products including the Facebook News Feed, mobile ads platform, and Messenger.
bio.zh: Andrew “Boz” Bosworth 是 Meta 首席技术官，公司最早的工程师之一（2006 年加入），并打造了 Facebook 动态消息、移动广告平台和 Messenger 等标志性产品。

episodeTitle.en: How to discover your superpowers, own your story, and unlock personal growth | Donna Lichaw
episodeTitle.zh: 如何发现你的超能力、掌控自己的故事并开启个人成长之旅 | 唐娜·利查沃（Donna Lichaw）

bio.en: Donna Lichaw is an executive coach, speaker, and bestselling author of The Leader's Journey, helping founders, CEOs, and executives scale their impact while staying true to themselves.
bio.zh: Donna Lichaw 是一位高管教练、演讲者和畅销书《领导者的旅程》（The Leader's Journey）作者，帮助创始人、CEO 和高管在忠于自我的同时放大影响力。

episodeTitle.en: How Netflix builds a culture of excellence | Elizabeth Stone (CTO)
episodeTitle.zh: Netflix如何构建卓越文化 | 伊丽莎白·斯通（CTO）

bio.en: Elizabeth Stone is the chief technology officer at Netflix—reportedly the first economist ever named CTO of a Fortune 500 company—and previously held leadership roles in data and science at Netflix, Lyft, and Nuna.
bio.zh: Elizabeth Stone 是 Netflix 的首席技术官——据称是有史以来第一位出任财富 500 强公司 CTO 的经济学家，此前曾在 Netflix、Lyft 和 Nuna 担任数据与研究领域的领导职务。

episodeTitle.en: Building a world-class sales org | Jason Lemkin (SaaStr)
episodeTitle.zh: 《打造世界级销售团队》 | 杰森·莱姆金（Jason Lemkin，SaaStr）

bio.en: Jason M. Lemkin is the founder of EchoSign (grown past $100M ARR and sold to Adobe) and the creator of SaaStr, the largest community for SaaS founders and executives; he is one of the most quoted voices on building and scaling SaaS go-to-market.
bio.zh: Jason M. Lemkin 是 EchoSign 的创始人（ARR 做到超 1 亿美元后出售给 Adobe），也是 SaaStr（最大的 SaaS 创始人与高管社区）的创办者；他是关于打造与扩展 SaaS 上市策略被引用最多的声音之一。

episodeTitle.en: Making time for what matters | Jake Knapp and John Zeratsky (Authors of Make Time, Character VC)
episodeTitle.zh: 为重要之事腾出时间 | 杰克·纳普和约翰·泽拉斯基（《腾出时间》作者）

bio.en: Jake Knapp and John Zeratsky are the co-creators of the Design Sprint and authors of Sprint and Make Time; they now run the venture firm Character and its Character Labs accelerator.
bio.zh: Jake Knapp 与 John Zeratsky 是“设计冲刺”（Design Sprint）的共同创造者，也是《Sprint》和《Make Time》的作者；他们如今经营着风险投资公司 Character 及其 Character Labs 加速器。

episodeTitle.en: Inside OpenAI | Logan Kilpatrick (head of developer relations)
episodeTitle.zh: 《OpenAI内幕》

bio.en: Logan Kilpatrick is the Head of Developer Relations at OpenAI, supporting developers building on its APIs and ChatGPT, and previously was an ML engineer at Apple.
bio.zh: 洛根·基尔帕特里克（Logan Kilpatrick）是 OpenAI 的开发者关系负责人，支持基于其 API 与 ChatGPT 构建应用的开发者，此前是 Apple 的机器学习工程师。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons from Atlassian | Megan Cook (Head of Product, Jira)
episodeTitle.zh: Atlassian的经验教训 | 梅根·库克（Jira产品负责人）

bio.en: Megan Cook is Head of Product for Jira at Atlassian, used by 75% of Fortune 500 companies, and has spent nearly 11 years at the company.
bio.zh: 梅根·库克（Megan Cook）是 Atlassian 公司 Jira 的产品负责人，Jira 被 75% 的财富 500 强企业使用，她在公司近 11 年。

episodeTitle.en: Managing nerves, anxiety, and burnout | Jonny Miller (Nervous Systems Mastery)
episodeTitle.zh: 管理紧张、焦虑与职业倦怠 | 乔尼·米勒（Nervous Systems Mastery）

bio.en: Jonny Miller is a coach and educator who created Nervous System Mastery, a program that teaches tech professionals practical tools to build calm, resilience, and sustained high performance.
bio.zh: 乔尼·米勒（Jonny Miller）是一位教练与教育工作者，他创立了"神经系统掌控力"（Nervous System Mastery）项目，向科技从业者传授培养内心平静、提升抗压能力与持续高效状态的实用工具。

episodeTitle.en: Geoffrey Moore on finding your beachhead, crossing the chasm, and dominating a market
episodeTitle.zh: 杰夫瑞·摩尔谈如何找到突破口、跨越鸿沟、主导市场

bio.en: Geoffrey Moore is the author of Crossing the Chasm, perhaps the most influential book ever written on technology go-to-market strategy, and a longtime advisor to B2B and tech companies on scaling through the adoption lifecycle.
bio.zh: Geoffrey Moore 是《跨越鸿沟》（Crossing the Chasm）的作者，这本书堪称史上最具影响力的技术产品上市策略著作，他长期为 B2B 与科技公司提供跨越采用生命周期、实现规模化的咨询。

episodeTitle.en: Good Strategy, Bad Strategy | Richard Rumelt
episodeTitle.zh: 《优秀战略与糟糕战略》|理查德·鲁梅尔特

bio.en: Richard Rumelt is a legend in the field of strategy and the author of Good Strategy/Bad Strategy and The Crux, and was a longtime professor at UCLA Anderson and on the faculty of Harvard Business School.
bio.zh: Richard Rumelt 是战略领域的传奇人物，著有《好战略，坏战略》（Good Strategy/Bad Strategy）与《关键难题》（The Crux），曾任 UCLA 安德森管理学院长期教授，亦曾执教于哈佛商学院。

episodeTitle.en: The art and wisdom of changing teams | Heidi Helfand (Author of Dynamic Reteaming)
episodeTitle.zh: 团队变动的艺术与智慧 | 海蒂·赫尔方德（《动态团队重组》作者）

bio.en: Heidi Helfand is an organizational-design consultant, workshop leader, and author of Dynamic Reteaming, who after two decades in tech became an expert on how to reorganize teams effectively and why change is good for them.
bio.zh: Heidi Helfand 是一位组织设计顾问、工作坊引导者，也是《Dynamic Reteaming》的作者；在科技行业深耕二十年后，她成为“如何有效重组团队”以及“为何变化对团队有益”的专家。

episodeTitle.en: Taking control of your career | Ethan Evans (Amazon)
episodeTitle.zh: 掌控你的职业生涯 | 伊桑·埃文斯（亚马逊）

bio.en: Ethan Evans is a former Amazon vice president and executive coach who spent 15 years at Amazon helping build Prime Video, the Amazon Appstore, Prime Gaming, and Twitch Commerce (a billion-dollar business), co-drafted one of Amazon's 14 leadership principles, and holds over 70 patents.
bio.zh: Ethan Evans 是前亚马逊副总裁、高管教练，在亚马逊任职 15 年，参与打造 Prime Video、Amazon Appstore、Prime Gaming 和 Twitch Commerce（价值十亿美元的业务），参与起草亚马逊 14 条领导力原则之一，并拥有 70 多项专利。

episodeTitle.en: How to be more innovative | Sam Schillace (Microsoft deputy CTO, creator of Google Docs)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何更具创新力 | 山姆·施利亚克（Sam Schillace，微软副首席技术官，Google Docs创始人）

bio.en: Sam Schillace is Corporate Vice President and Deputy CTO at Microsoft, leading consumer product, infrastructure, and AI efforts, and is best known for essentially inventing Google Docs with his company Writely.
bio.zh: Sam Schillace 是微软公司副总裁兼副首席技术官（Deputy CTO），领导消费级产品、基础设施与 AI 方面的工作；他最为人知的成就是凭借自己的公司 Writely 几乎凭一己之力发明了 Google Docs。

episodeTitle.en: The engineering mindset | Will Larson (Carta, Stripe, Uber, Calm, Digg)
episodeTitle.zh: 工程师思维模式 | 威尔·拉森（Will Larson，曾就职于Carta、Stripe、Uber、Calm、Digg）

bio.en: Will Larson is CTO at Carta, an engineering leader at Stripe, Uber, and Calm, and author of An Elegant Puzzle, Staff Engineer, and The Engineering Executive's Primer.
bio.zh: Will Larson 是 Carta 的 CTO，一位曾在 Stripe、Uber 和 Calm 任职的工程领导者，也是《An Elegant Puzzle》《Staff Engineer》与《The Engineering Executive's Primer》等书的作者。

episodeTitle.en: The UX Research reckoning is here | Judd Antin (Airbnb, Meta)
episodeTitle.zh: 用户体验研究的反思——贾德·安丁（Airbnb、Meta）

bio.en: Judd Antin is a user research leader who built the research practice at Facebook and spent years as head of research at Airbnb, and whose mentees now lead research at Figma, Notion, Slack, and more.
bio.zh: 贾德·安廷（Judd Antin）是一位用户研究领军人物，他曾在 Facebook 建立用户研究体系，并长期担任 Airbnb 的研究负责人，他的许多下属如今在 Figma、Notion、Slack 等公司领导研究团队。

episodeTitle.en: Strategies for becoming less distractible and improving focus | Nir Eyal
episodeTitle.zh: 提升专注力、减少分心干扰的策略 | 尼尔·埃亚尔

bio.en: Nir Eyal is the author of the bestselling books Hooked: How to Build Habit-Forming Products and Indistractable: How to Control Your Attention, and a teacher and consultant at the intersection of psychology, technology, and business.
bio.zh: Nir Eyal 是畅销书《钩住：如何打造让人上瘾的产品》（Hooked）与《不可分心：如何掌控你的注意力》（Indistractable）的作者，也是一位游走于心理学、科技与商业交叉领域的导师与顾问。

episodeTitle.en: The hierarchy of engagement | Sarah Tavel (Benchmark, Greylock, Pinterest)
episodeTitle.zh: 参与度的层级 | 莎拉·塔维尔（Sarah Tavel，Benchmark、Greylock、Pinterest）

bio.en: Sarah Tavel is a partner at Benchmark, one of the world's preeminent venture capital firms, focusing on consumer and marketplace startups, and was the first product manager at Pinterest.
bio.zh: Sarah Tavel 是 Benchmark 的合伙人，该基金是全球最负盛名的风投机构之一，她专注投资消费级与 marketplace 类初创公司，此前曾是 Pinterest 的首位产品经理。

episodeTitle.en: The essence of product management | Christian Idiodi (SVPG)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品管理的精髓 | 克里斯蒂安·伊多迪（SVPG）

bio.en: Christian Idiodi is a partner at Silicon Valley Product Group alongside Marty Cagan, known as “the most interesting man in the world,” helping companies implement and improve the discipline of product management.
bio.zh: Christian Idiodi 是硅谷产品集团（Silicon Valley Product Group）的合伙人，与 Marty Cagan 共事，被称为“世界上最有趣的人”，帮助各公司落地并改进产品管理的纪律。

episodeTitle.en: Jason Fried challenges your thinking on fundraising, goals, growth, and more
episodeTitle.zh: 杰森·弗里德挑战您对融资、目标、增长等的认知

bio.en: Jason Fried is co-founder and CEO of 37signals, the profitable, bootstrapped company behind Basecamp and HEY that has made money for 24 straight years with no investors, no board, and no plans to sell or go public.
bio.zh: Jason Fried 是 37signals 的联合创始人兼 CEO；37signals 是一家盈利、自筹资金的公司，旗下有 Basecamp 和 HEY，连续 24 年盈利，没有投资人、没有董事会，也无意出售或上市。

episodeTitle.en: How to tell better stories | Matthew Dicks (Storyworthy)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何讲好故事 | 马修·迪克斯（Storyworthy）

bio.en: Matthew Dicks is the author of Storyworthy, a 59-time Moth Story Slam winner, and a teacher of storytelling for business and life.
bio.zh: 马修·迪克斯（Matthew Dicks）是《Storyworthy》一书的作者、59 次 Moth 故事大赛的冠军，也是一位教授商业与生活叙事的老师。

episodeTitle.en: Failure
episodeTitle.zh: 失败

bio.en: A special compilation episode in which Lenny revisits the most insightful stories of failure pulled from past conversations, arguing that you can often learn more from failure than from studying successful companies.
bio.zh: 这是一期特别的合集节目：Lenny 从过往对话中挑出最具启发性的“失败”故事重新编排，主张研究失败往往比研究成功公司更能学到东西。

episodeTitle.en: Radical Candor: From theory to practice with author Kim Scott
episodeTitle.zh: 《激进坦诚》：从理论到实践 作者Kim Scott

bio.en: Kim Scott is the author of Radical Candor, the most-referenced management book on Lenny's podcast, and has coached leaders at Apple, Google, Twitter, and Dropbox.
bio.zh: 金·斯科特（Kim Scott）是《彻底坦率》（Radical Candor）一书的作者，该书是 Lenny 播客中被引用最多的管理类著作，她曾为 Apple、Google、Twitter 和 Dropbox 的领导者担任教练。

episodeTitle.en: The full-stack PM | Anuj Rathi (Swiggy, Jupiter Money, Flipkart)
episodeTitle.zh: 全栈产品经理 | 阿努吉·拉蒂（曾就职于Swiggy、Jupiter Money、Flipkart）

bio.en: Anuj Rathi is Chief Product and Marketing Officer at Jupiter Money, previously SVP of Revenue and Growth at Swiggy, VP of Product at Snapdeal, and the first PM at Flipkart's buyer experience team.
bio.zh: Anuj Rathi 是 Jupiter Money 首席产品与营销官，此前曾任 Swiggy 营收与增长高级副总裁、Snapdeal 产品副总裁，以及 Flipkart 买家体验团队的第一位产品经理。

episodeTitle.en: Crafting a compelling product vision | Ebi Atawodi (YouTube, Netflix, Uber)
episodeTitle.zh: 《打造引人注目的产品愿景 | 埃比·阿塔沃迪（YouTube、Netflix、Uber）》

bio.en: Ebi Atawodi is the director of product management at YouTube, where she oversees the creator experience, and previously led payments and fintech product at Uber and Netflix.
bio.zh: Ebi Atawodi 是 YouTube 的产品管理总监，负责创作者体验，此前曾在 Uber 和 Netflix 主导支付与金融科技产品。

episodeTitle.en: The future of AI in software development | Inbal Shani (CPO of GitHub)
episodeTitle.zh: 人工智能在软件开发中的未来 | 因巴尔·沙尼（GitHub首席产品官）

bio.en: Inbal Shani is a product executive who served as Chief Product Officer of Ironclad and is now Chief Product Officer at LinkedIn, where she leads development of the world's largest professional network.
bio.zh: Inbal Shani 是一位产品高管，曾担任 Ironclad 的首席产品官，现任 LinkedIn 首席产品官，领导全球最大职业社交网络的开发。

episodeTitle.en: My favorite interview questions from 100+ guests
episodeTitle.zh: 我从100+位嘉宾那里收集的最爱采访问题

bio.en: A special compilation episode in which Lenny gathers the best advice from past guests on how to prepare for, approach, and ace product and tech job interviews.
bio.zh: 这是一期特别的合集节目：Lenny 汇集了过往嘉宾关于如何准备、应对并在产品与技术岗位面试中脱颖而出的精华建议。

episodeTitle.en: Billion dollar failures, and billion dollar success | Tom Conrad (Quibi, Pandora, Pets.com, Zero)
episodeTitle.zh: 百亿美元的失败与百亿美元的成功 | 汤姆·康拉德（Quibi、Pandora、Pets.com、Zero）

bio.en: Tom Conrad is the CEO of Zero and a veteran product and technology leader who helped build foundational iOS features at Apple, served as CTO of Pandora and VP of Product at Snap, and was an executive at the famed failures Pets.com and Quibi.
bio.zh: Tom Conrad 是 Zero 的 CEO，也是一位资深的产品与技术领导者：他曾在 Apple 帮助打造 iOS 的基础性功能，担任过 Pandora 的 CTO 与 Snap 的产品副总裁，还曾任职于那些著名的失败案例 Pets.com 与 Quibi。

episodeTitle.en: Redefining success, money, and belonging | Paul Millerd (The Pathless Path)
episodeTitle.zh: 重新定义成功、金钱和归属感 | 保罗·米勒德（《无路之路》）

bio.en: Paul Millerd is the author of The Pathless Path: Imagining a New Story for Work and Life, a book that has resonated widely in the tech community for challenging the default career trajectory.
bio.zh: Paul Millerd 是《无路之路》（The Pathless Path）一书的作者，该书因挑战传统默认职业轨迹而在科技圈引发广泛共鸣。

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to product operations | Melissa Perri and Denise Tilles
episodeTitle.zh: 产品运营终极指南 | 梅丽莎·佩里（Melissa Perri）与丹妮丝·蒂勒斯（Denise Tilles）

bio.en: Melissa Perri and Denise Tilles are the authors of Product Operations, with Melissa known for Escaping the Build Trap and both helping companies scale product management through product ops.
bio.zh: 梅丽莎·佩里（Melissa Perri）与丹尼斯·蒂勒斯（Denise Tilles）是《产品运营》（Product Operations）一书的作者；梅丽莎以《逃离构建陷阱》（Escaping the Build Trap）闻名，二人都通过产品运营帮助公司扩展产品管理能力。

episodeTitle.en: Brian Chesky’s new playbook
episodeTitle.zh: 布莱恩·切斯基的新策略手册

bio.en: Brian Chesky is co-founder and CEO of Airbnb, which he grew from an apartment startup into an ~$80 billion global business operating in 220 countries.
bio.zh: Brian Chesky 是 Airbnb 联合创始人兼 CEO，他将公司从公寓里的创业项目发展成业务遍及 220 个国家、估值约 800 亿美元的全球化企业。

episodeTitle.en: Marketplace lessons from Uber, Airbnb, Bumble, and more | Ramesh Johari (Stanford professor)
episodeTitle.zh: 优步、Airbnb、Bumble等平台的市场经验 | 拉梅什·乔哈里（斯坦福大学教授）

bio.en: Ramesh Johari is a professor at Stanford University focused on the design and operation of online marketplaces, and has advised and worked with many of the world's largest marketplaces including Airbnb, Uber, Stripe, Bumble, and Stitch Fix.
bio.zh: Ramesh Johari 是斯坦福大学教授，研究方向为在线市场的设计与运营，曾为包括 Airbnb、Uber、Stripe、Bumble 和 Stitch Fix 在内的全球最大的一批市场平台提供咨询与合作。

episodeTitle.en: Mastering product strategy and growing as a PM | Maggie Crowley (Toast, Drift, TripAdvisor)
episodeTitle.zh: 《精通产品战略，成长为产品经理》| 玛吉·克劳利（Toast、Drift、TripAdvisor）

bio.en: Maggie Crowley is VP of Product at Toast and has held product leadership roles at Charlie Health, Drift, BevSpot, and TripAdvisor.
bio.zh: 玛吉·克劳利（Maggie Crowley）是 Toast 的产品副总裁，曾在 Charlie Health、Drift、BevSpot 和 TripAdvisor 担任产品领导职务。

episodeTitle.en: Unpacking Amazon’s unique ways of working | Bill Carr (author of Working Backwards)
episodeTitle.zh: 解读亚马逊独特的运营方式 | 比尔·卡尔（Bill Carr，《倒退工作法》作者）

bio.en: Bill Carr is co-author of 'Working Backwards' and a 15-year Amazon veteran who, as VP of Digital Media, launched and ran Amazon Music, Prime Video, and Amazon Studios before later serving as COO of OfferUp and founding the Working Backwards consulting firm.
bio.zh: Bill Carr 是《Working Backwards》的合著者，也是在亚马逊待了 15 年的老将。作为数字媒体副总裁，他发起并运营了 Amazon Music、Prime Video 和 Amazon Studios，之后担任 OfferUp 的 COO，并创立了 Working Backwards 咨询公司。

episodeTitle.en: Reflections on a movement | Eric Ries (creator of the Lean Startup methodology)
episodeTitle.zh: 制作和营销

bio.en: Eric Ries is the creator of the Lean Startup methodology and author of the influential book The Lean Startup; he is also founder and executive chairman of the Long-Term Stock Exchange, advising founders on building companies aligned with human flourishing.
bio.zh: Eric Ries 是“精益创业”（Lean Startup）方法论的创造者、畅销书《精益创业》的作者，同时是长期股票交易所（Long-Term Stock Exchange）的创始人兼执行董事长，致力于指导创始人打造与人类福祉相统一的企业。

episodeTitle.en: What AI means for your product strategy | Paul Adams (CPO of Intercom)
episodeTitle.zh: 人工智能对您产品战略意味着什么？ | 保罗·亚当斯（Intercom首席产品官）

bio.en: Paul Adams is Chief Product Officer at Intercom, a role he has held for over ten years, after previously serving as global head of brand design at Facebook, a user researcher at Google, and a product designer at Dyson.
bio.zh: Paul Adams 是 Intercom 的首席产品官（CPO），担任该职务已超过十年，此前曾任 Facebook 全球品牌设计负责人、Google 用户研究员，以及 Dyson 产品设计师。

episodeTitle.en: A step-by-step guide to crafting a sales pitch that wins | April Dunford (author of Sales Pitch)
episodeTitle.zh: 《打造致胜销售话术的分步指南 | 阿普里尔·邓福德（《销售话术》作者）》

bio.en: April Dunford is the world's foremost authority on product positioning and the bestselling author of "Obviously Awesome" and "Sales Pitch," with 25 years as a VP of marketing and advisor to companies like Google and Epic Games; she helps B2B companies translate positioning into sales stories that engage buyers, overcome indecision, and make it easier for customers to choose — and for the company to close more deals.
bio.zh: April Dunford 是全球最权威的产品定位专家、《Obviously Awesome》和《Sales Pitch》两本畅销书的作者，拥有 25 年营销 VP 和顾问经验，曾与 Google、Epic Games 等公司合作；她帮助 B2B 企业把「定位」翻译成能打动买家、克服犹豫不决的销售故事，让客户更容易做决定、也让公司显著提升销售转化。

episodeTitle.en: Scaling Duolingo, embracing failure, and insight into Latin America’s tech scene | Gina Gotthilf (Latitud, Duolingo)
episodeTitle.zh: 扩展Duolingo、拥抱失败及对拉丁美洲科技领域的洞察 | 吉娜·戈特利夫（Latitud，Duolingo）

bio.en: Gina Gotthilf led growth and marketing at Duolingo, helping grow it from 3 million to over 200 million users mostly through organic channels, and is now co-founder and COO of Latitude, backing the next generation of startups in Latin America.
bio.zh: Gina Gotthilf 曾在 Duolingo 负责增长与市场营销，主要通过自然增长渠道将其用户从 300 万做到超 2 亿，如今是 Latitude 的联合创始人兼 COO，致力于扶持拉丁美洲下一代科技创业公司。

episodeTitle.en: Building beautiful products with Stripe’s Head of Design | Katie Dill (Stripe, Airbnb, Lyft)
episodeTitle.zh: 用Stripe设计总监打造精美产品 | 凯蒂·迪尔（Stripe、Airbnb、Lyft）

bio.en: Katie Dill is the Head of Design at Stripe, overseeing product design, brand, research, and design operations, and previously led design at Lyft and Airbnb.
bio.zh: 凯蒂·迪尔（Katie Dill）是 Stripe 的设计负责人，统管产品设计、品牌、用户研究与设计运营，此前曾在 Lyft 和 Airbnb 领导设计团队。

episodeTitle.en: How to get press for your product | Jason Feifer (editor in chief of Entrepreneur magazine)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何为你的产品获取媒体关注 | 杰森·费弗（Jason Feifer，《创业家》杂志主编）

bio.en: Jason Feifer is editor-in-chief of Entrepreneur Magazine, a startup advisor, author, and podcast host who gets deeply tactical about how founders can earn press.
bio.zh: Jason Feifer 是《Entrepreneur》杂志的主编、创业顾问、作家兼播客主持人，他非常具体地讲解创始人如何获得媒体曝光。

episodeTitle.en: Inside Linear: Building with taste, craft, and focus | Karri Saarinen (co-founder, designer, CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: 《Linear内参：用品味、工艺与专注打造设计》|卡里·萨里宁（联合创始人、设计总监、CEO）

bio.en: Karri Saarinen is the co-founder and CEO of Linear, one of the most beloved issue-tracking tools for software teams, and was previously founding designer at Coinbase and principal designer at Airbnb.
bio.zh: 卡里·萨里宁（Karri Saarinen）是 Linear 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该产品是软件团队中最受青睐的任务追踪工具之一；他此前是 Coinbase 的创始设计师、Airbnb 的首席设计师。

episodeTitle.en: Brian Balfour: 10 lessons on career, growth, and life
episodeTitle.zh: 布莱恩·巴尔弗：关于职业、成长和生活的10个经验

bio.en: Brian Balfour is the founder and CEO of Reforge, formerly Head of Growth at HubSpot, who has lived through the rise and fall of every major distribution channel and now predicts a new AI-era distribution platform (likely ChatGPT) will open up within months.
bio.zh: Brian Balfour 是 Reforge 的创始人兼 CEO，曾任 HubSpot 增长负责人。他亲历了每个主要分发渠道的兴衰，现在预言一个 AI 时代的新分发平台（很可能是 ChatGPT）会在几个月内打开。

episodeTitle.en: What sets great teams apart | Lane Shackleton (CPO of Coda)
episodeTitle.zh: 《卓越团队的秘诀》 | 莱恩·沙克尔顿（Coda首席产品官）

bio.en: Lane Shackleton is the Chief Product Officer at Coda, where he has led product for over eight years, and previously was a Group Product Manager at YouTube.
bio.zh: 莱恩·沙克尔顿（Lane Shackleton）是 Coda 的首席产品官，已在产品岗位深耕八年多，此前是 YouTube 的产品组经理。

episodeTitle.en: Building Anchor, selling to Spotify, and lessons learned | Maya Prohovnik (Head of Podcast Product)
episodeTitle.zh: 构建锚点、向Spotify出售产品及经验教训 | 玛雅·普罗霍夫尼克（Maya Prohovnik，Podcast产品负责人）

bio.en: Maya Prohovnik was Spotify's Head of Product for podcasting, where she oversaw the product that powered Anchor's rapid hosting growth.
bio.zh: 玛雅·普罗霍夫尼克（Maya Prohovnik）曾任 Spotify 的播客产品负责人，主管驱动 Anchor 快速获取托管市场份额的产品。

episodeTitle.en: How to drive word of mouth | Nilan Peiris (CPO of Wise)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何驱动口碑传播 | 尼兰·皮里斯（Nilan Peiris，Wise首席产品官）

bio.en: Welcome to Lenny's Podcast, where I interview world-class product leaders and growth experts to learn from their hard won experiences building and growing today's most successful products.
