bio.zh: 欢迎来到Lenny的播客，我在节目中采访世界级的产品领袖和增长专家，从他们宝贵的经验中学习如何打造和发展当今最成功的产品。今天的嘉宾是Nilan Peiris。Nilan是Wise公司的首席产品官，他在Wise任职已有11年之久，

episodeTitle.en: Becoming evidence-guided | Itamar Gilad (Gmail, YouTube, Microsoft)
episodeTitle.zh: 以证据为导向 | 伊塔马尔·吉拉德（曾任谷歌、微软等公司产品高管）

bio.en: Itamar Gilad is a product coach, author, and former longtime Google product manager (Gmail, identity, YouTube) who just published Evidence-Guided: Creating High-Impact Products in the Face of Uncertainty.
bio.zh: Itamar Gilad 是一位产品教练、作家，也是谷歌的长期产品经理（Gmail、账号体系、YouTube），他刚出版了《Evidence-Guided: Creating High-Impact Products in the Face of Uncertainty》。

episodeTitle.en: How to become a category pirate | Christopher Lochhead (Author of Play Bigger, Niche Down, more)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何成为品类海盗 | 克里斯托弗·洛克黑德（《放大格局、深耕细分》等书作者）

bio.en: Christopher Lochhead is a three-time public company CMO, advisor to 50+ venture-backed startups, and the "Godfather of Category Design" — a 13-time number-one bestselling co-author (Play Bigger, Niche Down, The 22 Laws of Category Design) and co-creator of the Substack Category Pirates.
bio.zh: Christopher Lochhead 是一位三度任职上市公司 CMO、50 多家风投初创的顾问，以及"品类设计教父"——13 次登上榜首的畅销书合著者（《Play Bigger》《Niche Down》《品类设计 22 律》）和 Substack《Category Pirates》的联合创作者。

episodeTitle.en: Picking sharp problems, increasing virality, and unique product frameworks | Oji Udezue (Typeform)
episodeTitle.zh: 精准定位痛点、提升病毒式传播和独特的产品框架 | 奥吉·乌德祖（Typeform）

bio.en: Oji Udezue is Chief Product Officer at Typeform and a veteran product and growth leader who has built and scaled products at Microsoft, Atlassian, Calendly, and Twitter.
bio.zh: Oji Udezue 是 Typeform 的首席产品官（CPO），也是一位资深的产品与增长领袖，曾在 Microsoft、Atlassian、Calendly 和 Twitter 打造并扩展产品。

episodeTitle.en: When enough is enough | Andy Johns (ex-FB, Twitter, Quora)
episodeTitle.zh: 当适可而止时 | 安迪·约翰斯（前Facebook、Twitter、Quora员工）

bio.en: Andy Johns is a former legendary growth leader at Facebook, Twitter, Quora, and Wealthfront who left a path to CEO to become a mental-health advocate helping burned-out high achievers and veterans.
bio.zh: Andy Johns 曾是 Facebook、Twitter、Quora 和 Wealthfront 的传奇增长负责人，他放弃了成为 CEO 的职业路径，转而成为心理健康倡导者，帮助精疲力竭的高成就者和退伍军人。

episodeTitle.en: An inside look at Figma’s unique GTM motion | Claire Butler (first GTM hire)
episodeTitle.zh: Figma独特的GTM策略解析 | 克莱尔·巴特勒（首位GTM成员）

bio.en: Claire Butler was Figma's 10th employee and first marketing hire, leading its original launch, go-to-market, branding, and positioning, and continues to lead go-to-market and bottom-up growth.
bio.zh: Claire Butler 是 Figma 的第 10 号员工和首位营销员工，领导了其最初发布、进入市场、品牌与定位，并持续负责进入市场与自下而上的增长。

episodeTitle.en: Inside Etsy’s product, growth, and marketplace evolution | Tim Holley (VP of Product)
episodeTitle.zh: Etsy产品、增长与市场演进之路 | 蒂姆·霍利（VP of Product）

bio.en: Tim Holley is VP of Product at Etsy, where over 10+ years he helped grow GMV from around $500 million to over $13 billion.
bio.zh: Tim Holley 是 Etsy 的产品副总裁，在逾十年的时间里，他帮助该公司将 GMV（成交额）从约 5 亿美元增长到超过 130 亿美元。

episodeTitle.en: An inside look at Deel’s unprecedented growth | Meltem Kuran Berkowitz (Head of Growth)
episodeTitle.zh: Deel前所未有的增长内幕 | 梅尔特姆·库兰·伯科维茨（Meltem Kuran Berkowitz，增长部门负责人）

bio.en: Welcome to Lenny's Podcast where I interview world-class product leaders and growth experts to learn from their hard won experiences building and growing today's most successful products. Today my guest is Meltem Kuran Berkowitz. Meltem is head of growth at Deel, which is arguably the fastest growin
bio.zh: 欢迎来到 Lenny 的播客，在这里我会采访世界一流的产品负责人和增长专家，从他们打造和增长当今最成功产品的亲身经历中学习。今天的嘉宾是 Meltem Kuran Berkowitz。Meltem 是 Deel 的增长负责人，Deel 可以说是有史以来增长最快

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to JTBD | Bob Moesta (co-creator of the framework)
episodeTitle.zh: JTBD终极指南 | 鲍勃·莫埃斯塔（Bob Moesta，JTBD框架共同创始人）

bio.en: Bob Moesta is co-creator of the Jobs-to-be-Done framework alongside Clay Christensen and founder/CEO of the Rewired Group, helping companies unlock hidden insights to build successful products.
bio.zh: Bob Moesta 是与 Clay Christensen 共同创立“待办任务”（Jobs-to-be-Done）框架的人，也是 Rewired Group 的创始人兼 CEO，帮助企业发掘隐藏洞察以打造成功产品。

episodeTitle.en: Monetizing passions, scaling marketplaces, and stories from a creator economy vet | Camille Hearst
episodeTitle.zh: 在创作者经济中的先驱：如何将激情变现、扩展市场平台以及分享故事 | 卡米尔·赫斯特

bio.en: Camille Hearst is Head of Fan Monetization at Spotify, previously Head of Product for Creators at Patreon, product marketing manager at YouTube, and the second PM on iTunes, with a background as a founder.
bio.zh: Camille Hearst 是 Spotify 粉丝变现负责人，此前曾任 Patreon 创作者产品负责人、YouTube 产品营销经理，以及 iTunes 第二位产品经理，并有创始人经历。

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to Martech | Austin Hay (Reforge, Ramp, Runway)
episodeTitle.zh: 营销科技终极指南 | 奥斯汀·海（Austin Hay，Reforge、Ramp、Runway）

bio.en: Austin Hay is the Head of Marketing Technology at Ramp and a MarTech advisor to companies like Notion, Airbnb, and Walmart, who was the fourth employee at Branch Metrics and teaches Marketing Technology at Reforge.
bio.zh: Austin Hay是Ramp的营销技术负责人，曾是独角兽公司Branch Metrics的第4号员工，并为Notion、Airbnb、Walmart等公司提供MarTech战略顾问，同时在Reforge开设营销技术课程。

episodeTitle.en: Relentless curiosity, radical accountability, and HubSpot’s winning growth formula | Chris Miller
episodeTitle.zh: 永不止息的好奇心、彻底的责任感，以及HubSpot的制胜增长公式 | 克里斯·米勒

bio.en: Chris Miller is VP of Product for Growth and AI at HubSpot, where he helped create the company's early growth team and turned it into one of the most successful product-led growth businesses in history.
bio.zh: Chris Miller 是 HubSpot 增长与 AI 产品副总裁，他曾帮助创建公司的早期增长团队，并将其打造成史上最成功的产品驱动增长业务之一。

episodeTitle.en: Velocity over everything: How Ramp became the fastest-growing SaaS startup ever | Geoff Charles
episodeTitle.zh: 速度至上：Ramp如何成为增长最快的SaaS初创公司 | 杰夫·查尔斯

bio.en: Geoff Charles is VP of Product at Ramp, the fastest-growing SaaS business in history, which reached over $100 million in annual run rate within two years using a team of roughly 50 people.
bio.zh: Geoff Charles 是 Ramp 的产品副总裁；Ramp 是史上增长最快的 SaaS 公司，用约 50 人的团队在两年内达到超 1 亿美元年化经常性收入。

episodeTitle.en: How to measure and improve developer productivity | Nicole Forsgren (Microsoft Research, Github)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何衡量和提升开发者生产力 | 妮可·福斯格伦（微软研究院，Github）

bio.en: Nicole Forsgren is the developer productivity expert behind Accelerate and DORA metrics, helping organizations measure and improve how engineering teams deliver software.
bio.zh: 妮可·福斯格伦（Nicole Forsgren）是《Accelerate》与 DORA 指标背后的开发者生产力专家，帮助组织衡量并改进工程团队交付软件的方式。

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to A/B testing | Ronny Kohavi (Airbnb, Microsoft, Amazon)
episodeTitle.zh: 《A/B测试终极指南》| 罗尼·科哈维（Airbnb、微软、亚马逊）

bio.en: Ronny Kohavi is widely regarded as the world's leading expert on A/B testing and experimentation, formerly VP and Technical Fellow of Relevance at Airbnb, Corporate VP at Microsoft, and Director of Data Mining at Amazon, and author of Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments.
bio.zh: Ronny Kohavi 被公认为全球 A/B 测试与实验领域的顶尖专家，曾任 Airbnb 相关性副总裁兼技术研究员、微软公司副总裁、亚马逊数据挖掘总监，也是《可信在线受控实验》一书的作者。

episodeTitle.en: The 10 traits of great PMs, AI, and Slack’s approach to product | Noah Weiss (Slack, Google)
episodeTitle.zh: 伟大产品经理、人工智能和Slack的产品方法的10个特质 | 诺亚·韦斯（Slack、谷歌）

bio.en: Noah Weiss is Chief Product Officer at Slack, where he has spent the last seven years, after previously serving as Head of Product at Foursquare and as a product manager at Google and Fog Creek.
bio.zh: Noah Weiss 是 Slack 的首席产品官（CPO），已在那里工作七年，此前曾任 Foursquare 的产品负责人，以及 Google 与 Fog Creek 的产品经理。

episodeTitle.en: LinkedIn’s product evolution and the art of building complex systems | Hari Srinivasan (LinkedIn)
episodeTitle.zh: 领英的产品演进与复杂系统构建之道 | 哈里·斯里尼瓦桑（领英）

bio.en: Hari Srinivasan is VP of Product for LinkedIn's Talent Solutions—the company's largest business, spanning hiring and learning products—and has spent eight-plus years at LinkedIn shaping how the world's professionals find jobs.
bio.zh: Hari Srinivasan 是 LinkedIn 人才解决方案（Talent Solutions）业务的产品副总裁——这是 LinkedIn 最大的业务，涵盖招聘与学习类产品——他在 LinkedIn 任职八年多，深度参与了全球职场人求职方式的塑造。

episodeTitle.en: M&A, competition, pricing, and investing | Julia Schottenstein (dbt Labs)
episodeTitle.zh: 并购、竞争、定价与投资 | 朱莉娅·肖滕斯坦（dbt Labs）

bio.en: Julia Schottenstein is a product leader at dbt Labs, where she leads the dbt Cloud product, and previously held product roles at Facebook and Neural Magic.
bio.zh: 茱莉亚·舍滕施泰因（Julia Schottenstein）是 dbt Labs 的产品负责人，领导 dbt Cloud 产品，此前曾在 Facebook 和 Neural Magic 担任产品职务。

episodeTitle.en: How to ask the right questions, project confidence, and win over skeptics | Paige Costello (Asana)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何提出正确的问题、展现自信并赢得怀疑者 | 佩奇·科斯特洛（Asana）

bio.en: Paige Costello is a product lead at Asana overseeing the teams responsible for Asana's core product experience across desktop, web, and mobile, after previously serving as Director of Product at Intercom and Group Product Manager at Intuit.
bio.zh: Paige Costello 是 Asana 的产品负责人，领导负责 Asana 桌面端、网页端与移动端核心产品体验的团队，此前曾任 Intercom 产品总监以及 Intuit 的集团产品经理。

episodeTitle.en: Building minimum lovable products, stories from WeWork & Airbnb, and thriving as a PM | Jiaona Zhang
episodeTitle.zh: 《打造最小可爱产品——来自WeWork和Airbnb的故事，以及如何在产品经理岗位上蓬勃发展 | 庄佳诺》

bio.en: Jiaona Zhang (JZ) is Senior Vice President of Product at Webflow, a lecturer at Stanford teaching product management, and a longtime product leader at Airbnb, Dropbox, and WeWork.
bio.zh: Jiaona Zhang（JZ）是 Webflow 的产品高级副总裁、斯坦福产品管理课程讲师，也是在 Airbnb、Dropbox、WeWork 任职多年的产品负责人。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons from scaling Ramp | Sri Batchu (Ramp, Instacart, Opendoor)
episodeTitle.zh: 《Ramp扩展规模的经验教训 | 斯里·巴楚（Sri Batchu，Ramp、Instacart、Opendoor）》

bio.en: Sri Batchu is the Head of Growth at Ramp, the fastest-growing SaaS and FinTech company in history (which reached $100M in annualized revenue within two years), and previously served as Head of Growth at Instacart and VP of Operations at Opendoor.
bio.zh: Sri Batchu 是 Ramp 的增长负责人。Ramp 是史上增长最快的 SaaS 与金融科技公司——仅用两年就达到了 1 亿美元年化收入。在此之前，他曾任 Instacart 的增长负责人、Opendoor 的运营副总裁。

episodeTitle.en: Building high-performing teams | Melissa Tan (Webflow, Dropbox, Canva)
episodeTitle.zh: 打造高效团队 | 梅利莎·谭（Webflow、Dropbox、Canva）

bio.en: Melissa Tan was the longtime head of growth for Dropbox's B2B business and its first growth PM, later advising companies like Canva, Grammarly, and Miro on growth.
bio.zh: 梅丽莎·谭（Melissa Tan）曾是 Dropbox B2B 业务长期的增长负责人及第一位增长 PM，后来为 Canva、Grammarly、Miro 等公司提供增长咨询。

episodeTitle.en: Leveraging growth advisors, mastering SEO, and honing your craft | Luc Levesque (Shopify, Meta)
episodeTitle.zh: 借助增长顾问、精通SEO并磨练技艺 | 卢克·莱维斯克（Shopify、Meta）

bio.en: Luc Levesque is the Chief Growth Officer at Shopify and was personally recruited by Mark Zuckerberg to help grow Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp; he previously served as VP of Growth and GM at Tripadvisor and has advised companies like Twitter, Pinterest, Patreon, Thumbtack, and Canva on growth.
bio.zh: Luc Levesque 是 Shopify 的首席增长官（Chief Growth Officer），曾被 Mark Zuckerberg 亲自招揽去推动 Facebook Messenger、Instagram 和 WhatsApp 的增长；他此前担任 Tripadvisor 的增长副总裁兼总经理，并曾为 Twitter、Pinterest、Patreon、Thumbtack 和 Canva 等公司提供增长顾问。

episodeTitle.en: Building a long and meaningful career | Nikhyl Singhal (Meta, Google)
episodeTitle.zh: 打造长远且有意义的职业生涯 | 尼克尔·辛格尔（Meta、Google）

bio.en: Nikhyl Singhal has led large consumer and product teams at Google, Facebook, and Credit Karma, and is a former VP of Product at multiple influential companies.
bio.zh: 尼基尔·辛哈尔（Nikhyl Singhal）曾在 Google、Facebook 和 Credit Karma 领导大型消费级与产品团队，并担任过多个具影响力公司的产品副总裁。

episodeTitle.en: Moving fast and navigating uncertainty | Jeremy Henrickson (Rippling, Coinbase)
episodeTitle.zh: 快速行动并应对不确定性 | 杰里米·亨里克森（Rippling、Coinbase）

bio.en: Jeremy Henrickson is Senior Vice President of Product at Rippling, where he leads product and design, and was previously Chief Product Officer at Coinbase, where he oversaw 10x growth of the product and engineering orgs during a turbulent crypto period.
bio.zh: Jeremy Henrickson 是 Rippling 的产品高级副总裁，领导产品与设计团队，此前曾任 Coinbase 首席产品官，在加密市场剧烈波动的时期带领产品与工程组织实现了 10 倍增长。

episodeTitle.en: Storytelling with Nancy Duarte: How to craft compelling presentations and tell a story that sticks
episodeTitle.zh: 南希·杜阿尔特（Nancy Duarte）讲述故事：如何打造引人入胜的演示文稿，讲述令人难忘的故事

bio.en: Nancy Duarte is the CEO of Duarte Inc., which has created over 250,000 presentations for leaders including Apple, Google, and Al Gore, and author of books on the art of communication.
bio.zh: 南希·杜阿尔特（Nancy Duarte）是 Duarte 公司的 CEO，该公司为 Apple、Google、阿尔·戈尔等领导者创作了超过 25 万份演示文稿，她也著有关于沟通艺术的书籍。

episodeTitle.en: The power of strategic narrative | Andy Raskin
episodeTitle.zh: 战略叙事的力量 | 安迪·拉斯金

bio.en: Andy Raskin is a strategic-narrative expert who helps CEOs and company leaders align their teams around a simple story — a "strategic narrative" — that clarifies why customers need their product and unifies sales, marketing, product, and hiring; he has worked closely with founders and companies including Gong, Salesforce, Uber, Dropbox, Square, and IBM, and his post "The Greatest Sales Deck I've Ever Seen" is widely cited in business circles.
bio.zh: Andy Raskin 是一位战略叙事专家，帮助 CEO 和企业领导者用「战略叙事」这一简单故事让团队对齐——明确为什么客户需要他们的产品，并统一销售、市场、产品和招聘的方向；他曾与 Gong、Salesforce、Uber、Dropbox、Square、IBM 等公司密切合作，其文章《我见过最牛的销售 Deck》在商业圈广受引用。

episodeTitle.en: The science of product, big bets, and how AI is impacting the future of music | Gustav Söderström
episodeTitle.zh: 产品科学、大赌注以及人工智能如何影响音乐的未来 | 古斯塔夫·索德斯特伦（Gustav Söderström）

bio.en: Gustav Söderström is co-president, chief product officer, and chief technology officer at Spotify, where he oversees the company's global product and technology strategy across product, design, data, and engineering.
bio.zh: Gustav Söderström 是 Spotify 的联合总裁、首席产品官兼首席技术官，负责公司在产品、设计、数据与工程领域的全球产品与技术战略。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons on product sense, AI, the first mile experience, and the messy middle | Scott Belsky (Adobe)
episodeTitle.zh: 关于产品意识、人工智能、首英里体验和混沌中期的经验教训 | 斯科特·贝尔斯基（Scott Belsky，Adobe）

bio.en: Scott Belsky is a product legend - founder of Behance (sold to Adobe, where he rose to Chief Product Officer and later Chief Strategy Officer), author of The Messy Middle, and an active angel investor.
bio.zh: Scott Belsky 是一位产品传奇人物——Behance 的创始人（后被 Adobe 收购，他在那里升至首席产品官，后任首席战略官），《混乱的中段》（The Messy Middle）一书的作者，同时也是一位活跃的天使投资人。

episodeTitle.en: Frameworks for product differentiation, team building, and first principles thinking | Ayo Omojola
episodeTitle.zh: 《三体》

bio.en: Ayo Omojola is Chief Product Officer at Carbon Health and previously the founding product lead on Cash App's banking team at Square, where he co-created the Cash Card and scaled it into a nine-figure revenue line.
bio.zh: Ayo Omojola 是 Carbon Health 首席产品官，此前是 Square 旗下 Cash App 银行团队的创始产品负责人，共同打造了 Cash Card 并将其发展为上亿美元收入线。

episodeTitle.en: Mastering paid growth | Jonathan Becker (Thrive Digital)
episodeTitle.zh: 《付费增长攻略》|乔纳森·贝克尔（Jonathan Becker，Thrive Digital）

bio.en: Jonathan Becker is a legend of performance marketing whose agency Thrive Digital has planned and executed over $3.5 billion in paid acquisition for companies like Uber, Asana, Square, and MasterClass—this is Lenny's first deep dive into paid growth.
bio.zh: Jonathan Becker 是效果营销（performance marketing）领域的传奇人物，他的代理机构 Thrive Digital 已为 Uber、Asana、Square、Masterclass 等公司规划并执行了超 35 亿美元的付费获取预算——这是 Lenny 首次深入“付费增长”这一主题。

episodeTitle.en: Building a culture of excellence | David Singleton (CTO of Stripe)
episodeTitle.zh: 打造卓越文化 | 戴维·辛格尔顿（Stripe首席技术官）

bio.en: David Singleton is Chief Technology Officer at Stripe, guiding its engineering and design teams for over five years, previously VP of Engineering at Google.
bio.zh: David Singleton 是 Stripe 首席技术官，领导其工程与设计团队逾五年，此前曾任 Google 工程副总裁。

episodeTitle.en: How to achieve hypergrowth in your business and career | Carilu Dietrich (Atlassian)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何在业务与职业中实现超增长 | 卡里鲁·迪特里希（Atlassian）

bio.en: Carilu Dietrich is a former CMO who served as head of marketing at Atlassian through its IPO and has advised the CEOs and CMOs of hypergrowth B2B companies including Segment, Miro, 1Password, Bill.com, and Productboard.
bio.zh: Carilu Dietrich 是一位前首席营销官（CMO），在 Atlassian 上市期间担任其营销负责人，并曾为 Segment、Miro、1Password、Bill.com、Productboard 等超高速增长 B2B 公司的 CEO 与 CMO 提供顾问服务。

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to product-led sales | Elena Verna
episodeTitle.zh: 产品主导销售的终极指南 | 埃琳娜·维尔纳

bio.en: Elena Verna is a renowned growth advisor and former head of growth at companies like SurveyMonkey and Dropbox, best known for popularizing the "growth loops" framework and teaching growth strategy at Reforge.
bio.zh: Elena Verna 是知名的增长顾问，曾担任 SurveyMonkey、Dropbox 等公司的增长负责人，以推广"增长循环"（growth loops）框架和在 Reforge 讲授增长战略而闻名。

episodeTitle.en: An inside look at how Miro builds product | Varun Parmar (CPO of Miro)
episodeTitle.zh: 制作与营销

bio.en: Varun Parmar is Chief Product Officer at Miro and previously SVP and Chief Product Officer at Box, known for Miro's distinctive product culture.
bio.zh: Varun Parmar 是 Miro 的首席产品官（CPO），此前曾任 Box 的高级副总裁兼首席产品官，以 Miro 独具特色的产品文化而闻名。

episodeTitle.en: How to make better decisions and build a joyful career | Ada Chen Rekhi (Notejoy, LinkedIn)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何做出更明智的决策，打造愉悦的职业生涯 | 陈仁希（Notejoy、LinkedIn）

bio.en: Ada Chen Rekhi is an executive coach and co-founder of the note-taking product Notejoy, formerly SVP of Marketing at SurveyMonkey and an early LinkedIn marketing leader, who helps founders scale themselves.
bio.zh: Ada Chen Rekhi 是一位高管教练，也是笔记产品 Notejoy 的联合创始人，曾任 SurveyMonkey 营销高级副总裁及 LinkedIn 早期营销负责人，专注于帮助创始人实现自我成长。

episodeTitle.en: How to build a cult-like brand | Laura Modi (Bobbie)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何打造具有邪教般吸引力的品牌 | 劳拉·莫迪（Bobbie）

bio.en: Laura Modi is the co-founder and CEO of Bobbie, an organic infant-formula brand, and previously spent years at Airbnb leading hospitality and host community efforts.
bio.zh: 劳拉·莫迪（Laura Modi）是有机婴儿配方奶粉品牌 Bobbie 的联合创始人兼 CEO，此前在 Airbnb 工作多年，负责款待体验与房东社群。

episodeTitle.en: Product lessons from Waymo | Shweta Shrivastava (Waymo, Amazon, Cisco)
episodeTitle.zh: Waymo的产品经验启示 | 施维塔·什里瓦斯塔瓦（Waymo、亚马逊、思科）

bio.en: Shweta Shrivastava is Senior Director of Product Management at Waymo, the self-driving car company, and previously held product leadership roles at Amazon and Cisco.
bio.zh: Shweta Shrivastava 是自动驾驶公司 Waymo 的产品管理高级总监，此前曾在 Amazon 和 Cisco 担任产品领导职务。

episodeTitle.en: Driving alignment within teams, work-life balance, and the changing PM landscape | Nikita Miller
episodeTitle.zh: 推动团队内部协作、工作生活平衡及项目管理格局变革 | 尼基塔·米勒

bio.en: Nikita Miller is SVP of Product at The Knot Worldwide who previously led growth and retention at Trello for over five years and served as VP of Product at Dooly, and is also an angel investor and advisor.
bio.zh: Nikita Miller 是 The Knot Worldwide 的产品高级副总裁，此前曾在 Trello 担任增长与留存负责人逾五年，并在 Dooly 担任产品副总裁，同时也是一位天使投资人与顾问。

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to adding a PLG motion | Hila Qu (Reforge, GitLab)
episodeTitle.zh: PLG模式终极指南 | 胡佳琦（Reforge、GitLab）

bio.en: Hila Qu is a product-led growth expert best known for her two-part newsletter series on building a product-led growth motion—two of the most-read posts in Lenny's newsletter history—and for advising startups on activation, retention, and funnel optimization.
bio.zh: Hila Qu 是一位产品驱动增长（PLG）专家，她关于如何搭建 PLG 增长体系的两篇系列文章，是 Lenny newsletter 历史上阅读量最高的文章之二；她还就用户激活、留存与漏斗优化为众多初创公司提供顾问指导。

episodeTitle.en: Thinking beyond frameworks | Casey Winters (Pinterest, Eventbrite, Airbnb, Tinder, Reddit, Grubhub)
episodeTitle.zh: 超越框架的思考 | 凯西·温特斯（Pinterest、Eventbrite、Airbnb、Tinder、Reddit、Grubhub）

bio.en: Casey Winters is a growth and product strategist who has led growth or advised companies including Grubhub, Pinterest, Reddit, Eventbrite (as CPO), Canva, Airbnb, Tinder, and Thumbtack, and was the first repeat guest on Lenny's Podcast.
bio.zh: Casey Winters 是一位增长与产品战略专家，曾领导或与 Grubhub、Pinterest、Reddit、Eventbrite（任 CPO）、Canva、Airbnb、Tinder、Thumbtack 等公司合作或提供顾问，并且是 Lenny 播客第一个返场嘉宾。

episodeTitle.en: Taxi mafias, cash vaults & 100% MoM growth: The story of SEA’s biggest startup | Kevin Aluwi (Gojek)
episodeTitle.zh: 出租车黑手党、现金库与月增长率100%：东南亚最大初创企业的故事 | 凯文·阿鲁维（Gojek）

bio.en: Kevin Aluwi is the co-founder and former CEO of Gojek, the Indonesian super-app spanning ride-hailing, payments, and deliveries, which grew into one of Southeast Asia's most valuable startups.
bio.zh: 凯文·阿卢维（Kevin Aluwi）是 Gojek 的联合创始人兼前 CEO，Gojek 是印尼的一款超级应用，涵盖出行、支付与配送，已成长为东南亚最具价值的初创公司之一。

episodeTitle.en: Navigating comms and PR | Lulu Cheng Meservey (Substack, Activision Blizzard)
episodeTitle.zh: 《公关与传播力导航》| 程露思（Substack、动视暴雪）

bio.en: Lulu Cheng Meservey is a communications and PR strategist formerly heading comms at Substack and now advising companies on narrative and messaging.
bio.zh: 露露·程·梅瑟维（Lulu Cheng Meservey）是一位传播与公关策略专家，曾任 Substack 的传播负责人，如今为企业提供叙事与信息传达方面的咨询。

episodeTitle.en: Competing with giants: An inside look at how The Browser Company builds product | Josh Miller (CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: 与巨头竞争：浏览器公司打造产品的内部视角 | 乔希·米勒（CEO）

bio.en: Josh Miller is the co-founder and CEO of The Browser Company, the maker of the Arc web browser, and previously led product at TikTok's U.S. operations.
bio.zh: 乔什·米勒（Josh Miller）是 Arc 网页浏览器的开发商 The Browser Company 的联合创始人兼 CEO，此前曾负责 TikTok 美国区的产品业务。

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to OKRs | Christina Wodtke (Stanford)
episodeTitle.zh: OKR终极指南 | 克里斯蒂娜·沃特克（斯坦福大学）

bio.en: Christina Wodtke is a multi-time author, Stanford lecturer (product management, game design), and consultant who specializes in OKRs and product development processes, with product leadership experience at LinkedIn, MySpace, Zynga, and Yahoo.
bio.zh: Christina Wodtke 是多次著书者、斯坦福讲师（产品管理、游戏设计）和顾问，专长于 OKR 与产品开发流程，曾在 LinkedIn、MySpace、Zynga 和 Yahoo 担任产品领导。

episodeTitle.en: Hot takes and techno-optimism from tech’s top power couple | Sriram and Aarthi
episodeTitle.zh: 科技界顶级情侣的灼见与技术乐观主义 | 斯里拉姆（Sriram）与阿尔西（Aarthi）

bio.en: Sriram Krishnan and Aarthi Ramamurthy are the hosts of The Aarthi and Sriram Show; Sriram is a former Microsoft/Twitter exec and a16z partner (later a senior White House AI advisor), and Aarthi is a former Netflix, Spotify, and Microsoft product leader and founder of Latent.
bio.zh: Sriram Krishnan 与 Aarthi Ramamurthy 是《The Aarthi and Sriram Show》的主持人：Sriram 曾任 Microsoft/Twitter 高管与 a16z 合伙人（后任白宫高级 AI 顾问），Aarthi 则是前 Netflix、Spotify、Microsoft 产品领导者，也是 Latent 的创始人。

episodeTitle.en: Career frameworks, A/B testing, onboarding tips, selling to engineers |  Laura Schaffer (Amplitude)
episodeTitle.zh: 职业框架、A/B测试、上手指南、向工程师推销 | 劳拉·沙弗（Amplitude）

bio.en: Laura Schaffer is the Head of Growth at Amplitude, where she took over from Elena Verna, and a seasoned growth leader from prior roles at high-growth consumer products.
bio.zh: 劳拉·谢弗（Laura Schaffer）是 Amplitude 的增长负责人，接替了传奇人物 Elena Verna 的职位，也是一位在高速增长消费产品领域历练丰富的增长领导者。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons from scaling Stripe | Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-COO of Stripe)
episodeTitle.zh: 从扩展Stripe中吸取的经验教训 | 克莱尔·休斯·约翰逊（Stripe前COO）

bio.en: Claire Hughes Johnson was COO of Stripe for seven years, helping scale it from a startup to a legendary company, and previously spent a decade at Google; she's the author of Scaling People.
bio.zh: Claire Hughes Johnson 曾任 Stripe 首席运营官七年，帮助其从初创公司成长为传奇企业，此前在 Google 工作了十年；她是《Scaling People》一书的作者。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons from working with 600+ YC startups | Gustaf Alströmer (Y Combinator, Airbnb)
episodeTitle.zh: 从600多家YC初创公司中汲取经验 | 古斯塔夫·阿尔斯特罗默（Y Combinator、Airbnb）

bio.en: Gustaf Alstromer is a group partner at Y Combinator, where he has worked with 600+ startups, and previously started Airbnb's original growth team; he is also a driving force behind YC's focus on climate tech.
bio.zh: Gustaf Alstromer 是 Y Combinator 的集团合伙人，已辅导 600 多家初创公司，此前创办了 Airbnb 最初的增长团队；他也是 YC 聚焦气候科技的重要推动者。

episodeTitle.en: Behind the scenes of Calendly’s rapid growth | Annie Pearl (CPO)
episodeTitle.zh: Calendly快速增长的幕后故事 | 安妮·珀尔（首席产品官）

bio.en: Annie Pearl is Chief Product Officer at Calendly, previously CPO at Glassdoor and a product director at Fox, with experience across consumer and B2B product.
bio.zh: Annie Pearl 是 Calendly 首席产品官，此前曾任 Glassdoor 首席产品官及 Fox 产品总监，在消费级与 B2B 产品方面均有丰富经验。

episodeTitle.en: An inside look at how CNN builds product | Upasna Gautam
episodeTitle.zh: 《CNN产品打造之道》 | 乌帕斯纳·高塔姆

bio.en: Upasna Gautam is a product and technology leader at CNN, an investor, and an advisor who builds products inside a fast-moving newsroom.
bio.zh: Upasna Gautam 是 CNN 的产品与技术领导者、一位投资人与顾问，她在节奏飞快的新闻编辑室内部打造产品。

episodeTitle.en: 10 lessons on bootstrapping a $200m business | Patrick Campbell (ProfitWell)
episodeTitle.zh: 《如何白手起家打造价值2亿美元的企业 | 帕特里克·坎贝尔（ProfitWell）》

bio.en: I highly doubt it. I hope that doesn't happen. I've wanted to get you on this podcast ever since I started this podcast. It's always been on my list. You're just generally one of the smartest humans and most amazing humans I know, and so thank you for joining me on this podcast.
bio.zh: 我非常怀疑这一点。我希望这种情况不会发生。自从我开始做这个播客以来，我就一直想邀请你上节目。它一直在我的待办清单上。你无疑是我认识的最聪明、最了不起的人之一，所以感谢你能来参加我的播客。

episodeTitle.en: Understanding the role of product ops | Christine Itwaru (Pendo)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品运营角色的理解 | 克里斯汀·伊特瓦鲁（Pendo）

bio.en: Christine Itwaru is a long-time product ops leader at Pendo who transitioned into the role from product management and helps explain what product ops actually does.
bio.zh: Christine Itwaru 是 Pendo 长期的产品运营（product ops）负责人，从产品管理转岗而来，致力于解释产品运营到底做什么。

episodeTitle.en: Mastering onboarding | Lauryn Isford (Head of Growth at Airtable)
episodeTitle.zh: 《掌控入职流程 | 劳瑞恩·伊斯福德（Airtable增长负责人）》

bio.en: Lauryn Isford is a growth leader who was most recently Head of Growth at Airtable, and previously led product growth at Facebook and growth for Blue Bottle's e-commerce.
bio.zh: 劳琳·伊斯福德（Lauryn Isford）是一位增长负责人，最近担任 Airtable 的增长负责人，此前曾在 Facebook 领导产品增长，并负责 Blue Bottle 电商业务的增长。

episodeTitle.en: Leading with empathy | Keith Yandell (DoorDash, Uber)
episodeTitle.zh: 以同理心为先 | 基思·扬德尔（DoorDash、Uber）

bio.en: Keith Yandell is a longtime DoorDash leader who has run the company's legal, HR, customer support, marketing, and corporate development teams, and previously led litigation at Uber.
bio.zh: 基思·扬德尔（Keith Yandell）是 DoorDash 的资深领导者，曾执掌公司的法务、人力资源、客户支持、市场营销以及企业发展团队，此前在 Uber 负责诉讼业务。

episodeTitle.en: AI and product management | Marily Nika (Meta, Google)
episodeTitle.zh: AI与产品管理 | 玛丽莉·尼卡（Meta、谷歌）

bio.en: Marily Nika is an AI Product Lead at Meta (Reality Labs) and was an AI product manager at Google for eight years; she holds a PhD in Machine Learning and teaches AI Product Management.
bio.zh: 玛丽丽·尼卡（Marily Nika）是 Meta（Reality Labs）的 AI 产品负责人，此前在 Google 做了八年 AI 产品经理；她拥有机器学习博士学位，并教授 AI 产品管理课程。

episodeTitle.en: How to foster innovation and big thinking | Eeke de Milliano (Retool, Stripe)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何培育创新与大胆思维 | 伊克·德·米利亚诺（Retool、Stripe）

bio.en: Eeke de Milliano is the head of product at Retool and was one of Stripe's earliest product managers, where she helped build foundational products like Stripe Checkout, Connect, Radar, and Chargeback Protection.
bio.zh: Eeke de Milliano 是 Retool 的产品负责人，也是 Stripe 最早的产品经理之一，曾参与打造 Stripe Checkout、Connect、Radar 和 Chargeback Protection 等基础产品。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons from Airtable’s unconventional growth strategy | Zoelle Egner
episodeTitle.zh: Airtable非传统增长策略的启示 | 佐尔·埃格纳

bio.en: Zoelle Egner was one of the earliest employees at Airtable (leading early marketing and customer success), later advised dozens of startups, and is now head of marketing and growth at Block Party.
bio.zh: Zoelle Egner 是 Airtable 最早的员工之一（领导早期营销与客户成功团队），后来为数十家初创公司提供顾问服务，如今是 Block Party 的营销与增长负责人。

episodeTitle.en: An inside look at Mixpanel’s product journey | Vijay Iyengar
episodeTitle.zh: Mixpanel产品历程解析 | 维贾伊·伊扬加尔

bio.en: Vijay Iyengar is Head of Product at Mixpanel, and like Lenny came from an engineering background before moving into product.
bio.zh: Vijay Iyengar 是 Mixpanel 的产品负责人，和 Lenny 一样，他也是从工程背景转向产品的。

episodeTitle.en: How to nail your product positioning | April Dunford (Obviously Awesome)
episodeTitle.zh: 《如何精准定位你的产品 | 阿普里尔·邓福德（Obviously Awesome）》

bio.en: April Dunford is the author of "Obviously Awesome" and one of the world's leading product-positioning experts, with 25 years as a B2B VP of marketing and 200+ tech companies advised (including Epic Games and Google); she turned her five-step positioning method — competitive alternatives, differentiated capabilities, value themes, best-fit customers, market category — into a book that helps founders, PMs, and GTM teams turn positioning from a fuzzy concept into an executable sales story.
bio.zh: April Dunford 是《Obviously Awesome》的作者、全球最权威的产品定位专家之一，拥有 25 年 B2B 营销 VP 经验，合作过 200 多家科技公司（含 Epic Games、Google 等）；她把自己的「五步定位法」（竞争替代方案→差异化能力→价值主题→最佳契合客户→市场品类）写成书，帮助创始人、PM 和 GTM 团队把「定位」从模糊的概念变成可执行的销售故事。

episodeTitle.en: How to build your product strategy stack | Ravi Mehta (Tinder, Facebook, Tripadvisor, Outpace)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何构建你的产品战略体系 | 拉维·梅塔（Tinder、Facebook、Tripadvisor、Outpace）

bio.en: Ravi Mehta is co-founder and CEO of Outpace and a veteran product leader who was Chief Product Officer at Tinder, Product Director at Facebook, and VP of Product at Tripadvisor.
bio.zh: Ravi Mehta 是 Outpace 的联合创始人兼 CEO，也是一位资深产品领导者，曾任 Tinder 首席产品官、Facebook 产品总监，以及 Tripadvisor 产品副总裁。

episodeTitle.en: What differentiates the highest-performing product teams | John Cutler (The Beautiful Mess)
episodeTitle.zh: 高绩效产品团队的秘诀 | 约翰·卡特勒（John Cutler，The Beautiful Mess）

bio.en: John Cutler is one of the most prolific and beloved writers on product management online and a product evangelist at Amplitude, where his unique role has put him in front of a huge share of the world's product teams; he explores what separates high-performing teams from the rest.
bio.zh: John Cutler 是网络上最高产、最受喜爱的产品管理写作者之一，也是 Amplitude 的产品布道师；他独特的工作角色让他接触到了全球很大比例的产品团队，他致力于探究高效团队与普通团队的区别。

episodeTitle.en: How to price your product | Naomi Ionita (Menlo Ventures)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何为你的产品定价 | 娜奥米·伊奥尼塔（Naomi Ionita，Menlo Ventures）

bio.en: Naomi Ionita is a Partner at Menlo Ventures, was one of the first B2B product-led growth leaders at Evernote and Invoice2go, and an early mentor at Reforge.
bio.zh: 娜奥米·约尼塔（Naomi Ionita）是 Menlo Ventures 的合伙人，曾是 Evernote 与 Invoice2go 最早的一批 B2B 产品驱动增长（PLG）领导者，也是 Reforge 的早期导师。

episodeTitle.en: An inside look at how Figma builds product | Yuhki Yamashita (CPO of Figma)
episodeTitle.zh: 内部视角：Figma如何打造产品 | 山下勇希（Yuhki Yamashita，Figma首席产品官）

bio.en: Yuhki Yamashita is Chief Product Officer at Figma, previously led the redesign of Uber's rider/driver apps and the YouTube iOS app at Google/Microsoft.
bio.zh: Yuhki Yamashita 是 Figma 的首席产品官（CPO），此前曾领导 Uber 乘客/司机端应用的改版，以及 Google/Microsoft 时期的 YouTube iOS 应用。

episodeTitle.en: Leveraging mentors to uplevel your career | Jules Walter (YouTube, Slack)
episodeTitle.zh: 借助导师助力提升职业生涯 | 朱尔斯·沃尔特（YouTube、Slack）

bio.en: Jules Walter is a product leader at YouTube who was Slack's first growth PM and later led its monetization and mobile teams, and co-founded nonprofits expanding diversity in tech.
bio.zh: 朱尔斯·沃尔特（Jules Walter）是 YouTube 的产品负责人，曾是 Slack 的第一位增长产品经理，后来领导其变现与移动团队，并联合创办了推动科技行业多样性的非营利组织。

episodeTitle.en: Countdown of the top 10 episodes of the year
episodeTitle.zh: 年度十大播客集锦

bio.en: A special year-end episode in which Lenny Rachitsky counts down the 10 most popular conversations from the podcast's first 50 episodes, replaying the most insightful clips from each.
bio.zh: 这是一期特别的年终回顾节目：Lenny Rachitsky 盘点了播客前 50 期中最受欢迎的 10 期对话，并重温了其中最具启发性的片段。

episodeTitle.en: Launching and growing a podcast | Chris Hutchins (All the Hacks, Wealthfront, Google)
episodeTitle.zh: 推出并发展播客 | 克里斯·哈钦斯（Chris Hutchins，All the Hacks、Wealthfront、谷歌）

bio.en: Chris Hutchins is a former product manager, founder, and investor who went full-time on his podcast All the Hacks, and is head of new product strategy at Wealthfront.
bio.zh: Chris Hutchins 是一位前产品经理、创始人和投资人，现已全职投入他的播客《All the Hacks》，并任 Wealthfront 新产品战略负责人。

episodeTitle.en: Founder-led sales | Pete Kazanjy (Founding Sales, Atrium)
episodeTitle.zh: 创始人主导销售 | 皮特·卡赞吉（Atrium公司创始人销售总监）

bio.en: Pete Kazanjy is the author of Founding Sales - the book Lenny recommends to every B2B founder - and runs the Modern Sales Pros community; he is also CEO and founder of Atrium, a sales-analytics SaaS.
bio.zh: Pete Kazanjy 是《创始销售》（Founding Sales）一书的作者——这本书是 Lenny 推荐给每一位 B2B 创始人的必读——他运营着 Modern Sales Pros 销售社区，同时也是销售分析 SaaS 公司 Atrium 的创始人兼 CEO。

episodeTitle.en: How Notion leveraged community to build a $10B business | Camille Ricketts
episodeTitle.zh: Notion如何借助社区力量打造千亿美元业务 | 卡米尔·里基茨

bio.en: Camille Ricketts was the first marketing hire and longtime head of marketing at Notion, previously head of content and marketing at First Round Capital (launching First Round Review) and did comms/PR at early Tesla.
bio.zh: Camille Ricketts 是 Notion 的第一位营销员工和长期营销负责人，此前曾任 First Round Capital 内容与营销负责人（推出 First Round Review），并在早期 Tesla 负责传播与公关。

episodeTitle.en: The art and science of pricing | Madhavan Ramanujam (Monetizing Innovation, Simon-Kucher)
episodeTitle.zh: 定价的艺术与科学 | 马达万·拉马努贾姆（《创新变现》，西蒙-库彻出版社）

bio.en: Welcome to Lenny's Podcast. I'm Lenny and my goal here is to help you get better at the craft of building and growing products. Today my guest is Madhavan Ramanujam. Madhavan is the author of Monetizing Innovation, the most widely read book on pricing strategy. He's also Senior Partner at Simon-Kuch
bio.zh: 欢迎来到Lenny的播客。我是Lenny，我的目标是帮助你提升打造和发展产品的技能。今天的嘉宾是Madhavan Ramanujam。Madhavan是《创新变现》一书的作者，该书是关于定价策略的最畅销著作。他还是Simon-Kucher & Partners的资深合伙人。

episodeTitle.en: How to hit revenue targets in a recession | Sahil Mansuri (Bravado)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何在经济衰退中实现收入目标 | 萨希尔·曼苏里（Bravado）

bio.en: Sahil Mansuri is the CEO and founder of Bravado, which built the world's largest online sales community of over 300,000 salespeople and now builds SaaS tools for sellers, drawing on his own background as a longtime salesperson.
bio.zh: Sahil Mansuri 是 Bravado 的创始人兼 CEO，Bravado 打造了拥有超 30 万销售人员的全球最大在线销售社区，并正基于此为销售者打造 SaaS 工具；他本人也有着资深销售员的背景。

episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to SEO | Ethan Smith (Graphite)
episodeTitle.zh: SEO终极指南 | 伊桑·史密斯（Graphite）

bio.en: Ethan Smith is the CEO of Graphite, a leading SEO and answer-engine-optimization (AEO) agency, and one of the most sought-after experts on how to get products to show up as answers inside LLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. With 18 years of SEO experience dating back to 2007, he advises many top B2B SaaS and e-commerce companies on capturing the fast-growing answer-engine channel.
bio.zh: Ethan Smith 是 Graphite 的 CEO，一家领先的 SEO 与答案引擎优化（AEO）机构，也是关于"如何让产品作为答案出现在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 这类 LLM 里"最抢手的专家之一。他拥有自 2007 年起 18 年的 SEO 经验，为许多顶级 B2B SaaS 和电商公司提供顾问，帮它们抓住这个快速增长中的答案引擎渠道。

episodeTitle.en: How to be the best coach to product people | Petra Wille (Strong Product People)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何成为产品团队最佳教练 | 佩特拉·威尔（Petra Wille，Strong Product People）

bio.en: Petra Wille is an independent product leadership coach and author of Strong Product People, who for a decade has helped product teams and their managers level up, focusing on the crucial first-line manager layer.
bio.zh: Petra Wille 是一位独立的产品领导力教练，也是《强势产品人才》（Strong Product People）一书的作者，十年来一直帮助产品团队及其管理者提升能力，尤其专注于至关重要的“一线经理”层级。

episodeTitle.en: What it takes to become a top 1% PM | Ian McAllister (Uber, Amazon, Airbnb)
episodeTitle.zh: 成为顶级1%产品经理需要具备哪些条件 | 伊恩·麦卡利斯特（曾任Uber、亚马逊、Airbnb高管）

bio.en: Ian McAllister is the author of the classic product-management essay 'What Separates a Top 1% PM from a Top 10% PM,' a 12-year Amazon veteran who built Amazon Smile and grew Alexa internationally, and now leads global product for Uber's vehicles platform.
bio.zh: Ian McAllister 是经典产品经理文章《是什么让前 1% 的 PM 区别于前 10% 的 PM》的作者，在亚马逊任职 12 年、打造了 Amazon Smile 并推动 Alexa 国际化，如今领导 Uber 车辆平台的全球产品。

episodeTitle.en: Leaving big tech to build the #1 technology newsletter | Gergely Orosz (The Pragmatic Engineer)
episodeTitle.zh: 离开大型科技公司，创办头号科技新闻通讯 | 格尔盖利·奥罗兹（The Pragmatic Engineer）

bio.en: Gergely Orosz is the author of The Pragmatic Engineer, the top engineering newsletter on Substack, which he writes full-time after leaving a senior engineering role at Uber.
bio.zh: Gergely Orosz 是《The Pragmatic Engineer》的作者，这是 Substack 上排名第一的工程师 newsletter，他在离开 Uber 的高级工程职位后全职写作。

episodeTitle.en: An inside look at how the New York Times builds product | Alex Hardiman (CPO, the New York Times)
episodeTitle.zh: 《纽约时报》产品内幕解析 | 亚历克斯·哈迪曼（纽约时报首席产品官）

bio.en: Alex Hardiman is Chief Product Officer at The New York Times, leading teams building news, cooking, games, audio, and advertising products, previously CPO at The Atlantic and a product leader at Facebook.
bio.zh: Alex Hardiman 是《纽约时报》首席产品官，领导构建新闻、烹饪、游戏、音频及广告产品的团队，此前曾任《大西洋月刊》首席产品官及 Facebook 产品负责人。

episodeTitle.en: How to work through fear, give hard feedback, and doing layoffs with grace | Matt Mochary
episodeTitle.zh: 如何克服恐惧、给予坦诚反馈，并优雅地进行裁员 | 马特·莫查里

bio.en: Matt Mochary is a renowned executive coach who has worked with the CEOs of OpenAI, Coinbase, Reddit, Rippling, and Notion, and authored the widely-shared CEO training document.
bio.zh: 马特·莫查里（Matt Mochary）是一位知名的高管教练，曾辅导 OpenAI、Coinbase、Reddit、Rippling、Notion 等公司的 CEO，并撰写了被广泛传播的首席执行官培训文档。

episodeTitle.en: How Snyk built a product-led growth juggernaut | Ben Williams (VP of Product at Snyk)
episodeTitle.zh: Snyk如何打造产品主导的增长引擎 | 本·威廉姆斯（Snyk产品副总裁）

bio.en: Ben Williams is VP of Product at Snyk, where he built the company's developer-growth organization and helped scale the developer-first security platform from an early-stage startup into an $8.6B-valued leader serving millions of developers.
bio.zh: Ben Williams 是 Snyk 的产品副总裁，他在那里搭建了公司的开发者增长组织，并帮助这家“开发者优先”的安全平台从早期初创公司成长为估值 86 亿美元、服务数百万开发者的行业领军者。

episodeTitle.en: Lessons from one of the world’s top executive recruiters | Lauren Ipsen (Daversa Partners, GC)
episodeTitle.zh: 全球顶级高管猎头公司的经验之谈 | 劳伦·伊普森（Daversa Partners，首席法务官）

bio.en: Lauren Ipsen is a veteran people and talent leader who has built and scaled hiring and talent functions at high-growth technology companies.
bio.zh: 劳伦·伊普森（Lauren Ipsen）是一位资深的人力资源与人才领导者，曾在多家高增长的科技公司搭建并扩展招聘与人才体系。

episodeTitle.en: Building Substack | Sachin Monga (Substack, Facebook)
episodeTitle.zh: Substack平台建设 | 萨钦·蒙加（Substack、Facebook）

bio.en: Sachin Monga is Head of Product at Substack, which he joined via the acquisition of his startup Cocoon, and previously spent over seven years at Facebook working on video, the developer platform, and the ads growth team.
bio.zh: Sachin Monga 是 Substack 的产品负责人，他通过自己初创公司 Cocoon 被收购而加入 Substack，此前曾在 Facebook 工作逾七年，负责视频、开发者平台与广告增长团队。

episodeTitle.en: Category creation and brand building | Barbra Gago (Pando, Miro, Greenhouse, Culture Amp)
episodeTitle.zh: 类别创造与品牌建设 | 芭芭拉·加戈（Barbra Gago，Pando、Miro、Greenhouse、Culture Amp）

bio.en: Barbra Gago is founder and CEO of Pando, a career-progression platform democratizing promotion and feedback, previously CMO and Global Head of Marketing at Miro and VP of Marketing at Greenhouse.
bio.zh: Barbra Gago 是 Pando 的创始人兼 CEO，Pando 是一个让晋升与反馈更普惠的职业发展平台，此前曾任 Miro 首席营销官兼全球市场负责人，以及 Greenhouse 营销副总裁。

episodeTitle.en: How to build trust and grow as a product leader | Fareed Mosavat (Reforge, Slack, Instacart, Pixar)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何建立信任并成长为产品领导者 | 法里德·莫萨瓦特（Reforge、Slack、Instacart、Pixar）

bio.en: Fareed Mosavat is the Chief Development Officer at Reforge and a veteran product leader who, before Reforge, led growth at Slack and Instacart, served as VP of Product at Runkeeper and GM at Zynga, and spent six years building 3D animation tools at Pixar.
bio.zh: Fareed Mosavat 是 Reforge 的首席发展官（Chief Development Officer），也是一位资深产品负责人；在加入 Reforge 之前，他曾在 Slack 和 Instacart 主导增长，担任 Runkeeper 的产品副总裁、Zynga 的总经理，并在皮克斯工作了六年，开发 3D 动画工具。

episodeTitle.en: Humanizing product development | Adriel Frederick (Reddit, Lyft, Facebook)
episodeTitle.zh: 人性化产品开发 | 阿德里尔·弗雷德里克（Reddit、Lyft、Facebook）

bio.en: Adriel Frederick is VP of Product at Reddit (Reddit X), where he incubates and scales new products, previously serving as Director of Product at Lyft (marketplace and pricing) and an early product manager at Facebook focused on user acquisition.
bio.zh: Adriel Frederick 是 Reddit（Reddit X）的产品副总裁，负责孵化并扩展新产品，此前曾任 Lyft 产品总监（负责市场与定价团队）以及 Facebook 早期专注用户获取的产品经理。

episodeTitle.en: Building better roadmaps | Janna Bastow (Mind the Product, ProdPad)
episodeTitle.zh: 构建更优路线图 | 詹娜·巴斯托（Janna Bastow，Mind the Product，ProdPad）

bio.en: Janna Bastow is co-founder and CEO of ProdPad, the product management tool, and co-creator of Mind the Product, the global product management community and conference series.
bio.zh: Janna Bastow 是产品管理工具 ProdPad 的联合创始人兼 CEO，也是全球产品管理社区与会议系列 Mind the Product 的共同创办人。

episodeTitle.en: How to build a high-performing growth team | Adam Fishman (Patreon, Lyft, Imperfect Foods)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何打造高效增长团队 | 亚当·菲什曼（Patreon、Lyft、Imperfect Foods）

bio.en: Adam Fishman is a veteran growth and product leader who was Lyft's first growth hire, later led product and growth at Patreon where he helped build one of the most successful creator platforms, and today advises companies and teaches growth through his newsletter and Reforge.
bio.zh: Adam Fishman 是一位资深的增长与产品领导者，曾是 Lyft 最早的 growth 招聘员工，后来在 Patreon 主导产品与增长、参与打造业内最成功的创作者平台之一，如今通过他的 Newsletter 和 Reforge 为企业做顾问并教授增长。

episodeTitle.en: Developing a growth model + marketplace growth strategy | Dan Hockenmaier
episodeTitle.zh: 构建增长模型与市场增长策略 | 丹·霍肯迈尔

bio.en: Dan Hockenmaier is VP of Growth at Faire, a B2B marketplace for independent retailers, where he owns growth modeling and marketplace strategy; before Faire he led growth at Thumbtack and founded Basis One, a consultancy that built growth models for 20-30 startups.
bio.zh: Dan Hockenmaier 是 Faire 的增长副总裁。Faire 是一个面向独立零售商的 B2B 市场，他在那里负责增长建模与市场策略；加入 Faire 之前，他在 Thumbtack 领导增长，并创立了 Basis One——一家为二三十家创业公司搭建增长模型的咨询公司。

episodeTitle.en: Build better products with continuous product discovery | Teresa Torres
episodeTitle.zh: 通过持续产品探索打造更优质产品 | 特蕾莎·托雷斯

bio.en: Teresa Torres is a product discovery coach and the author of Continuous Discovery Habits, who has helped thousands of product teams adopt a continuous discovery practice.
bio.zh: Teresa Torres 是一位产品发现（discovery）教练，也是《持续发现习惯》（Continuous Discovery Habits）一书的作者，她已帮助数千支产品团队建立起持续发现的工作方法。

episodeTitle.en: Using behavioral science to improve your product | Kristen Berman (Irrational Labs)
episodeTitle.zh: 利用行为科学优化产品 | 克里斯汀·伯曼（Irrational Labs）

bio.en: Kristen Berman is the CEO and co-founder of Irrational Labs, a behavioral-design firm that helps companies like Google, Airbnb, and Microsoft build better products, and co-founded the Common Cents Lab at Duke.
bio.zh: 克里斯滕·伯曼（Kristen Berman）是行为设计公司 Irrational Labs 的 CEO 兼联合创始人，该公司帮助 Google、Airbnb、微软等企业打造更好的产品；她还联合创办了杜克大学的 Common Cents Lab。

episodeTitle.en: Customer-led growth | Georgiana Laudi (Forget The Funnel)
episodeTitle.zh: 《客户主导的增长》 | 乔治亚娜·劳迪（Georgiana Laudi，Forget The Funnel）

bio.en: Gia Laudi (Georgiana Laudi) is the founder of the consultancy Forget The Funnel, where she works hands-on with SaaS companies to diagnose their biggest growth bottlenecks and frequently doubles or triples conversion across their product flows.
bio.zh: Gia Laudi（Georgiana Laudi）是咨询公司 Forget The Funnel 的创始人，她亲手帮助 SaaS 公司诊断最大的增长瓶颈，并常常将其产品流程中的转化率提升两到三倍。

episodeTitle.en: Growth tactics, retention strategies, and becoming a better writer | Julian Shapiro (Demand Curve, Hyper, Webflow, TechCrunch)
episodeTitle.zh: 朱利安·夏皮罗（Julian Shapiro）：增长策略、留存策略与提升写作能力 | （Demand Curve、Hyper、Webflow、TechCrunch）

bio.en: Julian Shapiro is the founder of Demand Curve, a growth-training company that has helped thousands of startups with their growth strategy, and previously wrote the growth column at TechCrunch and led marketing at Webflow.
bio.zh: 朱利安·夏皮罗（Julian Shapiro）是增长培训公司 Demand Curve 的创始人，已帮助数千家初创公司制定增长战略；他此前曾为 TechCrunch 撰写增长专栏，并担任 Webflow 的市场营销副总裁。

episodeTitle.en: Why product-led growth is the future | Elena Verna (Amplitude, Miro, Surveymonkey)
episodeTitle.zh: 为何产品主导增长是未来趋势 | 埃琳娜·维尔纳（Amplitude、Miro、Surveymonkey）

bio.en: Elena Verna is a world-leading growth and monetization expert who has scaled product-led growth and product-led sales at companies including Amplitude, Miro, SurveyMonkey, MongoDB, and Netlify, and teaches experimentation and growth at Reforge.
bio.zh: Elena Verna 是世界领先的增长与变现专家，曾在 Amplitude、Miro、SurveyMonkey、MongoDB、Netlify 等公司规模化地打造产品驱动增长与产品驱动销售，并在 Reforge 教授实验与增长课程。

episodeTitle.en: Building a meaningful career | Jason Shah (Airbnb, Amazon, Microsoft, Alchemy)
episodeTitle.zh: 构建有意义的职业生涯 | 杰森·沙阿（Jason Shah，Airbnb、亚马逊、微软、Alchemy）

bio.en: Jason Shah is a product leader whom Lenny worked with at Airbnb and who later led product in Web3; he shares deep, tactical advice on leadership, hiring, pushing back on your CEO, and advancing your career.
bio.zh: Jason Shah 是一位产品负责人，Lenny 曾在 Airbnb 与他共事，他后来也在 Web3 领域领导产品；他分享了关于领导力、招聘、如何对 CEO 说“不”、以及职业晋升的深入而具体的建议。

episodeTitle.en: When to invest in new acquisition channels | Adam Grenier (Uber, MasterClass)
episodeTitle.zh: 何时投资新获客渠道 | 亚当·格雷尼尔（Adam Grenier，优步、MasterClass）

bio.en: Adam Grenier is a growth and marketing leader who built Uber's growth marketing team and infrastructure from scratch, served as VP of Product and Marketing at Lambda School and VP of Marketing at MasterClass, and now advises companies and invests while shaping the emerging "Growth CMO" model.
bio.zh: Adam Grenier 是一位增长与营销领导者，曾在 Uber 从零搭建增长营销团队与基础设施、担任 Lambda School 产品与营销 VP 及 MasterClass 营销 VP，如今作为顾问和投资人在新兴获客渠道与「增长型 CMO」理念上影响行业。

episodeTitle.en: How to build a powerful marketing machine | Emily Kramer (Asana, Carta, MKT1)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何打造强大的营销机器 | Emily Kramer（Asana、Carta、MKT1）

bio.en: Emily Kramer is a B2B marketing leader who built and led the early marketing teams at Asana, Carta, Ticketfly, and Astro (acquired by Slack), writes the popular MKT1 newsletter, and now advises, invests in, and runs a fund for early-stage B2B startups.
bio.zh: Emily Kramer 是一位 B2B 营销负责人，曾在 Asana、Carta、Ticketfly 和 Astro（被 Slack 收购）从零搭建并带领早期营销团队，运营广受欢迎的 MKT1 通讯，现在为早期 B2B 初创提供顾问、投资，并管理一支相关基金。

episodeTitle.en: Overcome imposter syndrome and accelerate your career | Julie Zhuo (Sundial, Facebook)
episodeTitle.zh: 克服冒名顶替综合症，加速职业发展 | 朱莉·卓（Sundial，Facebook）

bio.en: Julie Zhuo spent 13 years at Facebook, rising from an individual-contributor designer to VP of Product Design, and is the bestselling author of The Making of a Manager.
bio.zh: 朱莉·卓（Julie Zhuo）在 Facebook 工作了 13 年，从一线设计师成长为产品设计副总裁，并著有畅销书《创作者之路》（The Making of a Manager）。

episodeTitle.en: The role of AI in new product development | Ryan J. Salva (VP of Product at GitHub)
episodeTitle.zh: 人工智能在新产品开发中的作用 | Ryan J. Salva（GitHub产品副总裁）

bio.en: Ryan J. Salva is VP of Product at GitHub, where he incubated and launched GitHub Copilot - one of the most transformative developer tools of the decade - and previously spent a decade at Microsoft and started in philosophy and English.
bio.zh: Ryan J. Salva 是 GitHub 的产品副总裁，在 GitHub 他孵化并推出了 GitHub Copilot——十年来最具变革性的开发者工具之一——此前他在微软工作十年，学术背景始于哲学与英语。

episodeTitle.en: How to grow a subscription business | Yuriy Timen (Grammarly, Canva, Airtable)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何发展订阅业务 | 尤里·蒂门（Yuriy Timen，曾就职于Grammarly、Canva、Airtable）

bio.en: Yuriy Timen is a growth advisor who spent eight and a half years at Grammarly building its growth and marketing function into the household-name brand it is today; he now advises 4-5 subscription and consumerized B2B companies at a time (including Canva, Airtable, Otter, Hims, and Flow Health) on finding and scaling their core growth engines.
bio.zh: Yuriy Timen 是一位增长顾问。他在 Grammarly 待了八年半，把公司的增长和营销体系打造成了今天这个人尽皆知的品牌；如今他一次同时辅导 4 到 5 家订阅型和“消费化”的 B2B 公司（包括 Canva、Airtable、Otter、Hims、Flow Health 等），帮它们找到并放大核心增长引擎。

episodeTitle.en: Persuasive communication and managing up | Wes Kao (Maven, altMBA, Section4)
episodeTitle.zh: 《说服性沟通与向上管理》| 韦斯·考（Maven、altMBA、Section4）

bio.en: Wes Kao co-created the Alt-MBA with Seth Godin and co-founded Maven, and is a writer and educator focused on operations, management, and executive communication.
bio.zh: Wes Kao 与 Seth Godin 共同创造了 Alt-MBA，并联合创立了 Maven，她是一位专注于运营、管理与高管沟通的写作者和教育者。

episodeTitle.en: The art of product management | Shreyas Doshi (Stripe, Twitter, Google, Yahoo)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品管理的艺术 | 施雷亚斯·多希（Stripe、Twitter、Google、雅虎）

bio.en: Shreyas Doshi is a product leader and one of today's most consistently insightful voices on the craft of product management, drawing on senior product roles at Google, Twitter, Yahoo, and Stripe.
bio.zh: Shreyas Doshi 是一位产品领导者，也是当下对产品管理手艺最具持续洞察力的声音之一，其经验来自在 Google、Twitter、Yahoo 和 Stripe 的高级产品职务。

episodeTitle.en: The nature of product | Marty Cagan, Silicon Valley Product Group
episodeTitle.zh: 产品之道 | 硅谷产品集团的马蒂·卡根

bio.en: Marty Cagan is the author of Inspired and Empowered and a partner at SVPG, widely regarded as one of the most influential voices in modern product management.
bio.zh: 马蒂·卡根（Marty Cagan）是《Inspired》与《Empowered》的作者、SVPG 的合伙人，被公认为现代产品管理领域最具影响力的声音之一。

episodeTitle.en: The art of building legendary brands | Arielle Jackson (Google, Square, First Round Capital)
episodeTitle.zh: 《打造传奇品牌的艺术》 | 阿里尔·杰克逊（Arielle Jackson，曾就职于Google、Square、First Round Capital）

bio.en: Arielle Jackson spent nine years at Google helping grow Gmail from a side project, was one of the first marketers at Square, and has advised 100+ early-stage companies on brand and marketing; she now teaches startup brand strategy and is a marketer-in-residence at First Round.
bio.zh: Arielle Jackson 在 Google 工作了九年，助力 Gmail 从一个副项目成长起来；她是 Square 最早的营销人员之一，并为 100 多家早期公司提供品牌与营销建议；她现在讲授创业品牌策略，并是 First Round 的驻场营销人。

episodeTitle.en: The rituals of great teams | Shishir Mehrotra, Coda, YouTube, Microsoft
episodeTitle.zh: 优秀团队的仪式感 | 希希尔·梅赫罗特拉，Coda，YouTube，微软

bio.en: Shishir Mehrotra is co-founder and CEO of Coda, the all-in-one doc, spreadsheet, and product workspace, and previously spent over a decade at Google/YouTube, where he was a VP leading core product areas including YouTube's homepage and watch experience.
bio.zh: Shishir Mehrotra 是 Coda 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Coda 是一款集文档、表格与产品工作区于一体的工具；此前他在 Google/YouTube 工作逾十年，担任副总裁，领导包括 YouTube 首页与观看体验在内的核心产品领域。

episodeTitle.en: How to launch and grow your product | Ryan Hoover of Product Hunt and Weekend Fund
episodeTitle.zh: 如何推出并发展你的产品 | Product Hunt和Weekend Fund的瑞安·胡佛

bio.en: Ryan Hoover is the founder of Product Hunt and a full-time investor through his fund Weekend Fund, and previously spent time as a product manager before becoming a well-known figure in tech.
bio.zh: Ryan Hoover 是 Product Hunt 的创始人，也是通过其基金 Weekend Fund 全职从事投资的人，在成为科技圈知名人物之前，他曾担任过产品经理。

episodeTitle.en: How to scrappily hire for, measure, and unlock growth | Crystal Widjaja, Gojek and Kumu
episodeTitle.zh: 何以以低成本招聘、精准衡量并释放增长潜力 | 水晶·维迪雅加（Gojek、Kumu产品负责人）

bio.en: Crystal Widjaja is Chief Product Officer at Kumu and was a growth leader at Gojek, where she built and led the growth team through its rise to Southeast Asia's largest super app.
bio.zh: Crystal Widjaja 是 Kumu 首席产品官，曾任 Gojek 增长负责人，在那里建立并领导增长团队，助其成长为东南亚最大的超级应用。

episodeTitle.en: How to create a winning product strategy | Melissa Perri
episodeTitle.zh: 如何制定成功的产品策略 | 梅丽莎·佩里

bio.en: Melissa Perri is the author of Escaping the Build Trap and a leading voice on product strategy and product management training.
bio.zh: 梅丽莎·佩里（Melissa Perri）是《逃离构建陷阱》（Escaping the Build Trap）的作者，也是产品战略与产品管理培训领域的领军声音。

episodeTitle.en: How to unlock your product leadership skills | Ken Norton, Ex-Google
episodeTitle.zh: 如何解锁产品领导力 | 肯·诺顿（前谷歌高管）

bio.en: Ken Norton spent 14 years at Google leading product teams behind Google Docs, Calendar, and Maps, and now works full-time as an executive coach for product leaders.
bio.zh: 肯·诺顿（Ken Norton）在 Google 工作了 14 年，领导过 Google Docs、Calendar 和 Maps 等产品团队，如今是全职的产品高管教练。

episodeTitle.en: How to sell your ideas and rise within your company | Casey Winters, Eventbrite
episodeTitle.zh: 如何在公司推销自己的想法并晋升 | 凯西·温特斯（Casey Winters），Eventbrite

bio.en: Casey Winters is a growth and product strategist who has led growth or advised companies including Grubhub, Pinterest, Reddit, Eventbrite (as CPO), Canva, Airbnb, Tinder, and Thumbtack, and was the first repeat guest on Lenny's Podcast.
bio.zh: Casey Winters 是一位增长与产品战略专家，曾领导或与 Grubhub、Pinterest、Reddit、Eventbrite（任 CPO）、Canva、Airbnb、Tinder、Thumbtack 等公司合作或提供顾问，并且是 Lenny 播客第一个返场嘉宾。

episodeTitle.en: Nickey Skarstad (Airbnb, Etsy, Shopify, Duolingo) on translating vision into goals, operationalizing product quality, second-order decisions, brainstorming, influence, and much more
episodeTitle.zh: 尼基·斯卡斯塔德（曾任Airbnb、Etsy、Shopify、Duolingo产品总监）将探讨如何将愿景转化为目标、产品质量的运营化、二阶决策、头脑风暴、影响力等诸多议题。

bio.en: Nickey Skarstad is a product leader at Duolingo (and formerly Airbnb and The Wing) known internally as a PM who gets things done, and a repeated community recommendation as an under-the-radar guest.
bio.zh: 尼基·斯卡斯塔德（Nickey Skarstad）是 Duolingo 的产品负责人（此前在 Airbnb 和 The Wing），以"能把事做成"的 PM 闻名于内部，也是社群反复推荐、却低调的嘉宾。

episodeTitle.en: Manik Gupta (ex-CPO Uber, Google Maps) on how to build consumer apps, why it’s useful to be optimistic about technology, creating inflections in your PM career, the changing CPO role, and more
episodeTitle.zh: Manik Gupta（前优步、谷歌地图首席产品官）谈如何打造消费者应用、为何对科技保持乐观态度、在产品管理生涯中创造转折点、CPO角色的变化等

bio.en: Manik Gupta led two of history's most successful consumer products - Google Maps as director of product and Uber as Chief Product Officer - and later joined Microsoft as a Corporate VP.
bio.zh: 马尼克·古普塔（Manik Gupta）曾领导史上最成功的两款消费级产品——作为产品总监领导 Google Maps，并担任 Uber 的首席产品官——后来以企业副总裁身份加入微软。

episodeTitle.en: Merci Grace (ex-Head of Growth at Slack) on PLG, interviewing, storytelling, building a diverse team, hiring salespeople, building a growth team, and much more
episodeTitle.zh: Merci Grace（前Slack增长部门主管）谈产品生命周期管理、面试技巧、讲故事、组建多元化团队、招聘销售人员、建立增长团队等

bio.en: Merci Grace is the founder and CEO of Panobi, was previously Head of Growth and Head of Product at Slack, and is a co-founder of Women in Product.
bio.zh: 梅西·格雷斯（Merci Grace）是 Panobi 的创始人兼 CEO，此前曾任 Slack 的增长负责人与产品负责人，也是 Women in Product 的联合创始人。

episodeTitle.en: Sanchan Saxena (VP of Product at Coinbase) on the inside story of how Airbnb made it through Covid; what he’s learned from Brian Chesky, Brian Armstrong, and Kevin Systrom; much more
episodeTitle.zh: 桑钱·萨克塞纳（Coinbase产品副总裁）将分享Airbnb如何度过新冠疫情的内部故事；他从布莱恩·切斯基、布莱恩·阿姆斯特朗和凯文·西斯特罗姆身上学到的经验；以及更多内容。

bio.en: Sanchan Saxena is VP of Product at Coinbase and was previously Head of Product and GM at Airbnb, founder and Head of Product of Instagram Shopping, Director of Product at Yahoo, and a PM at Microsoft.
bio.zh: Sanchan Saxena 是 Coinbase 的产品副总裁，此前曾任 Airbnb 产品负责人兼总经理、Instagram Shopping 创始人兼产品负责人、Yahoo 产品总监，以及微软产品经理。

episodeTitle.en: Brandon Chu on building product at Shopify, how writing changed the trajectory of his career, the habits that make you a great PM, pros and cons of being a platform PM, how Shopify got through Covid
episodeTitle.zh: 布兰登·朱（Brandon Chu）在Shopify的职业生涯：如何在产品管理中突破极限

bio.en: Brandon Chu is a former VP of Product and GM of Platform at Shopify, where he helped define and scale the company's product organization, and the creator of influential writing on product management (The Black Box of Product Management / The Linear Method).
bio.zh: Brandon Chu 曾任 Shopify 产品副总裁兼平台总经理，帮助定义并扩展了公司的产品组织，也是极具影响力的产品管理著作（The Black Box of Product Management / The Linear Method）的作者。

episodeTitle.en: Gibson Biddle on his DHM product strategy framework, GEM roadmap prioritization framework, 5 Netflix strategy mini case studies, building a personal board of directors, and much more
episodeTitle.zh: 吉布森·比德尔将分享他的DHM产品战略框架、GEM路线图优先级框架、5个Netflix战略迷你案例研究、如何组建个人董事会等诸多内容。

bio.en: Gibson Biddle is a veteran product leader who served as VP of Product at Netflix and Chief Product Officer at Chegg, and now advises companies and teaches product strategy through his popular newsletter on product leadership.
bio.zh: Gibson Biddle 是一位资深产品负责人，曾任 Netflix 产品副总裁、Chegg 首席产品官，如今通过自己广受欢迎的“产品领导力”newsletter 为企业提供咨询并讲授产品战略。

episodeTitle.en: Jackie Bavaro on getting better at product strategy, what exactly is strategy, PM pitfalls to avoid, advancing your career, getting into management, and much more
episodeTitle.zh: 杰基·巴瓦罗（Jackie Bavaro）将谈及如何提升产品战略能力、战略的定义、产品经理需避免的陷阱、职业发展、晋升管理层等诸多话题。

bio.en: Jackie Bavaro is a product leader and co-author of the bestselling PM guides Cracking the PM Interview and Cracking the PM Career, drawing on product experience at Amazon, Facebook, and Dropbox.
bio.zh: Jackie Bavaro 是一位产品负责人，也是畅销 PM 指南《Cracking the PM Interview》和《Cracking the PM Career》的合著者，产品经验来自 Amazon、Facebook 和 Dropbox。

episodeTitle.en: Gokul Rajaram on designing your product development process, when and how to hire your first PM, a playbook for hiring leaders, getting ahead in you career, how to get started angel investing, more
episodeTitle.zh: 戈库尔·拉贾拉姆将探讨如何设计产品开发流程、何时及如何聘请首位产品经理、招聘领导者的指南、职业发展、如何开启天使投资等诸多话题。

bio.en: Gokul Rajaram is a product and business leader at DoorDash, a prolific angel investor, and a board member at companies including Coinbase, Pinterest, and The Trade Desk, who describes himself simply as a 'startup helper.'
bio.zh: Gokul Rajaram 是 DoorDash 的产品与业务负责人、高产的天使投资人，并担任 Coinbase、Pinterest、The Trade Desk 等公司的董事，他却把自己简单称作一名“创业帮手”。
